dictionary_entries.original: Vantage Pictures is an international video production company with offices in the United States, Vietnam and Hong Kong. We pride ourselves on bringing a multicultural touch to globally produced content, so that your brand may reach the widest possible audience in an authentic way.
dictionary_entries.translated: Vantage Pictures 是一家国际视频制作公司，在美国、越南和香港都设有办事处。我们为全球制作的内容带来多元文化的触及而感到自豪，这样您的品牌可以以真实的方式触及最广泛的受众。

dictionary_entries.original: We’re made up of producers, directors and creatives from all around the world who seek to bring a fresh voice to commercial storytelling. With every project, it’s our sole mission to illuminate the unseen vantage that makes every brand unique.
dictionary_entries.translated: 我们的团队由来自世界各地的制片人、导演和创意人士组成，致力于为商业故事讲述带来新鲜声音。在每一个项目中，我们唯一的使命就是展示使每个品牌独一无二的不可见视角。

dictionary_entries.original: in the Rich Natural Beauty of Vietnam

Vietnam is quickly becoming the next advertising hub of Southeast Asia with full-scale production services at a fraction of the standard costs in many countries. With its stunning landscapes and diverse cultural history, Vietnam offers a wide range of shooting locations that can fit the look of any commercial.
dictionary_entries.translated: 越南正在迅速成为东南亚广告产业的新兴中心，全方位的制作服务费用仅为许多国家的一部分。凭借其壮丽的景观和丰富的文化历史，越南拥有各种各样的拍摄地点，可满足任何广告的视觉需求。

dictionary_entries.original: With our remote offices in Ho Chi Minh City, Vantage Pictures has years of experience filming all across Vietnam. We offer all of the same production services and our multilingual team will make your transition to shooting abroad completely seamless– you'll hardly even know you left home.
dictionary_entries.translated: 凭借在胡志明市的远程办公室，Vantage Pictures在越南各地拥有多年的拍摄经验。我们提供与国内相同的制作服务，而我们的多语言团队将使您在海外拍摄的过渡完全无缝——您几乎不会察觉到自己离开了家乡。

dictionary_entries.original: Vietnam has no shortage of professional shooting facilities, casting agencies and equipment. As the local film & TV industry continues to grow every year, you'll find state-of-the-art sound stages that fit the needs of any production.
dictionary_entries.translated: 在越南，专业拍摄设施、选角机构和设备一应俱全。随着当地电影和电视行业逐年发展壮大，你将发现这里有各种先进的录音棚，足以满足任何制作需求。

dictionary_entries.original: In terms of gear, rest assured because Vietnam has just about anything you'd find in your home country. Rental houses carry the latest items from every major brand and if you're looking for something special, let us know ahead of time and we'll locate the nearest source.
dictionary_entries.translated: 在设备方面，也请放心，因为越南几乎拥有你在本国能找到的一切。设备租赁公司提供各大品牌的最新产品，如果你需要某种特殊设备，提前告诉我们，我们会帮你找到最近的供应商。
越南制作服务

dictionary_entries.original: With our Vietnam office based in Saigon, Vantage Pictures provides full-scale production services all across beautiful Southeast Asia.
dictionary_entries.translated: Vantage Pictures 的越南办事处设在西贡，在美丽的东南亚各地提供全面的制作服务。.

dictionary_entries.original: In search of adventure and a simpler lifestyle, this family hit the road in a tiny, traveling home. Leaving routine behind, the Collier family found freedom spending time together – exploring the length and breadth of New Zealand and its stunning scenery.
dictionary_entries.translated: 为了寻找冒险和更简单的生活方式，这个家庭驾驶着微型的旅行屋上路了。抛开日常例行，Collier家庭找到了自由，共度时光-探索新西兰的广阔领土和令人惊叹的景色。

dictionary_entries.original: Today we live with a greater understanding of sustainability challenges – and with a host of solutions, too. IONIQ, Hyundai’s new electric line-up, utilizes sustainable materials that will allow the vehicle to perform with a much lighter footprint. By listening and learning from others, there’s an opportunity for the whole system to shift to a more sustainable way of being. If we join hands, sustainability for human progress is within our reach.
dictionary_entries.translated: 今天，我们对可持续性挑战的理解更深刻，也有了许多解决方案。现代汽车的新电动汽车系列IONIQ采用可持续材料，这将使车辆的性能具有更轻的足迹。通过倾听和学习他人的经验，我们有机会将整个系统转向更可持续的生活方式。如果我们携手合作，可持续发展对于人类的进步已经近在眼前。

Branded documentary for drone manufacturer DJI, featuring a world-famous Mongolian eagle huntress.
dictionary_entries.translated: 为无人机制造商大疆创新拍摄的品牌纪录片，以世界闻名的蒙古女猎鹰为主角。.

dictionary_entries.original: Follow the DJI film crew on an epic adventure into the Altai Mountains of Western Mongolia, where they battle harsh elements and sub-zero temperatures to bring you the DJI World short film about Aisholpan, Mongolia's famous eagle huntress. See how the DJI Ronin and the Inspire 2 were put to the test in some of the harshest conditions DJI has ever shot in, to create this cinematic, moving short film.
dictionary_entries.translated: 跟随大疆电影制作团队，踏上蒙古西部阿尔泰山的史诗般冒险之旅，他们与恶劣天气和零下低温作斗争，为您带来大疆世界关于蒙古著名猎鹰少女艾肖尔潘的短片。了解大疆如影系列稳定器和 Inspire 2 在大疆拍摄过的最严酷的环境中如何经受考验，最终创作出这部电影感十足、感人至深的短片。.

dictionary_entries.original: The ancient tradition of hunting with eagles has been practiced in the mountains of Western Mongolia for centuries. Historically done by men, a brave young girl is now taking on her father’s legacy. Hers is a breathtaking story of empowerment and evolving tradition, set in the stunning landscapes of the Altai Mountains. Captured with the DJI Ronin and Inspire 2 by the DJI film crew.
dictionary_entries.translated: 猎鹰捕猎的古老传统在西蒙古的山区已经传承了几个世纪。这项活动历史上一直由男性进行，但现在一位勇敢的年轻女孩正在继承她父亲的衣钵。她的故事极具震撼力，展现了赋权和不断演变的传统，故事背景设定在壮丽的阿尔泰山脉。由大疆电影摄制组使用 DJI Ronin 和 Inspire 2 拍摄。.

dictionary_entries.original: Our Strategic Approach to the Video
, “A video is by far the best way to get a feel for the emotions, motivations and character of a project. It’s a demonstration of effort and a good predictor of success.”
dictionary_entries.translated: , “迄今为止，视频是了解一个项目的情感、动机和特点的最佳方式。它是努力的展示，也是成功的良好预测”。”

dictionary_entries.original: EcoFlow is no stranger to crowdfunding. They’re fully aware of the importance of video in the success of a campaign. So when they invited us to bid on the project, we knew we had to strategize a data-driven approach to the creative that would yield measurable results and meet their budget limitations.
dictionary_entries.translated: EcoFlow 对众筹并不陌生。他们充分认识到视频对活动成功的重要性。因此，当他们邀请我们竞标该项目时，我们知道我们必须制定一个以数据为导向的创意策略，既能产生可衡量的结果，又能满足他们的预算限制。.

dictionary_entries.original: A video is by far the best way to get a feel for the emotions, motivations and character of a project. It’s a demonstration of effort and a good predictor of success.
dictionary_entries.translated: 迄今为止，视频是了解一个项目的情感、动机和特点的最佳方式。它是努力的展示，也是成功的良好预测。.

dictionary_entries.original: We decided to use a combination of both live-action scenes and high-end 3D animation. This allowed us to visualize DELTA Pro’s more advanced features in a very clear and engaging way. While the live-action scenes provided relatable scenarios for target demographics, the flashy CGI helped elevate EcoFlow’s brand as a cutting-edge tech company.
dictionary_entries.translated: 我们决定将实景拍摄与高端三维动画相结合。这使我们能够以非常清晰和引人入胜的方式将 DELTA Pro 更为先进的功能形象化。真人场景为目标人群提供了贴近生活的场景，而华丽的 CGI 则有助于提升 EcoFlow 作为尖端科技公司的品牌形象。.

dictionary_entries.original: From the start, DELTA Pro was set for a global release in virtually all major markets around the world. Its most important demographic would be middle-aged, tech-savvy families in the United States, so we knew we needed a Western look for our talent and locations.
dictionary_entries.translated: 从一开始，《DELTA Pro》就计划在全球所有主要市场发行。它最重要的受众群体将是美国精通技术的中年家庭，因此我们知道，我们的人才和拍摄地点都需要西方风格。.

dictionary_entries.original: We decided to film in Washington DC. It’s a rather uncommon shooting location that would keep costs low while providing plenty of options for a classic American-style family home.
dictionary_entries.translated: 我们决定在华盛顿特区拍摄。这是一个相当少见的拍摄地，既能降低成本，又能为经典美式家庭住宅提供大量选择。.

dictionary_entries.original: This allowed us to achieve the look that EcoFlow needed for its key demographic. For Asian markets, our post-production team drafted multiple translations for the motion graphic text and voice over subtitles, so that the campaign would reach a wider global audience.
dictionary_entries.translated: 这样，我们就能实现 EcoFlow 针对其主要人群所需的外观。针对亚洲市场，我们的后期制作团队为动态图形文本和配音字幕起草了多个翻译版本，以便让更多的全球受众了解这项活动。.

dictionary_entries.original: In this new era of digital marketing, repurposing content is more important than ever. For the DELTA Pro campaign, we wanted to make sure that EcoFlow had plenty of ancillary material for continued promotion over the next 6-12 months.
dictionary_entries.translated: 在数字营销的新时代，内容的再利用比以往任何时候都更加重要。在 DELTA Pro 活动中，我们希望确保 EcoFlow 有大量的辅助材料，以便在未来 6-12 个月内继续推广。.

dictionary_entries.original: In addition to the main video, we provided three cut-downs for social media as well as key visual photos, which were shot alongside the video. Not only did this reduce the cost of each deliverable, it also gave all visuals across the campaign a cohesive look. Then, EcoFlow was armed with many months’ worth of content that could be shared across all marketing channels to drive more and more traffic to their Kickstarter page.
dictionary_entries.translated: 除主视频外，我们还为社交媒体提供了三段剪辑，以及与视频同时拍摄的关键视觉照片。这不仅降低了每项交付的成本，还使整个活动的所有视觉效果具有凝聚力。这样，EcoFlow 就拥有了几个月的内容，可以在所有营销渠道分享，从而为他们的 Kickstarter 页面带来越来越多的流量。.

dictionary_entries.original: Our main strategy for achieving great results within the proposed budget was sharing resources between videos. In addition to DELTA Pro, EcoFlow planned to announce three other products at the same time. We put together a package for all four campaigns that greatly reduced the cost of each video by producing them together—with many of the same crew members, talent, locations, props, etc.
dictionary_entries.translated: 我们在预算范围内取得巨大成果的主要策略是在视频之间共享资源。除 DELTA Pro 外，EcoFlow 还计划同时发布其他三款产品。我们为所有四个宣传活动设计了一个套餐，通过共同制作大大降低了每个视频的成本--使用相同的工作人员、人才、场地、道具等。.
在 COVID-19 期间进行国际拍摄

dictionary_entries.original: The safety of our production crew is always a top priority so there was much deliberation over how we should manage an international shoot.
dictionary_entries.translated: 制作人员的安全始终是我们工作的重中之重，因此我们对如何管理国际拍摄进行了反复斟酌。.

dictionary_entries.original: With the right preparations during pre-production, we were able to reduce our traveling crew to a single person. Our co-founder and in-house director, Zacharia Lorenz, flew from our offices in Vietnam to oversee the shoot while our producing team managed everything remotely from Asia. It was an ideal solution for minimizing potential exposure to the virus without hemorrhaging money toward travel costs.
dictionary_entries.translated: 通过前期的正确准备，我们将出差人员减少到了一个人。我们的联合创始人兼内部导演 Zacharia Lorenz 从越南的办公室飞来监督拍摄，而我们的制作团队则在亚洲远程管理一切。这是一个理想的解决方案，既能最大限度地减少可能接触病毒的机会，又不会因差旅费而大出血。.

dictionary_entries.original: We were also lucky to work with our friends over at
dictionary_entries.translated: 我们还有幸与我们的朋友在

dictionary_entries.original: , who provided production support on the ground in Washington DC. We worked closely with LGND’s team to safely reduce the number of active crew members on set, keeping only the bare minimum that was required to achieve the creative.
dictionary_entries.translated: , 他们在华盛顿特区提供现场制作支持。我们与 LGND 的团队密切合作，安全地减少了现场工作人员的数量，只保留了实现创意所需的最低人数。.

dictionary_entries.original: Technology also played a huge role in this production. With one editor in the Philippines, one editor in Vietnam and a VFX team in Thailand, we couldn’t afford to waste days transcoding footage and shipping hard drives… Just two month before the shoot, Frame.io launched its new
dictionary_entries.translated: 技术在这次制作中也发挥了巨大作用。一个剪辑师在菲律宾，一个剪辑师在越南，还有一个视觉特效团队在泰国，我们不能再浪费转码素材和运输硬盘的时间了。

dictionary_entries.original: real-time upload workflow and we were quick to jump aboard. With C2C, every time we wrapped a take, our video files would be instantaneously uploaded to our Frame.io library and transcoded. Within hours of wrapping each shoot day, all proxies were accessible to our multinational post team, ready to be downloaded and cut into something awesome.
dictionary_entries.translated: 我们很快就加入了实时上传工作流程。有了 C2C，每次拍摄结束后，我们的视频文件都会立即上传到 Frame.io 库并进行转码。在每个拍摄日结束后的几个小时内，我们的跨国后期团队就可以访问所有代理文件，并准备下载和剪辑成精彩的作品。.

Take all the work out of finding the perfect picture; just turn on Horizon in any room and reshape your cinema experience in seconds, right out of the box. Get more immersive anywhere you choose with industry-leading picture quality, intelligent imaging features, and Hi-Fi sound from Harman Kardon. No more limits, no more hassle.

dictionary_entries.original: Designed to cool small spaces and the outdoors, Wave balances excellent cooling performance, long run times, and portability. Drop your tent’s temperature in 8 minutes, and adjust the run time to sleep comfortably through the night. There’re multiple charging methods, including solar, so you’re never caught short when you’re off-grid.
dictionary_entries.translated: Wave 设计用于在室内小空间和户外空间进行降温，兼具出色的制冷性能、长续航时间和便携性。 8分钟即可降低帐篷内的温度，您还可以调节运行时间，舒适地安睡整夜。有多种充电方式，包括太阳能充电，这样您在户外离网时就不会捉襟见肘。.

dictionary_entries.original: Branded documentary for drone manufacturer DJI, a behind the scenes look at the filming of Linkin Park’s Hunting Party tour diary video in China.
dictionary_entries.translated: 为无人机制造商大疆创新（DJI）制作的品牌纪录片，讲述林肯公园在中国拍摄 "Hunting Party "巡演日记视频的幕后故事。.

dictionary_entries.original: When Linkin Park returned to China in the Summer of 2015 to showcase their new sound and meet a new generation of fans, we were there to capture their every step on the way through the country’s largest cities, from Shenzhen in the south, to Shanghai, Chongqing, Beijing, and Nanjing. For a unique perspective on the band, we used DJI gimbal systems including Inspire 1, Ronin, Ronin-M, and Phantom 3.
dictionary_entries.translated: 2015年夏天，林肯公园重返中国，展示他们的新声音并与新一代粉丝见面，我们捕捉了他们从南方深圳到上海、重庆、北京和南京等中国大城市的每一个足迹。为了从独特的视角展示乐队，我们使用了大疆（DJI）的稳定器系统，包括悟1（Inspire 1）、如影（Ronin）、如影（Ronin-M）和精灵3（Phantom 3）。.

In order to distinguish herself and her work to get noticed, she started to shoot from above. Watch how Helene reimagines the art of wedding photography with her own inimitable signature style.

dictionary_entries.original:
When it comes to search and rescue missions, time is scarce and mistakes cannot be afforded. Especially in countries like Iceland where weather conditions are harsh and daylight is limited.
Thor Argnrimsson, member of a search and rescue team in Iceland, believes the DJI M200 Series has revolutionized the way in which his team can work. He takes us through the challenges of a typical mission and the ways in which the DJI M200 Series overcomes these obstacles by adding efficiency and reliability to each mission.
dictionary_entries.translated:
在搜救任务中，时间紧迫，不容出错。尤其是在冰岛这样天气恶劣、日照时间有限的国家。
冰岛搜救队成员 Thor Argnrimsson 认为，大疆M200系列产品彻底改变了他所在团队的工作方式。他将带领我们了解一次典型任务的挑战，以及大疆M200系列产品如何通过提高任务效率和可靠性来克服这些困难。.

dictionary_entries.original: Making the most out of a trip can be challenging. Where do you go? How do you get there? And what should you do to preserve your best travel memories? DJI is here to help with seven practical Mavic Pro travel tips. Make the most out of your next excursion to the great unknown!
dictionary_entries.translated: 充分享受旅行可能充满挑战。去哪里？怎么去？以及如何珍藏旅途中的美好回忆？大疆 Mavic Pro 将为您提供七个实用的旅行小贴士，助您充分利用下一次探险未知之行！

dictionary_entries.original: Aerial platforms are rapidly becoming vital tools for businesses looking to more efficiently collect information crucial to their operations. As the first integrated aerial camera with an optical zoom up to 30x, the Zenmuse Z30 offers unparalleled image data capture. Designed to seamlessly integrate with DJI’s Matrice series of airframes, the Zenmuse Z30 works right out of the box and gives access to the intelligent features DJI is known for.
dictionary_entries.translated: 空中平台正迅速成为企业收集运营所需的关键信息的更为高效的重要工具。作为首款集成光学变焦高达 30 倍的航拍相机，禅思 Z30 可提供无与伦比的图像数据采集能力。Zenmuse Z30 设计宗旨是与 DJI 的 Matrice 系列机架无缝集成，开箱即用，并能访问 DJI 享誉业界的智能功能。.

James Duong，马西米利安·伦内森

dictionary_entries.original: Arup is a British engineering firm that is never shy for a challenge and always looking to innovate their craft. In Shenzhen, the company is now adapting DJI’s Inspire 1 to collect information about and create 3D models of the city to better understand it, so that they can design a more sustainable city for the future.
dictionary_entries.translated: 奥雅普是一家从未畏惧挑战、始终致力于创新工艺的英国工程公司。目前，该公司正在深圳对大疆“悟”Inspire 1无人机进行改造，以收集关于城市的信息并创建城市的三维模型，从而更好地了解这座城市，以便为未来设计一个更可持续的城市。.
大疆故事——构筑我们的未来

dictionary_entries.original: DJI Stories – Building Our Future – Vantage Pictures
dictionary_entries.translated: 大疆创新故事 - 共创未来 - Vantage Pictures

dictionary_entries.original: The new DJI Osmo Mobile transforms your phone into a smart motion camera that keeps your footage stable even on the move. Simply snap in your phone to become the director and star of your life’s movie. Capture action selfies or make that script of yours into a moving picture for the big screen, and edit and share right within DJI GO. Make your phone more than smart, make it Osmo.
dictionary_entries.translated: 全新 DJI Osmo Mobile 将您的手机变身为智能稳定器，即使在移动中也能保持画面稳定。只需将手机安装进去，您就可以成为自己生活电影的导演和主演。拍摄动感自拍，或将您的剧本变成大银幕上的动态影像，并直接在 DJI GO 应用中编辑和分享。让您的手机不仅仅是智能，更是 Osmo。.

dictionary_entries.original: DJI was invited to visit Chernobyl with filmmaker Philip Grossman, who is making a documentary named ‘Half-Lives’. This documentary is part of a five-year personal project that Philip has been working on about the area surrounding the Chernobyl nuclear power plant, where in the early hours of 26 April 1986, one of four nuclear reactors exploded creating a 30km radius zone now known as the “The Zone”. Philip used the DJI Ronin, Phantom 3 Professional, & Inspire 1 to capture his images.
dictionary_entries.translated: 大疆创新受邀与电影制片人菲利普-格罗斯曼（Philip Grossman）一同探访切尔诺贝利。1986年4月26日凌晨，切尔诺贝利核电站四座核反应堆中的一座发生爆炸，造成方圆30公里的区域被称为 ‘核区’。菲利普使用大疆 Ronin、Phantom 3 Professional 和 Inspire 1 拍摄了照片。.

dictionary_entries.original: Product introduction video for the DJI Spark mini drone.
dictionary_entries.translated: DJI Spark 微型无人机的产品介绍视频。.

dictionary_entries.original: Meet Spark, DJI’s first ever mini drone. Signature technologies, new gesture control, and unbelievable portability make your aerials more fun and intuitive than ever before. With five different colors, there’s a Spark for everyone.
dictionary_entries.translated: 认识 Spark，大疆首款迷你无人机。标志性的技术、全新的手势控制以及令人难以置信的便携性，让您的航拍比以往任何时候都更加有趣和直观。Spark 有五种不同的颜色，总有一款适合您。.

dictionary_entries.original: After graduating from the New York Institute of Photography, CJ Kale moved to Hawaii to start his career as a photographer and became the first person ever to photograph lava entering the ocean from the surf, which required him risking his life to create a work of art. With the Phantom 4 Pro’s improved camera and precise controls, Kale is now able to keep breaking creative boundaries while gaining unprecedented creative control and shooting from a safe distance.
dictionary_entries.translated: 在纽约摄影学院毕业后，CJ Kale 移居夏威夷开始了他的摄影生涯，并成为第一个从浪尖拍摄熔岩入海的人，这需要他冒着生命危险去创造一件艺术品。凭借 Phantom 4 Pro 改进的相机和精确的控制，Kale 现在可以在确保安全距离拍摄的同时，不断突破创作界限，并获得前所未有的创意控制。.
游牧电影人（特邀：凯莉·弗拉维尔）

dictionary_entries.original: Kylie’s unique lifestyle of spontaneous traveling and filmmaking has inspired people across the globe. With the companionship of her Mavic Pro, she can capture and share her adventures with creativity and ease.
dictionary_entries.translated: 凯莉独特的生活方式——随性旅行和拍摄电影，激励了世界各地的人们。有了她 Mavic Pro 的陪伴，她就可以轻松、富有创意地捕捉和分享她的冒险经历。.

dictionary_entries.original: Ellie and Jared share videos of their young boys Jackson and Calvin, (and their dog Penny), with more than a million fans across the world every day. They believe that every moment their family shares together is priceless and worthy of being remembered. With the Mavic Pro, they can document all these moments of their family’s love, shenanigans, and journey.
dictionary_entries.translated: Ellie 和 Jared 每天与全球超过百万的粉丝分享他们的小儿子 Jackson 和 Calvin （还有他们的狗狗 Penny）的视频。他们认为，他们一家人在一起分享的每一个时刻都无比珍贵，值得被铭记。有了 Mavic Pro，他们就可以记录下他们家庭的爱、趣事和旅程中的所有这些时刻。.

dictionary_entries.original: Self professed tech geek Kai has played around with his fair share of cool gadgets. But the Mavic Pro is something different altogether.
Series of short global commercial spots for the Realme X7 smartphone.
dictionary_entries.translated: Realme X7 智能手机的全球广告短片系列。.

dictionary_entries.original: The realme X7 is packed with specs perfect for gaming... the Dimensity 800U is equipped with a 7nm octa-core CPU and two A76 cores clocking in at 2.4GHz and the GPU is empowered by the ARM Mali G57 with an AnTuTu score of 340,000+.
dictionary_entries.translated: realme X7 搭载了堪称游戏玩家的完美配置... 天玑 800U 配备 7nm 八核 CPU，拥有两颗主频达 2.4GHz 的 A76 核心，GPU 搭载 ARM Mali G57，安兔兔跑分超过 340,000+。.
Realme X7 活动 - Vantage Pictures

dictionary_entries.original: The coldest corners of the world can also be the most beautiful. Watch as award-winning director Jimmy Chin and freeskiing champion Kit DesLauriers face the formidable mountains and frigid temperatures of Greenland’s western fjords. They must navigate unknown variables as they ascend to the summit, and then ski all the way down to the base. This short video is a blend of stunning scenery, dogged determination, and an expedition of epic proportions.
dictionary_entries.translated: 世界上最寒冷的地方也可以是最美丽的地方。观看获奖导演吉米·钦（Jimmy Chin）和自由滑雪冠军基特·德劳里埃（Kit DesLauriers）在格陵兰西部峡湾面对险峻的山脉和严寒的温度。他们必须在攀登至顶峰的过程中应对未知的变量，然后一路滑雪至山脚。这部短片融合了绝美的风景、顽强的决心，以及一场史诗般的探险。.

dictionary_entries.original: The short film Expedition Greenland allowed Jimmy Chin to demonstrate the endless possibilities of shooting with DJI’s Mavic 2. From beautiful aerial landscapes to adrenaline-inducing ski footage, the Mavic 2 can capture it all. Chin is able to convey the magnificence of the awe-inspiring peaks of Greenland thanks to the vivid colors and details granted by the Mavic 2.
dictionary_entries.translated: 短片《格陵兰探险》让吉米·陈展示了使用大疆 Mavic 2 拍摄的无限可能。从美丽的航拍风景到令人肾上腺素飙升的滑雪镜头，Mavic 2 都能捕捉。由于 Mavic 2 提供的鲜艳色彩和细节，陈才得以传达出格陵兰令人敬畏的山峰的壮丽景象。.

dictionary_entries.original: The DJI Zenmuse X7 was designed to bring ultimate professional imaging to aerial cinematography. With a new DL-Mount, multiple prime lenses, and advanced sensors and color systems, the X7 creates breathtaking shots indoors and outdoors, in fair and foul weather, on smooth and rugged landscapes anywhere. The following showreel demonstrates the diverse applications in which the Zenmuse X7 excels when fitted on an Inspire 2 drone, creating a completely integrated system for every shot.
dictionary_entries.translated: DJI Zenmuse X7 旨在为航拍电影制作带来极致的专业影像。凭借全新的 DL 卡口、多款定焦镜头以及先进的传感器和色彩系统，X7 无论是在室内还是室外、晴天还是恶劣天气、平坦还是崎岖的地形，都能捕捉到令人惊叹的画面。以下展示片展示了 Zenmuse X7 在安装在 Inspire 2 无人机上时表现出色的多样化应用，为每一次拍摄创建了一个完全集成化的系统。.

dictionary_entries.original: Drone platforms have proved a valuable resource for a host of industrial applications, including disaster response and construction. The expansion of drone operations has also presented a difficulty for scale management, standardizing procedures, and ensuring reliable regulatory compliance. To help organizations of all sizes conquer this challenge, DJI introduces FlightHub, enabling enterprise users to manage live operations, organize fleets, and log all of their historical flight data. Organize your aerial fleet with FlightHub, the ultimate solution for managing your drone operations.
dictionary_entries.translated: 无人机平台已成为包括灾难响应和建筑在内的众多工业应用的有价值的资源。无人机运营的扩展也给规模管理、标准化程序和确保可靠的监管合规性带来了挑战。为了帮助各种规模的组织应对这一挑战，大疆推出了 FlightHub，使企业用户能够管理实时运营、组织机队并记录所有历史飞行数据。通过 FlightHub 组织您的空中机队，这是管理您无人机运营的终极解决方案。.

dictionary_entries.original: Hong Kong is a city of wild contrasts, where urban chaos, untamed nature, and perfect solitude come together. For everybody in Hong Kong, the city has something different to offer, and every new place offers a different perspective, making Hong Kong a natural fit for DJI's third flagship store.
dictionary_entries.translated: 香港是一座充满野生对比的城市，都市的喧嚣、未经驯服的大自然和完美的宁静在这里交织在一起。香港的每个人都能在这里找到不同的东西，而每一个新的地方都能提供不同的视角，这使得香港成为DJI第三家旗舰店的理想选择。.

dictionary_entries.original: Widely recognized as the exemplar of three-axis handheld gimbals for professional filmmakers, ZHIYUN Crane2 series is proud to present you the newest masterpiece - #CRANE2S, featuring high load capacity and modular design, the CRANE 2S is keen on delivering reliable and excellent performance on different shooting sets.
dictionary_entries.translated: 智云 稳定器Crane 2 系列被广泛认为是专业电影制作人三轴手持稳定器的典范。我们荣幸地推出最新杰作——#CRANE2S。CRANE 2S 具有高负载能力和模块化设计，致力于在不同的拍摄场景中提供可靠且卓越的性能。.

dictionary_entries.original: Nan Hauser, world-renowned American marine biologist based on Rarotonga and Director of the Cook Islands Whale & Wildlife Center, has spent 25 years studying whales in order to be able to better protect them. Always at the forefront of her industry, she’s now adopted the DJI Phantom 3 because of its ability to let her and her team easily and quickly survey whales without scaring them away.
dictionary_entries.translated: 南·豪瑟（Nan Hauser）是一位世界知名的美国海洋生物学家，常驻拉罗汤加岛，并且是库克群岛鲸鱼与野生动物中心的主任。她花了25年时间研究鲸鱼，以便更好地保护它们。作为行业的先驱，她现在采用了大疆“御”3无人机（DJI Phantom 3），因为它能够让她的团队轻松快速地调查鲸鱼，而不会惊吓到它们。.

dictionary_entries.original: Hooves thump to the ground as mallets collide. DJI drones have brought polo back into the spotlight, giving players, teams and viewers a whole new passion for the sport.
dictionary_entries.translated: 蹄声踏响地面，马球杆激烈碰撞。大疆无人机让马球重新焕发生机，为球员、团队和观众带来了这项运动的全新激情。.

dictionary_entries.original: 7-second commercial spot for the Samsung Galaxy S21 Ultra 5G, featuring rapper BinZ. Released in January 2021.
dictionary_entries.translated: 三星 Galaxy S21 Ultra 5G 7秒广告，由说唱歌手 BinZ 出演。发布于2021年1月。.

dictionary_entries.original: Nguyen Tuan, Tuyen Ngoc, Dương Đặng
7-second commercial spot for the Samsung Galaxy S21 Ultra 5G earphones accessory, released in January 2021.
dictionary_entries.translated: 三星 Galaxy S21 Ultra 5G 耳机配件 7秒广告，发布于2021年1月。.

dictionary_entries.original: 7-second commercial spot for the Samsung Galaxy S21 Ultra 5G, released in January 2021.
dictionary_entries.translated: 三星 Galaxy S21 Ultra 5G，2021年1月发布，7秒广告.

dictionary_entries.original: Besieged by climate change, the beautiful coral atolls of the Maldives may soon disappear forever. Scientists predict that by 2050, most will be submerged in rising sea levels. With drones, mapping the topography of the island allows local communities and agencies like the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), to gather evidence-based spatial data to better inform policy makers influencing climate change issues.
dictionary_entries.translated: 面对气候变化的围困，马尔代夫美丽的珊瑚环礁可能很快就会永远消失。科学家预测，到2050年，大部分岛屿将被不断上升的海平面淹没。借助无人机绘制岛屿地形图，使当地社区和联合国开发计划署（UNDP）等机构能够收集基于证据的空间数据，从而更好地为影响气候变化问题的政策制定者提供信息。.

dictionary_entries.original: The Last Wild Place on Earth

In 1968, The North Face founder Doug Tompkins and three friends took a legendary road trip to Patagonia, South America. Captivated by Patagonia’s natural beauty, Doug and his wife Kris moved to Chile and created Tompkins Conservation. Over the past 25 years, they have purchased and developed more than 13 million acres of protected national parks. Following Doug’s legacy, world-renowned outdoor photographer Chris Burkard ventures to Chilean Patagonia with the Mavic Air on an assignment to uncover the region’s majestic wilderness from an aerial perspective.
dictionary_entries.translated: 1968 年，The North Face 创始人道格-汤普金斯（Doug Tompkins）和三位朋友在南美巴塔哥尼亚进行了一次传奇式的公路旅行。被巴塔哥尼亚的自然美景深深吸引，道格和妻子克里斯搬到了智利，并创建了汤普金斯保护组织。在过去的 25 年里，他们购买并开发了超过 1300 万英亩的受保护国家公园。秉承道格的遗志，世界著名户外摄影师克里斯-伯卡德（Chris Burkard）驾驶 Mavic Air 前往智利巴塔哥尼亚执行任务，从空中俯瞰该地区的壮丽荒原。.
让你的无人机独一无二

dictionary_entries.original: Why should your drone footage be the only thing that looks cool? Mavic Mini lets you express yourself, in the air, and even in your hand. The Mavic Mini DIY Creative Kit gives you everything you need to make your drone your own.
dictionary_entries.translated: 为什么只有您的无人机镜头看起来很酷？Mavic Mini 让您可以在空中，甚至在手中自由表达。Mavic Mini DIY 创意套装为您提供了一切，助您打造独一无二的无人机。.

dictionary_entries.original: Oh boy, another complex instructional video with a long list of things you’ll probably forget. There’s no avoiding it right? Wrong. With Mavic Mini, smart features like Flight Tutorial and a simplified app let you skip the headaches and fly with confidence.
dictionary_entries.translated: 哎呀，又是一个复杂的指导视频，还有一长串你很可能会忘记的事情。这是不可避免的，对吧？错了。有了 Mavic Mini，智能功能，如飞行教程和简化的应用程序，可以让你跳过麻烦，充满信心地飞行。.

dictionary_entries.original: Ah, the never-ending quest for the perfect selfie. Can it ever be achieved? Is it even possible? Who knows, but thanks to Mavic Mini’s easy-to-use interface and the DJI Fly app’s breezy editor, you can get pretty darn close.
dictionary_entries.translated: 啊，永无止境的完美自拍追求。能够实现吗？有可能吗？谁知道呢，但多亏了 Mavic Mini 易于使用的界面和 DJI Fly 应用程序的流畅编辑器，你可以非常接近了。.

dictionary_entries.original: This short documentary film tells the breathtaking story of a young Tibetan nomad and her epic seasonal journey across the mountains of Amdo Region, Tibet.
dictionary_entries.translated: 这部短片纪录片讲述了一位年轻的藏族游牧女孩，她穿越安多地区高山的史诗般的季节性旅程，故事扣人心弦。.

dictionary_entries.original: Branded documentary for drone manufacturer DJI, featuring VFX artist Rufus Blackwell.
dictionary_entries.translated: 为无人机制造商大疆创新拍摄的品牌纪录片，特效艺术家 Rufus Blackwell 担任主角。.

dictionary_entries.original: When Rufus Blackwell looked at his career as a VFX artist in the UK, he saw untapped potential just waiting for an opportunity. After relocating to Vietnam, his profession and passion came together in the form of timelapse photography. Using the Osmo and Inspire 2, adding his VFX skills, and bending the nature of time, Blackwell created award-winning videos of unimaginable scale and beauty.
dictionary_entries.translated: 当鲁弗斯·布莱克韦尔（Rufus Blackwell）回顾他在英国的视觉特效艺术家职业生涯时，他看到了等待机遇的未被充分利用的潜力。搬到越南后，他的职业和热情以延时摄影的形式结合在了一起。布莱克韦尔利用Osmo和Inspire 2，结合他的视觉特效技能，并扭曲时间，创作出了规模宏大、美轮美奂的获奖视频。.

dictionary_entries.original: ZHIYUN brings you a revolutionary new gimbal, CRANE 3S, which introduces a modular design, greater payload capacity and cross-compatibility with camera support systems to meet the demands of professional filmmakers. Check out the video, and let's find out what other possibilities does CRANE 3S have!
dictionary_entries.translated: 智云为您带来革命性新型稳定器——CRANE 3S，它采用了模块化设计，具有更大的负载能力，并支持跨设备兼容相机支撑系统，以满足专业电影制作人的需求。快来看看视频，了解CRANE 3S还有哪些其他可能！

dictionary_entries.original: Our society and Earth itself are meeting new challenges in preserving our environment for future generations while sustaining a growing global population. The key to combining greater agricultural yields with sustainable farming practices is efficiency. Through the use of Precision Agriculture methods based on aerial systems like the DJI Matrice 100 paired with the Zenmuse XT thermal camera, crop health can easily be monitored and output increased while reducing inputs.
dictionary_entries.translated: 我们的社会和地球本身正面临着新的挑战：在养育日益增长的全球人口的同时，为子孙后代保护我们的环境。将更高的农业产量与可持续耕作方法相结合的关键在于效率。通过使用诸如大疆Matrice 100等航空系统配合Zenmuse XT热成像相机实现的精准农业方法，可以轻松监测作物健康状况，提高产量，同时减少投入。.

dictionary_entries.original: The Matrice 200 Series unlocks the full potential of commercial drones for enterprise users who demand reliability, accuracy and efficiency. Built with an innovative aircraft design, the M200 is both rugged and versatile, making it the perfect tool for inspection, search and rescue, construction, mapping and more.
dictionary_entries.translated: Matrice 200 系列为要求可靠性、精度和效率的企业用户释放了商用无人机的全部潜力。M200 采用创新的飞机设计，坚固耐用且用途广泛，是检查、搜索救援、建筑、测绘等应用的理想工具。.

dictionary_entries.original: Commercial spot for HONOR, Huawei’s smartphone brand featuring Magic 2 voice control technology.
dictionary_entries.translated: 华为智能手机品牌 HONOR 的广告片，采用 Magic 2 语音控制技术。.
史蒂夫·杜，本杰明·维拉塔斯派桑

dictionary_entries.original: Commercial spot for HONOR, Huawei's smartphone brand featuring Magic 2 voice control technology.
dictionary_entries.translated: 华为智能手机品牌 HONOR 的广告片，采用 Magic 2 语音控制技术。.

dictionary_entries.original: Shark attacks and rip currents have been an on going danger for surfers and swimmers in the beaches of Australia. Surf lifesaving and patrol teams have begun to utilize DJI’s Phantom 4 drones to more effectively perform rescues and surveillance. In this way, priorities of safety as well as maintaining harmony within the eco-system can both be addressed.
dictionary_entries.translated: 鲨鱼袭击和离岸流一直是澳大利亚海滩冲浪者和游泳者的持续危险。冲浪救生和巡逻队开始利用大疆的 Phantom 4 无人机来更有效地进行救援和监视。通过这种方式，可以同时解决安全优先事项和维持生态系统和谐的问题。.
钢铁侠版 组装完成

dictionary_entries.original: Tello Iron Man Edition is the result of a collaboration between Marvel, Ryze Tech, and DJI. An immersive app, 5MP photos, and intelligent flight functions such as Throw & Go make Tello Iron Man Edition the perfect choice for learning how to fly. With a flashy shell inspired by Iron Man’s classic suit, this fun mini drone allows you to explore the world of the Avengers and save the day!
dictionary_entries.translated: Tello Iron Man 版是漫威、大疆创新和 Ryze Tech 合作的产物。沉浸式应用程序、500 万像素照片以及“抛飞起飞”等智能飞行功能，使 Tello Iron Man 版成为学习飞行的理想选择。这款迷你无人机外壳采用经典的钢铁侠战衣设计，炫酷有趣，让你探索漫威宇宙，拯救世界！

dictionary_entries.original: Welcome to Earth. Our little corner of the universe here is filled with endless beauty and limitless landscapes for those with enough curiosity to explore it. Though we may fail, we try again, all in the name of adventure, carving our paths through time and space, as we reach into the future. Shot using a Mavic 2.
dictionary_entries.translated: 欢迎来到地球。我们宇宙中的这个小小角落，为那些拥有足够好奇心去探索的人们，充满了无尽的美景和无限的风景。尽管我们会失败，但我们仍会重试，这一切都是为了冒险，我们在时间与空间中开辟道路，同时探索未来。这是用 Mavic 2 拍摄的。.

dictionary_entries.original: Work, free time, indoor, outdoor, emergencies... It's for all of your needs! Power any device, ultra fast recharge, monitor remotely... With double, quadruple or even limitless power expansion, RIVER 600 Max & RIVER 600 Pro have you covered.
dictionary_entries.translated: 工作、休闲、室内、室外、紧急情况……满足您的所有需求！为任何设备供电，超快充电，远程监控……通过双倍、四倍甚至无限动力扩展，RIVER 600 Max & RIVER 600 Pro 都能满足您。.

dictionary_entries.original: The perfect way of capturing Hong Kong’s moveable feasts is here with the DJI Osmo Mobile. Transform your phone into a smart motion camera to get buttery smooth video of anything from streetfood to three star restaurants. Set it up with ActiveTrack to capture your own home cooking sessions, and easily share with the world, directly from DJI GO.
dictionary_entries.translated: DJI Osmo Mobile 为您捕捉香港街头美食和三星餐厅美食的最佳方式。将您的手机变成智能运动相机，拍摄出流畅稳定的街头小吃到三星餐厅美食的视频。通过 ActiveTrack 固定跟踪，捕捉您自家的烹饪时刻，并通过 DJI GO 直接与世界分享。.

dictionary_entries.original: The new DJI Matrice 600 is a heavy-lifting platform that gives you the freedom to use the best camera equipment available to shoot from the sky. Capable of extended flight times and featuring built-in and add-on redundancies for maximum reliability, the M600 is the ideal aerial system for professional filmmaking.
dictionary_entries.translated: 新款 DJI Matrice 600 是一款重型飞行平台，让您可以自由地使用最先进的相机设备从空中进行拍摄。M600 具备超长续航能力，并内置和可选配冗余系统以实现最高可靠性，是专业电影制作的理想航空系统。.

dictionary_entries.original: The DJI Zenmuse X5 Series marks the next evolution of aerial camera technology. The Zenmuse X5 and Zenmuse X5R are designed to work seamlessly with the DJI Inspire 1, so that you’re ready to fly and capture professional-level footage in seconds. The large Micro Four Thirds sensor in the Zenmuse X5 Series cameras captures incredibly detailed 16 megapixel photos and 4K video. The Zenmuse X5R also records lossless 4K video in CinemaDNG RAW format and comes with a 512GB mini-SSD drive for media storage.
dictionary_entries.translated: DJI Zenmuse X5 系列是航空摄影摄像技术的新一次飞跃。Zenmuse X5 和 Zenmuse X5R 专为 DJI Inspire 1 设计，可无缝配合，让您瞬间准备就绪，捕捉专业级影像。Zenmuse X5 系列.

dictionary_entries.original: Branded documentary for drone manufacturer DJI, featuring renowned drone operator Ferdinand Wolf.
dictionary_entries.translated: 无人机制造商大疆创新（DJI）的品牌纪录片，讲述著名无人机操作员费迪南德-沃尔夫（Ferdinand Wolf）的故事。.

dictionary_entries.original: Growing up, Ferdinand Wolf always had a passion for remote controlled vehicles. After finding success in the professional world, he decided to dedicate himself to his passion for photography and filmmaking. By combining this with his skill as an RC pilot he was able to quickly create one of Europe's top UAV film making teams. The next step in his journey led him to join DJI, making him part of creating the technology that changed his life, empowering him to change the lives of others.
dictionary_entries.translated: 费迪南德·沃尔夫（Ferdinand Wolf）从小就对遥控车辆充满热情。在事业上取得成功后，他决定投身于他对摄影和电影制作的热情。结合他作为遥控飞机飞行员的技能，他迅速组建了一支欧洲顶尖的无人机电影制作团队。他职业生涯的下一步是加入大疆，参与创造改变了他生活的技术，并使他能够改变他人的生活。.

dictionary_entries.original: For the most experienced cinematographers in the film industry, control over the shot is what defines a professional. DJI Master Wheels are an advanced wheel controller that gives artists the finest accuracy and precision in every gimbal movement.
dictionary_entries.translated: 对于电影行业经验最丰富的摄影师来说，对镜头画面的掌控是专业性的体现。DJI 映画轮是一款先进的轮式控制器，为艺术家在每一次云台运动中提供了极致的精准度和精确性。.

dictionary_entries.original: Street artist Astro adds color and life in neighborhoods where both are in short supply. Travel with him to Portugal where he uses a DJI Mavic to help him create one of his largest and most compelling works of art.
dictionary_entries.translated: 街头艺术家 Astro 在缺少色彩和生机的街区为那里增添色彩和活力。与他一同前往葡萄牙，他将使用 DJI Mavic 帮助他创作出他最大、最引人注目的艺术作品之一。.

dictionary_entries.original: This briefing form helps us gather important information about your brand, products/services and upcoming video campaign. Understanding your vision for this project means everything to us so please provide as many details as possible. The more we know, the faster we’ll be able to kickoff the creative process and provide you with an accurate budget estimate.
dictionary_entries.translated: 清楚了解你们项目的愿景是非常的重要。这个问卷可以收集有关您的品牌、产品/服务和即将开展的视频活动的重要信息。因此请尽量提供详细资料。我们就可以启动创意流程，为您提供准确的预算估算。

dictionary_entries.original: If you’re unsure about any fields, feel free to leave them blank and we’ll offer our suggestions.
dictionary_entries.translated: 如果你有什么不确定的地方，你可以把它留空，我们会提供适合你的建议。

dictionary_entries.original: What are the primary goals of your video campaign?
What's the key message that you want to communicate to viewers?
dictionary_entries.translated: 想给观看者传达什么的关键信息？

dictionary_entries.original: What's your desired runtime for the video? For most cases, we recommend 90 seconds or less.
dictionary_entries.translated: 你们需要的视频长度？ 大部分的情况下，我们都会建议90秒或以內的。

dictionary_entries.original: Who's the target audience of your video?
Try to take us inside the minds of your viewers... Why will they care about the video? What value will it offer them?
dictionary_entries.translated: 试着把我们带进观众的脑海...他们为什么要关心这个视频？ 这个视频会给他们带来什么价值？

dictionary_entries.original: Please describe the mood and style of the video. What emotions do you wish to evoke in your audience?
dictionary_entries.translated: 请描述视频带出来的情绪和风格。你想唤起观众什么情绪？

dictionary_entries.original: Are there any important themes, buzzwords or campaign slogans that we should focus on as we develop a concept? Anything we should explicitly avoid?
dictionary_entries.translated: 在开发概念时，有没有相关重要的主题、流行语或推广口号我们需要知道的？ 有没有什么东西我们是需要避免？

dictionary_entries.original: Can you give us a few references that are similar in style to the video you're imagining? Either from our own portfolio or other videos that you found online. Please provide comma-separated links.
dictionary_entries.translated: 请提供一些与你想象中风格相似的视频作为参考。可以是你们公司本身的视频或者是你在网上找到一些其他的参考。

dictionary_entries.original: What's your budget range for this campaign?
How will this video be released and displayed? (i.e. broadcast, YouTube, website, storefront displays, trade shows, etc.)
dictionary_entries.translated: 此视频将如何发布和显示？（电视广播、YouTube、网站、店面展示、展会等）

dictionary_entries.original: In which countries/regions will the video be shared?
dictionary_entries.translated: 视频将在哪些国家/地区使用？

dictionary_entries.original: When do you need the final video to be delivered? Is this deadline fixed or flexible?
dictionary_entries.translated: 视频的交付日期。这个是确实的日期，还是有弹性的？

dictionary_entries.original: Is the release of the video tied to any important events or holidays?
dictionary_entries.translated: 视频的发布是否与任何重点的推广或假期相关？

dictionary_entries.original: Briefly describe your brand and the services that your company provides.
dictionary_entries.translated: 请简要描述品牌和提供的服务

dictionary_entries.original: Can you summarize your company's mission statement? What are your brand's core values that we should consider when developing a concept and style?
dictionary_entries.translated: 请总结一下贵公司的使命宣言。在开发概念和风格时，我们应该要考虑到品牌那些核心价值观？

dictionary_entries.original: What are some of the keywords you would associate with your brand?
dictionary_entries.translated: 贵公司会联想到与品牌相关的关键字

dictionary_entries.original: What are the key features of your product that you wish to highlight in the video?
dictionary_entries.translated: 希望在视频中突出产品的哪些主要功能？

dictionary_entries.original: What are the pain points of your target market that the product aims to address? How will your product solve them?
dictionary_entries.translated: 产品能够解决的目标市场的哪些痛点？产品将如何解决它们？

dictionary_entries.original: What separates your product from those of your competitors? What makes it unique within your industry?
dictionary_entries.translated: 您的产品与竞争对手的产品有何不同？是什么让它在行业内独一无二？

dictionary_entries.original: Aside from the main video(s), is there any other content you need to produce for this campaign? (i.e. cut-downs for social media or explainer videos)
dictionary_entries.translated: 除了主视频之外，还需要为活动制作其他内容吗？（即社交媒体或解释视频的剪辑）

dictionary_entries.original: Considering your plans for online promotion, will you need the dimensions of any videos to be resized for certain social media platforms?
dictionary_entries.translated: 考虑到您的线上推广计划，您是否需要为某些社交媒体平台调整任何视频的尺寸？

dictionary_entries.original: Vantage Pictures also offers professional photography services. Do you foresee any need for product/lifestyle photos to be shot alongside the video? If so, please outline your requirements.
dictionary_entries.translated: Vantage Pictures 也提供专业的摄影服务。您是否预见到在视频以外也需要拍摄主视觉或产品照片？如果有的话，请概述您的要求。

dictionary_entries.original: Anything else you'd like to add? Feel free to leave comments or questions here and we'll get back to you right away!
dictionary_entries.translated: 如果你有其他的资料或是问题，欢迎你在这里留言。我们会尽快回复你。

dictionary_entries.original: If you have any other materials you'd like to share, please attach them here. Official briefs, company decks and product slideshows are always helpful!
dictionary_entries.translated: 如果您有其他资料可以分享，请把文件上载到这里。文件可以是发布活动资料、公司介绍，或者是产品资料。这些都对我们的创作很有帮助的。

dictionary_entries.original: Cuộc sống là những ngã rẽ mà mỗi lựa chọn lại đưa ta đến một hành trình thật khác. Hoà mình vào đám đông hay hết mình trong từng khoảnh khắc? Những đại diện của thế hệ why not đã không ngần ngại chọn đáp án cho riêng mình. Và nhiều câu chuyện rực màu khác mà Techcombank đã cùng với Thùy Tiên đi tìm và lưu lại trong thước phim này. Để lần tới, khi những người xung quanh hay chính bản thân bạn hoài nghi: Tại sao làm khác? Tại sao khám phá? Tại sao chẳng giống ai? Tại sao phiêu lưu, chọn con đường chưa biết? Bạn có thể đơn giản trả lời: WHY NOT?
dictionary_entries.translated: 生活是各种岔路口，每一次选择都将我们带向截然不同的旅程。是融入人群，还是全身心投入每一个瞬间？Why not一代的代表们毫不犹豫地选择了自己的答案。还有许多色彩斑斓的故事，是Techcombank与Thùy Tiên一起在这部电影中寻找并记录下来的。这样，下次当身边的人或你自己质疑：为什么要做得不一样？为什么要去探索？为什么要与众不同？为什么要去冒险，走一条未知的道路？你就可以简单地回答：WHY NOT？

dictionary_entries.original: Nan Hauser, world-renowned American marine biologist based on Rarotonga and Director of the Cook Islands Whale & Wildlife Center, has spent 25 years studying whales in order to be able to better protect them. Always at the forefront of her industry, she’s now adopted the DJI Phantom 3 because of its ability to let her and her team easily and quickly survey whales without scaring them away.
dictionary_entries.translated: 南·豪瑟（Nan Hauser）是一位世界知名的美国海洋生物学家，常驻拉罗汤加岛，并且是库克群岛鲸鱼与野生动物中心的主任。她花了25年时间研究鲸鱼，以便更好地保护它们。作为行业的先驱，她现在采用了大疆“御”3无人机（DJI Phantom 3），因为它能够让她的团队轻松快速地调查鲸鱼，而不会惊吓到它们。.

dictionary_entries.original: A new generation of smart mobile power is here. EcoFlow Tech's first product, RIVER, is a portable battery with 412W output, 11 charger ports, flow-through charging, and a shelf life of 1 year. RIVER can be re-charged through car, wall, and solar chargers.

dictionary_entries.original: DJI was invited to visit Chernobyl with filmmaker Philip Grossman, who is making a documentary named ‘Half-Lives’. This documentary is part of a five-year personal project that Philip has been working on about the area surrounding the Chernobyl nuclear power plant, where in the early hours of 26 April 1986, one of four nuclear reactors exploded creating a 30km radius zone now known as the “The Zone”. Philip used the DJI Ronin, Phantom 3 Professional, & Inspire 1 to capture his images.
dictionary_entries.translated: 大疆创新受邀与电影制片人菲利普-格罗斯曼（Philip Grossman）一同探访切尔诺贝利。1986年4月26日凌晨，切尔诺贝利核电站四座核反应堆中的一座发生爆炸，造成方圆30公里的区域被称为 ‘核区’。菲利普使用大疆 Ronin、Phantom 3 Professional 和 Inspire 1 拍摄了照片。.

dictionary_entries.original: With the recent explosion of generative AI, authenticity in visual content has all but deteriorated into nonexistence. Instagram filters, beautify apps, generative fill, text-to-image artwork… you can hardly browse a feed without scrolling past some deformed figure with perfect skin and thirty-eight fingers.
dictionary_entries.translated: 最近，随着人工智能生成技术的蓬勃发展，视觉内容的真实性已荡然无存。Instagram滤镜、美化应用、生成填充、文本到图像的艺术创作......在浏览新闻时，你很难不滚动经过一些拥有完美皮肤和38根手指的变形人物。.

dictionary_entries.original: The AI revolution is inescapable and for many of us, especially in advertising, that’s all well and good. But last year, Samsung learned the hard way that we can’t just slap generative imaging into any application without public backlash… Since 2020, Samsung has touted the “Space Zoom” feature of its Galaxy cameras with incredibly detailed photos of the moon. After a few clever users debunked their claims of authenticity, Samsung was slammed by The Verge for misleading people when, in fact, the phones were utilizing AI to produce details that were never there in the first place.
dictionary_entries.translated: 人工智能革命不可避免，对我们中的许多人来说，尤其是在广告业，这一切都很好。但去年，三星公司惨痛地认识到，我们不能在任何应用中加入生成式成像技术而不引起公众反感......自 2020 年以来，三星公司一直在利用其 Galaxy 相机的 “太空变焦 ”功能和令人难以置信的月球细节照片进行宣传。在一些聪明的用户揭穿其真实性之后，三星遭到 The Verge 的抨击，称其误导了人们，而事实上，这些手机是利用人工智能生成了原本不存在的细节。.

dictionary_entries.original: So it seems brands will need to tread carefully as they continue to weave machine learning into the fabric of their products. Photographers, especially those with a passion for the natural world, take the authenticity of their work very seriously.
dictionary_entries.translated: 因此，在继续将机器学习融入产品结构时，品牌似乎需要谨慎行事。摄影师，尤其是那些对自然世界充满热情的摄影师，非常重视作品的真实性。.

dictionary_entries.original: In the wake of Samsung’s fake moon fiasco, Chinese smartphone manufacturer OnePlus seized the opportunity to showcase the capabilities of its latest OnePlus 12 camera in a genuine #RealMoon campaign. Sporting 3x optical zoom and a 64MP sensor that enables up to 120x digital zoom with incredible detail retention, its new Hasselblad camera is a powerhouse for telephoto imaging.
dictionary_entries.translated: 在三星假月亮事件之后，中国智能手机制造商一加（OnePlus）抓住机会，在一场名副其实的 #RealMoon 活动中展示了其最新 OnePlus 12 相机的功能。新款哈苏相机拥有 3 倍光学变焦和 6400 万像素传感器，可实现高达 120 倍的数字变焦，并能保留令人难以置信的细节，是远摄成像的强力工具。.

dictionary_entries.original: Global production house Vantage Pictures teamed up with wilderness landscape photographer Joshua Cripps to produce a series of moon photos that would dazzle viewers with impressive detail never before seen from a smartphone camera—a brave endeavor on OnePlus’s part, no doubt. Cripps was free to make colour, contrast and exposure adjustments in Lightroom but under no circumstances could the images be composited or manipulated in Photoshop.
dictionary_entries.translated: 全球制作公司 Vantage Pictures 与荒野风光摄影师 Joshua Cripps 合作，拍摄了一系列月球照片，这些照片的细节让观众目不暇接，这是智能手机相机从未有过的，毫无疑问，这是 OnePlus 勇敢的尝试。Cripps 可以在 Lightroom 中自由调整色彩、对比度和曝光，但在任何情况下都不能在 Photoshop 中对图片进行合成或处理。.
天体摄影的细致准备工作

dictionary_entries.original: In honor of the tedious process required to capture unaltered lunar imagery, the team at Vantage Pictures proposed a longer-form behind the scenes documentary in addition to the 30-second spot. Executive Producer James Duong said, “We felt a single hero spot wouldn’t be enough to convey the core messaging. Because it wasn’t just about showcasing the end result of the camera specs. We wanted to celebrate the enormous workload that astrophotography demands, which is so easily undermined by digital manipulation.”
dictionary_entries.translated: 为了纪念捕捉未经改动的月球图像所需的繁琐过程，Vantage Pictures 团队提议在 30 秒的广告片之外，再制作一部较长的幕后纪录片。执行制片人 James Duong 说：“我们认为一个单一的英雄广告不足以传达核心信息。因为这不仅仅是展示相机规格的最终结果。我们希望颂扬天体摄影所要求的巨大工作量，而这种工作量很容易被数字处理所破坏”。”

dictionary_entries.original: Cripps and the production crew spent over three months testing prototypes, battling weather during short full moon intervals. OnePlus also wanted to include a human element, so the moon alone was not enough. Positioning a climber in front of the moon is no easy feat… Weeks of scouting, tracking lunar phases, calculating distance between subject and camera for various focal lengths—all of which needs to align at a precise moment so the sun illuminates the landscape without overexposing the sky. Not to mention the scant 20-minute window where the moon is low enough to remain in frame.
dictionary_entries.translated: 克里普斯和制作团队花了三个多月的时间测试原型，在短暂的满月期间与天气作斗争。OnePlus 还希望加入人类元素，因此仅有月亮是不够的。将登山者安置在月亮前并不是一件容易的事......需要数周的侦查、跟踪月相、计算拍摄对象与摄像机之间的距离以适应不同的焦距--所有这些都需要在一个精确的时刻对准，这样太阳才能照亮风景，同时又不会让天空曝光过度。更不用说还有 20 分钟的短暂空档，在这段时间里，月亮的位置足够低，可以保持在画面中。.

dictionary_entries.original: The end result is a striking hero spot that blends anamorphic footage of Cripps in the field with enigmatic CG renders of particles coalescing into features of the moon. Shot in the Alabama Hills of eastern California, jagged granite spires produce an otherworldly look that beautifully supports the campaign’s extra-terrestrial theme.
dictionary_entries.translated: 最终的效果是将克里普斯在现场的变形镜头与粒子凝聚成月球特征的神秘 CG 渲染效果融合在一起，形成了一个引人注目的英雄广告片。在加利福尼亚东部的阿拉巴马山拍摄时，锯齿状的花岗岩尖顶产生了一种超凡脱俗的感觉，完美地烘托了广告的地外主题。.

dictionary_entries.original: Director Zacharia Lorenz said, “I was sweating bullets just days out from shooting. We were still wrestling with prototype bugs and deliberating locations, trying to piece together some semblance of a story that was unfolding into a logistical nightmare. But as soon as Josh took us out for a pre-scout, all the stars aligned. I was blown away by the location, our crew was small but nimble, and the obstacles we had to overcome really paved the way for a potent behind the scenes story. It was the kind of experience that reminds you to trust the process and find solace in the struggle.”
dictionary_entries.translated: 导演 Zacharia Lorenz 说：“在距离拍摄还有几天的时候，我已经汗流浃背了。我们还在与原型错误搏斗，斟酌拍摄地点，试图拼凑出一个故事的雏形，而这个故事的展开却成了一场后勤噩梦。但当乔希带我们去进行前期勘察时，所有的星星都对准了我们。拍摄地点让我大开眼界，我们的摄制组小而灵活，而我们必须克服的障碍也为一个精彩的幕后故事铺平了道路。这种经历提醒你要相信过程，在奋斗中寻找慰藉”。”

dictionary_entries.original: Leading global cryptocurrency exchange and web3 company, Bitget has partnered with Vantage Pictures, a leading film production company to launch the new “Trade Smarter” marketing campaign. Filmed in Bangkok, the four films—invite viewers into humorous scenarios where clever thinking transforms the ordinary into the extraordinary. Directed by Paul Moore, the campaign departs from the typical high-stakes tone of financial ads, infusing a touch of joy and relatability into trading.
dictionary_entries.translated: 全球领先的加密货币交易所和网络3公司Bitget与领先的电影制作公司Vantage Pictures合作，推出全新的 “更聪明地交易 ”营销活动。这四部电影在曼谷拍摄，邀请观众进入幽默的场景，通过巧妙的思维将平凡变为非凡。该活动由 Paul Moore 执导，一改金融广告中典型的高风险基调，为交易注入了一丝欢乐和亲和力。.

dictionary_entries.original: Roborock, the design manufacturer behind its highly-rated robot vacuum cleaner S6 MaxV, has partnered with Vantage Pictures on a series of short videos showcasing its latest cordless vacuum product.
dictionary_entries.translated: Roborock 是备受好评的机器人真空吸尘器 S6 MaxV 的设计制造商，它与 Vantage Pictures 合作制作了一系列短片，展示其最新的无绳真空吸尘器产品。.

dictionary_entries.original: Produced to exhibit the new Roborock H7 cordless vacuum, the collection of six 15 second clips make vacuuming fun and amusing, emphasising the common cleaning issues we all face while explaining complex technological features with comedy.
dictionary_entries.translated: 为展示新款 Roborock H7 无绳真空吸尘器而制作的 6 个 15 秒短片集让吸尘变得有趣而好玩，强调了我们共同面临的清洁问题，同时用喜剧的方式解释了复杂的技术功能。.

dictionary_entries.original: “From the start we knew that creating an ad for this product would be a challenge because vacuum cleaner is a well-known category with little new to say,” said Andy Knight, global head of brand at Roborock. “To get around this we knew we had to take a different tact and create something that would entertain people rather than force specs on them as is the norm.”
dictionary_entries.translated: “从一开始，我们就知道为这款产品创作广告将是一个挑战，因为吸尘器是一个众所周知的类别，没有什么新意可言，”Roborock 公司全球品牌负责人 Andy Knight 说。“为了解决这个问题，我们知道我们必须采取不同的策略，创造出能够娱乐人们的东西，而不是像通常那样把规格强加给他们。”

dictionary_entries.original: A Fresh Twist on a Household Staple
The Roborock H7 cordless vacuum is a one-of-a-kind product leveraging advanced technology — and it features in a series of short videos made by Vantage Pictures that are just as unique.
dictionary_entries.translated: Roborock H7 无绳真空吸尘器是一款独一无二的产品，它采用了先进的技术--Vantage Pictures 制作的一系列视频短片中也有它的身影。.

dictionary_entries.original: “Our social media channels heavily emphasise humour and human connection, and we consistently receive stronger engagement on posts that aim more to entertain than to sell,” said Noad Auckburally, social media manager at Roborock. “With that in mind, we decided to go in the same direction for our commercials with the help of Vantage Pictures. Entertain first, educate second.”
dictionary_entries.translated: “Roborock 社交媒体经理 Noad Auckburally 说：”我们的社交媒体渠道非常强调幽默和人与人之间的联系，以娱乐而非销售为目的的帖子总是能获得更高的参与度。“考虑到这一点，我们决定在 Vantage Pictures 的帮助下，在我们的广告中也采用同样的方式。娱乐第一，教育第二。”

dictionary_entries.original: The production company has enabled Roborock’s H7 vacuum to stand out in an intensely competitive market by highlighting key features in a direct and easily digestible way across six short videos, which were shot remotely over two days in Cape Town, South Africa
dictionary_entries.translated: 该制作公司在南非开普敦用两天时间远程拍摄了六段视频短片，以直接易懂的方式突出了 Roborock H7 真空吸尘器的主要功能，使其在竞争激烈的市场中脱颖而出。

dictionary_entries.original: To convey the product’s lightweight yet powerful nature, Vantage Pictures filmed a short martial arts duel between masked assailants and a vacuum user, while use cases like cleaning animal fur are made equally compelling with chase scenes between a man masquerading as a dog and a vacuum-wielding homeowner.
dictionary_entries.translated: 为了传达该产品轻便而强大的特性，Vantage Pictures 拍摄了一段蒙面袭击者与真空吸尘器用户之间的武术对决短片，而在清洁动物皮毛等使用案例中，伪装成狗的人与挥舞着真空吸尘器的房主之间的追逐场面同样引人注目。.
复杂的技术，简单的信息传递

dictionary_entries.original: To highlight the powerful tech behind Roborock H7 vacuum, the production company relied on humour and exaggeration.
dictionary_entries.translated: 为了突出 Roborock H7 真空吸尘器背后的强大技术，制作公司采用了幽默和夸张的手法。.

dictionary_entries.original: “The challenge was to take everyday chores, like cleaning your house, and give it a surreal twist. Projects that like this are always fun as they challenge us creatively and allow us to play around with the possibilities of commercial filmmaking,” director Alexis Odiowei noted.
dictionary_entries.translated: “我们面临的挑战是将日常琐事，比如打扫房间，赋予超现实的色彩。导演 Alexis Odiowei 指出：”这样的项目总是很有趣，因为它们对我们提出了创造性的挑战，让我们能够发挥商业电影制作的可能性。.

dictionary_entries.original: For instance, the vacuum’s 90-minute battery life is explained with a car race-themed competition between a couple, complete with graphics for every “round” and a timer counting down the seconds.
dictionary_entries.translated: 例如，这款真空吸尘器的 90 分钟电池续航时间是通过一对情侣之间以赛车为主题的比赛来解释的，每 “一轮 ”都有相应的图案，还有一个计时器在倒计时。.

dictionary_entries.original: By the same token, magnetism can be a dry subject but Vantage Pictures makes the product’s magnetic storage capabilities exciting in a quirky scene featuring a man covered in metallic objects.
dictionary_entries.translated: 同样，磁性可能是一个枯燥的话题，但 Vantage Pictures 通过一个满身金属物品的人的奇特场景，使产品的磁性存储功能令人兴奋。.

dictionary_entries.original: realme 13+ 5G Blurs the Line Between Reality and Gaming in Immersive Ad - Vantage Pictures
dictionary_entries.translated: realme 13+ 5G 沉浸式广告模糊了现实与游戏之间的界限 - Vantage Pictures

dictionary_entries.original: Directed by Paul Moore, the film blends the intensity of gaming with the feel of a real-world environment. The atmosphere is designed to be immersive and fast-paced, capturing the attention of viewers with its energetic and engaging scenes. The aim was to create a viewing experience that resonates with the gaming community, highlighting the powerful performance capabilities of the realme 13+ 5G.
dictionary_entries.translated: 影片由 Paul Moore 执导，融合了游戏的紧张刺激和真实世界的环境感。影片的氛围设计让人身临其境，节奏明快，以充满活力和引人入胜的场景吸引观众的注意力。其目的是创造一种与游戏社区产生共鸣的观看体验，突出 realme 13+ 5G 的强大性能。.

dictionary_entries.original: “Building a piece of New York City in our studio was a challenging yet rewarding process,” said James Duong, executive producer at Vantage Pictures. “Our goal was to create an experience that gamers everywhere could connect with. The combination of a New York setting and our local expertise made this project unique.”
dictionary_entries.translated: “Vantage Pictures 的执行制片人 James Duong 说：”在我们的工作室中建造一片纽约市是一个充满挑战但又收获颇丰的过程。“我们的目标是创造一种各地游戏玩家都能接受的体验。纽约的背景与我们在当地的专业知识相结合，使这个项目变得独一无二”。”

dictionary_entries.original: The commercial showcases Vantage Pictures’ ability to merge global concepts with local production. By shooting entirely in-studio, the team was able to maintain control over every detail, ensuring the final product met the high standards expected of a global brand launch.
dictionary_entries.translated: 该广告展示了 Vantage Pictures 将全球概念与本地制作相结合的能力。通过完全在摄影棚内进行拍摄，团队能够保持对每个细节的控制，确保最终产品符合全球品牌发布的高标准要求。.

dictionary_entries.original: ECD at Byron McKenzie Kiefer McKenzie says: “Rather than just seeing upgrading as a chore to improve hardware, the campaign aims to get key decision makers to see it as an opportunity to improve everything. It’s a way for ASUS Business to begin a conversation with their potential customers and to get them to redefine what ‘upgrading’ can mean to their business.”
dictionary_entries.translated: Byron McKenzie 的 ECD Kiefer McKenzie 说：“这次活动的目的是让关键决策者将升级视为改善一切的机会，而不是仅仅将升级视为改善硬件的苦差事。这是华硕商用与潜在客户展开对话的一种方式，让他们重新定义'升级'对企业的意义‘。’

dictionary_entries.original: Tommy Tai, ASUS commercial PC global campaign director says: “Sharing our brand vision is ever more critical as modern technology plays a profound role for companies to not only achieve growth but enable them to break through. With BM and Vantage’s partnership, we were able to deliver that vision through compelling, meaningful, and human stories.”
dictionary_entries.translated: 华硕商用个人电脑全球活动总监 Tommy Tai 说：“现代科技对企业发挥着深远的作用，不仅使其实现增长，还使其实现突破，因此，分享我们的品牌愿景变得越来越重要。在 BM 和 Vantage 的合作下，我们能够通过引人入胜、有意义和人性化的故事来传达我们的品牌愿景。”

dictionary_entries.original: VFX was handled by Bangkok based VFX house Bassugga Studio, who worked closely with the team to create a particularly complex CGI timelapse shot of a skyscraper being constructed.
dictionary_entries.translated: 视觉特效由曼谷的视觉特效公司 Bassugga Studio 负责，他们与团队密切合作，制作了一个特别复杂的摩天大楼建造过程的 CGI 延时镜头。.

dictionary_entries.original: Director Paul Moore added: “I love the epic scale of the films and the aspirational tone it brings. It’s a good day whenever we can tell a story for a technology brand that isn’t just about tech specs.”
dictionary_entries.translated: 导演 Paul Moore 补充说：“我喜欢电影史诗般的规模和它带来的令人向往的基调。每当我们能为一个科技品牌讲述一个不只是关于技术规格的故事时，都是美好的一天。”

dictionary_entries.original: The ‘Upgrade to Incredible’ campaign will be launched through various digital channels, including online video and social media.
dictionary_entries.translated: 升级到不可思议 ‘活动将通过各种数字渠道推出，包括在线视频和社交媒体。.

dictionary_entries.original: ASUS Education – Upgrading Education to Incredible
dictionary_entries.translated: 华硕教育 - 将教育升级至精彩

dictionary_entries.original: ASUS Business Lets You ‘Upgrade to Incredible’ in Campaign from Byron McKenzie
dictionary_entries.translated: Byron McKenzie 的华硕商务广告让您 ‘升级到不可思议’。

dictionary_entries.original: Leading technology brand ASUS Business has launched its latest campaign, 'Upgrade to Incredible'. The spots take the viewer on a journey across different business industries, exploring the incredible possibilities of growth when companies upgrade with ASUS.
dictionary_entries.translated: 领先的科技品牌华硕商用（ASUS Business）启动了其最新活动'升级，焕享非凡'（Upgrade to Incredible）。该活动带领观众穿越不同的商业行业，探索当企业通过华硕进行升级时，所能获得的令人难以置信的增长潜力。.

dictionary_entries.original: In this new commercial spot for the OnePlus Y-Series smart TV, we follow the journey of a young couple as they experience their first months living together.
dictionary_entries.translated: 在 OnePlus Y 系列智能电视的新广告片中，我们跟随一对年轻夫妇经历了他们共同生活的第一个月。.

dictionary_entries.original: Director Alexis Odiowei wanted to break away from the conventional feature-based format & explore a more meaningful narrative that resonates with our emotional side. Alexis explains his inspiration for the core concept: “I saw the TV almost as a window into this couple’s world. We see the good, the bad & everything in between. At home, our TVs are often the focal point of the living room. So, I thought, why not switch things up and see these character’s lives from the TV’s perspective instead”.
dictionary_entries.translated: 导演 Alexis Odiowei 希望突破传统的故事片形式，探索一种更有意义的叙事方式，与我们的情感产生共鸣。亚历克西斯解释了核心概念的灵感来源：“我认为电视几乎就是这对夫妇世界的一扇窗。我们看到好的、坏的以及介于两者之间的一切。在家里，电视往往是客厅的焦点。因此，我想，为什么不换个角度，从电视的视角来观察这些人物的生活呢？.

dictionary_entries.original: Collaborating with OnePlus’ in-house marketing team, Vantage Pictures knew they had to develop something unique if they were going to capture the attention of consumers in a heavily saturated market dominated by big brands like LG, Samsung & Sony.
dictionary_entries.translated: Vantage Pictures 与 OnePlus 的内部营销团队合作，他们知道要想在 LG、三星和索尼等大品牌占据的严重饱和的市场中吸引消费者的注意，就必须开发出独一无二的产品。.

dictionary_entries.original: These little snapshots throughout the couple’s relationship felt like universal moments to which audiences of any cultural background could relate. However, focusing on such a ubiquitous story also came with its own challenges… The execution had to feel authentic & believable, as the subject matter is so familiar. The Vantage Pictures team carried out extensive casting in Cape Town, South Africa to find the perfect couple that would bring this story to life. The result was natural chemistry between the two lead characters that speaks for itself on screen.
dictionary_entries.translated: 这对夫妻关系中的这些小插曲，让任何文化背景的观众都能产生共鸣。然而，关注这样一个无处不在的故事也有其自身的挑战......由于主题是如此熟悉，执行起来必须真实可信。Vantage Pictures 团队在南非开普敦进行了广泛的选角工作，以找到能将这个故事娓娓道来的完美情侣。结果，两位主角之间自然而然地产生了化学反应，这在银幕上是不言而喻的。.

dictionary_entries.original: Director Alexis Odiowei opens a window into a couple's world. In this new commercial spot for the OnePlus Y-Series smart TV, we follow the journey of a young couple as they experience their first months living together.
dictionary_entries.translated: 导演Alexis Odiowei为我们打开了一扇通往一对情侣生活的窗口。在这支一加Y系列智能电视的全新广告中，我们跟随一对年轻情侣，共同见证他们同居初期的点点滴滴。.
越南生产服务 - Vantage Pictures

dictionary_entries.original: In this new branded documentary for OPPO, we follow the children of the Bagasal family as they recreate special photos from their childhood to give mom a unique gift for Mother’s Day.
dictionary_entries.translated: 在这部为 OPPO 拍摄的全新品牌纪录片中，我们将跟随 Bagasal 家族的孩子们重现童年时期的特别照片，为妈妈送上一份独特的母亲节礼物。.

dictionary_entries.original: Creative director Alexis Odiowei tapped into a social media trend that has been popularised over the past few years, recreating photos from our childhood in the present day.
dictionary_entries.translated: 创意总监 Alexis Odiowei 利用过去几年在社交媒体上流行的趋势，将我们童年时的照片重现于今日。.

dictionary_entries.original: On working with the Bagasal family, Alexis said: “It was important that we didn’t over produce or direct the family too much. Our approach was to simply give the family the mission and let them execute in a way that felt natural to them. To avoid doing multiple takes and breaking them out of their rhythm, we had two cameras rolling throughout. This allowed us to shoot long takes at different focal lengths, helping us maintain a natural flow throughout the day and avoid interrupting the whole process. The Bagasal family were so bubbly & fun and we felt the final film beautifully captured the real bond between mother and children.”
dictionary_entries.translated: 谈到与 Bagasal 一家的合作，亚历克西斯说：“重要的是，我们没有过多地制作或指导这个家庭。我们的做法是将任务简单地交给一家人，让他们以自然的方式完成任务。为了避免多次拍摄，打破他们的节奏，我们在整个拍摄过程中使用了两台摄像机。这样我们就可以用不同的焦距拍摄长镜头，帮助我们在整个拍摄过程中保持自然流畅，避免打断整个拍摄过程。巴加萨尔一家非常活泼有趣，我们觉得最终的影片很好地捕捉到了母亲和孩子之间真实的亲情”。”

dictionary_entries.original: Vantage Pictures on recreating mum's fondest memories with the OPPO Reno7 Pro for Mother’s Day 2022. Creative director Alexis Odiowei tapped into a social media trend that has been popularised over the past few years, recreating photos from our childhood in the present day.
dictionary_entries.translated: Vantage Pictures 携手 OPPO Reno7 Pro，在 2022 年母亲节重现妈妈最珍贵的回忆。创意总监 Alexis Odiowei 借势近年来在社交媒体上风靡的潮流，将我们童年的照片在当下重新演绎。.

dictionary_entries.original: realme Unveils Humorous and Chaotic Spot for New ‘Mishap Proof’ C75
dictionary_entries.translated: realme 推出幽默混乱的全新 C75『防意外』广告

dictionary_entries.original: Vantage Pictures’ latest campaign displays the integrity of the realme C75 smartphone through placing the phone in a variety of relatable yet unfortunate scenarios.
dictionary_entries.translated: Vantage Pictures 最新广告通过将 realme C75 智能手机置于各种贴近生活却充满意外的情境中，展现其坚固品质。

dictionary_entries.original: Bitget’s Humorous Human Moments Shake Up Crypto Trading
dictionary_entries.translated: Bitget 以幽默人性化瞬间颠覆加密交易

dictionary_entries.original: Vantage Pictures film director, Paul Boyer Moore, on infusing laughter into financial advertising and the joys of taking a work meeting from a jet ski.
dictionary_entries.translated: Vantage Pictures 导演 Paul Boyer Moore 谈如何为金融广告注入幽默，以及在水上摩托上开会的乐趣。

dictionary_entries.original: realme Unveils Humorous and Chaotic Spot for New ‘Mishap Proof’ C75
dictionary_entries.translated: realme 为新款 ‘防事故 ’C75 发布幽默而混乱的广告片

dictionary_entries.original: Vantage Pictures' latest campaign displays the integrity of the realme C75 smartphone through placing the phone in a variety of relatable yet unfortunate scenarios.
dictionary_entries.translated: Vantage Pictures 的最新广告通过将 realme C75 智能手机置于各种贴近生活却又不幸的场景中，展示了这款手机的完整性。.

dictionary_entries.original: realme Unveils Humorous and Chaotic Spot for New 'Mishap Proof' C75 - Vantage Pictures
dictionary_entries.translated: realme 为新款 '防事故 'C75 发布幽默而混乱的广告片 - Vantage Pictures

dictionary_entries.original: Life’s full of surprises, and sometimes they’re chaotic. That’s where realme’s C75 comes in: aimed at on the go blue-collar workers. The commercial highlights the phone’s worry free waterproof, drop-proof, batter-proof features through hilarious mishaps.
dictionary_entries.translated: 生活充满意外，有时也会变得一片混乱。这就是 realme C75 登场的时刻：专为忙碌的蓝领工人打造。这支广告通过一系列滑稽的意外场景，生动展现了手机的防水、防摔、防撞功能，让用户真正实现无忧使用。

dictionary_entries.original: Co-directed by Paul Moore and Zacharia Lorenz, they employed Phantom high-speed cameras and motion control rigs to capture the action. Slow-motion shots allowed them to showcase the character’s amusing reactions. “We put the C75 through the wringer! It handled anything from being run over by a motorbike to diving into boiling hotpot or spinning around in a washing machine!” said directors Paul Moore & Zacharia Lorenz.
dictionary_entries.translated: 该广告由 Paul Moore 和 Zacharia Lorenz 共同执导，他们使用 Phantom 高速摄像机和运动控制设备捕捉精彩瞬间。慢动作镜头不仅突出了角色的搞笑反应，也增强了视觉冲击力。“我们真的把 C75 彻底折腾了一遍！它经历了从被摩托车碾压、掉进滚烫的火锅，到在洗衣机里疯狂旋转的一切考验！” 导演 Paul Moore 和 Zacharia Lorenz 如是说道。

dictionary_entries.original: The campaign, shot in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, by Vantage Pictures, was a cost-effective solution for the numerous locations required to tell these vignette-structured stories. Executive producer James Duong explains, “Vietnam has become the next advertising production hub of APAC with full-scale production at a fraction of the costs in many countries. Our production team in Ho Chi Minh City, proved to be a very efficient choice for the diverse locations needed to convey these stories. We were able to shoot the whole 60 second spot in just two days with numerous location moves and set builds.”
dictionary_entries.translated: 这次广告由 Vantage Pictures 在越南胡志明市拍摄，采用了一种高效的制作方式，以满足故事所需的多个场景需求。执行制片人 James Duong 解释道：“越南正迅速成为亚太地区的新兴广告制作中心，在这里拍摄一部全规模的商业广告，成本仅为许多国家的一小部分。我们的制作团队在胡志明市的高效运作，使得这次拍摄能够涵盖多种不同的场景。整个 60 秒的广告仅用两天时间完成，包括多次场景转换和搭建。”

dictionary_entries.original: Matching the film’s lively tone, the music was composed by
dictionary_entries.translated: 与影片活泼的基调相匹配，这次广告的音乐由

dictionary_entries.original: . “From the first briefing, we knew Paul & Zach meant business when it came to the music. The vocals had to lead the film’s message, so we all agreed to push for something addictively sticky. They gave us lots of creative freedom, so we went wild with vocal effects and deliveries.” says Oliver Stutz, audio director, Two AM Music.
dictionary_entries.translated: 创作。“从最初的简报阶段，我们就知道 Paul 和 Zach 对音乐的要求极高。人声必须主导影片的核心信息，因此我们一致决定打造一首让人上瘾的旋律。他们给了我们很大的创作自由，所以我们大胆尝试了各种人声特效和表现方式。” Two AM Music 音频总监 Oliver Stutz 说道。

dictionary_entries.original: The campaign is airing in markets across China, Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Mexico, Egypt, and Brazil.
dictionary_entries.translated: 这次广告将在中国、印度尼西亚、越南、印度、墨西哥、埃及和巴西等市场播出。

dictionary_entries.original: Two AM Music | Music Composition & Audio Branding Studio
dictionary_entries.translated: Two AM Music | 音乐创作与音频品牌工作室

dictionary_entries.original: Highlighting the profound effects of taking small smart steps, Bitget’s latest campaign, ‘Trade Smarter’, brings relatable moments and humour to financial advertising. To execute this, the cryptocurrency exchange and web3 company partnered with Vantage Pictures who produced a series of four films depicting comedic moments, where thinking outside the box transforms the ordinary into the extraordinary.
dictionary_entries.translated: Bitget 的最新广告 ‘Trade Smarter ’强调了采取聪明的小步骤所产生的深远影响，为金融广告带来了贴近生活的幽默瞬间。为了实现这一目标，这家加密货币交易所和 Web3 公司与 Vantage Pictures 合作，后者制作了一系列四部影片，描述了跳出思维定势将平凡转化为非凡的喜剧时刻。.

dictionary_entries.original: To delve behind the scenes on the campaign, LBB’s Sunna Coleman interviews film director, Paul Boyer Moore, who tells us how comedy can make an impact, how they came up with the funny scenarios and why he loves filming in Thailand.
dictionary_entries.translated: 为了深入了解这次竞选的幕后故事，LBB 的 Sunna Coleman 采访了电影导演 Paul Boyer Moore，他告诉我们喜剧如何产生影响力、他们是如何想出搞笑场景的，以及他为什么喜欢在泰国拍摄。.

dictionary_entries.original: What was the brief from the client and what initial ideas did you have?
dictionary_entries.translated: 客户的简报是什么？您最初有哪些想法？

dictionary_entries.original: Paul: Bitget came to Vantage Pictures with a pretty cool challenge: they wanted a series of films that highlight the importance of being smart in an amusing way, all tied back to trading smarter. The catch was that these films had to work across all target markets, including folks who are new to crypto trading.
dictionary_entries.translated: 保罗：Bitget 向 Vantage Pictures 提出了一个很棒的挑战：他们想要一系列用有趣的方式强调“聪明”这一点，并将其与更明智的交易联系起来的影片。难点在于这些影片必须能在所有目标市场中奏效，包括那些刚接触加密货币交易的人。.

dictionary_entries.original: The spots take a different approach than the usual financial / crypto trading ads. Tell us about the choice to use a humorous tone.
dictionary_entries.translated: 这些广告的风格与传统的金融/加密货币交易广告不同。请谈谈选择幽默基调的缘由。.

dictionary_entries.original: Paul: Financial ads can be so serious and, honestly, a bit dull. Bitget was brave enough to shake things up. Humour makes things memorable and relatable. When people laugh, they connect with the content on a personal level.
dictionary_entries.translated: 保罗：金融广告总是那么严肃，说实话，有点乏味。Bitget 敢于打破常规。幽默能让人印象深刻，更容易产生共鸣。当人们笑的时候，他们会在个人层面上与内容产生联系。.

dictionary_entries.original: How did you come up with the different scenarios and select the final stories?
dictionary_entries.translated: 你是如何构思不同的故事情节并最终选定最终的故事的？

dictionary_entries.original: Paul: We tossed around a bunch of scenarios where everyday folks solve problems with clever ideas. One idea I loved was about a football fan struggling to watch a game due to two tall men blocking his view. Frustrated, he builds a huge throne of empty beer mugs to elevate himself so he can watch the game. It was so weird and absurd! We were so close to making that one. In the end, we chose stories that were more practical to shoot and would really resonate with Bitget’s audience.
dictionary_entries.translated: 保罗我们讨论了很多日常生活中人们用巧妙创意解决问题的场景。我喜欢的一个点子是，一个足球迷因为两个高个子挡住了他的视线而无法观看比赛。沮丧之余，他用空啤酒杯做了一个巨大的宝座，把自己垫高，这样就能看比赛了。这太奇怪、太荒诞了！我们差一点就能做出这样的故事了。最后，我们选择了更实用的故事进行拍摄，这样才能真正引起 Bitget 受众的共鸣。.

dictionary_entries.original: Which spot is your personal favorite and why?
dictionary_entries.translated: 你最喜欢的地点是哪里？为什么？

dictionary_entries.original: The spots were filmed in Bangkok – tell us about the locations chosen and any production challenges that came with it.
dictionary_entries.translated: 广告片在曼谷拍摄--请介绍一下拍摄地点的选择以及制作过程中遇到的挑战。.

dictionary_entries.original: Paul: Filming in Bangkok was fantastic. It’s cost-effective and offers a wealth of international talent – actors who can really perform, not just stand there and look good. The western-style homes and beach locations also fit our needs perfectly for this global campaign.
dictionary_entries.translated: 保罗在曼谷拍摄非常棒。这里的成本效益高，国际人才济济--演员可以真正表演，而不仅仅是站在那里好看。这里的西式住宅和海滩外景也完全符合我们这次全球宣传活动的需要。.

dictionary_entries.original: One big challenge was our location move from a home film set to a beach jet ski scene. You’d think in Thailand that’s easy, but the nearest natural beach was two hours away, which didn’t fit our tight schedule. We got creative and found a man-made beach lake much closer. It saved us time and gave us better control without worrying about waves disrupting the shoot.
dictionary_entries.translated: 一个巨大的挑战是我们的拍摄地点从家庭电影场景转移到了海滩摩托艇场景。在泰国，你会觉得这很容易，但最近的天然海滩也要两个小时的车程，这不符合我们紧凑的日程安排。我们发挥创意，找到了一个更近的人工沙滩湖。这样既节省了时间，又能更好地控制拍摄，不用担心海浪会影响拍摄。.

dictionary_entries.original: What was the casting process like?

Paul: Casting was a breeze. In Thailand, casting agencies really go the extra mile. They don’t just send audition tapes – they film entire scenes based on our storyboard, complete with makeup, wardrobe, props, and even edit it to music. It made it so much easier to visualise the final product and get the client’s approval.
dictionary_entries.translated: 保罗选角很容易。在泰国，选角机构真的是不遗余力。他们不只是寄来试镜带，还会根据我们的故事板拍摄整个场景，包括化妆、服装、道具，甚至还会根据音乐进行剪辑。这让我们更容易想象出最终产品并获得客户的认可。.

dictionary_entries.original: What was the most enjoyable part of the production process for you?
dictionary_entries.translated: 在制作过程中，您最享受的部分是什么？

dictionary_entries.original: Paul: Honestly, working with the actors was the highlight for me. Their energy and enthusiasm were incredible. They brought each character to life in ways that exceeded my expectations.
dictionary_entries.translated: 保罗：说实话，能和演员们一起工作是我最大的亮点。他们的精力和热情令人难以置信。他们将每个角色都演绎得活灵活现，超出了我的预期。.

dictionary_entries.translated: 还有什么你想分享的吗？

dictionary_entries.translated: 微星科技与 Vantage Pictures 合作，在 B2B 领域拍摄首部全球品牌宣传片

dictionary_entries.original: MSI taps Vantage Pictures for its first global brand film in the B2B space | Vantage Pictures
dictionary_entries.translated: MSI 携手 Vantage Pictures 推出首部 B2B 领域全球品牌宣传片 | Vantage Pictures

dictionary_entries.original: When gaming hardware giant MSI officially entered the B2B market in 2020 with its “Business and Productivity” series, it marked a significant pivot for the Taiwan-based brand. But 2025 brought a new milestone: the launch of MSI Business’s first-ever brand film – a campaign aimed not just at selling specs, but at elevating how everyday professionals experience their work.
dictionary_entries.translated: 当游戏硬件巨头微星于2020年携其“商用与生产力”系列正式进军B2B市场时，标志着这家总部位于台湾的品牌发生了重大转变。但2025年迎来了一个新的里程碑：微星商用首部品牌影片的发布——这项活动旨在提升普通专业人士的工作体验，而不仅仅是推销产品规格。.

dictionary_entries.original: For that, MSI turned to Vantage Pictures, a global production company known for its extensive experience in the tech space. The brief: Develop a brand-forward film that showcases MSI’s expanding range of business PCs without leaning into the product-porn territory that’s so typical of tech. Instead, the focus was on aspirational storytelling across three key sectors: education, retail, and SMB (small-to-medium businesses).
dictionary_entries.translated: 为此，MSI 找到Vantage Pictures，这是一家以其在科技领域丰富的经验而闻名的全球制作公司。要求是：制作一部以品牌为导向的影片，展示 MSI 不断扩展的商用 PC 系列，同时避免像科技产品那样常见的“产品色情”风格。取而代之的是，影片将专注于教育、零售和中小企业这三个关键领域的励志故事。.

dictionary_entries.original: “We knew we had to show the products in use, but we didn’t want to fall into the trap of making this feel like a spec sheet come to life,” says Zacharia Lorenz, co-founder of Vantage Pictures and director of the film. “MSI wanted something grounded, human, and relatable to virtually any market worldwide.”
dictionary_entries.translated: “我们知道必须展示产品的使用场景，但我们不想落入俗套，让它看起来像是规格说明书的具象化，” Zacharia Lorenz说，他是 Vantage Pictures 的联合创始人兼本片导演。“MSI 希望它能接地气，有人情味，并且在全球几乎任何市场上都具有亲和力。”

dictionary_entries.original: The campaign consists of a 2.5-minute brand film “Elevate Everyday Work”, along with three 30-second cutdowns tailored to each sector. The story features a fashion entrepreneur in her boutique shop, a middle school teacher shaping young minds, and a cybersecurity analyst protecting critical infrastructure — each storyline subtly interwoven with MSI’s product ecosystem.
dictionary_entries.translated: 此次宣传活动包含一部2.5分钟的品牌影片“Elevate Everyday Work”，以及三部针对不同行业的30秒短片。故事围绕着一位精品店里的时尚创业者、一位启迪学生心灵的中学教师和一位保护关键基础设施的网络安全分析师展开——每个故事线都巧妙地融入了MSI的产品生态系统。.

dictionary_entries.original: Undoubtedly, the biggest production challenge was time. From award to shoot, the team had just two weeks for creative development and pre-production. Scouting for real locations was off the table. Instead, Vantage leaned into Vietnam’s fast-moving art departments and cost-effective build options.
dictionary_entries.translated: 毫无疑问，最大的制作挑战是时间。从获奖到拍摄，团队只有两周时间进行创意开发和前期制作。实地勘景的可能性被排除。相反，Vantage 公司依靠越南高效的艺术部门和具有成本效益的搭建方案。.

dictionary_entries.original: “Set builds are one of Vietnam’s secret weapons,” says Lorenz. “We had three large sets to construct in a single studio space, and our art director Jean Phan turned around visual mockups in under 24 hours. The sets were approved and constructed within just three days.”
dictionary_entries.translated: “布景搭建是越南的秘密武器之一，”洛伦兹说道。“我们在同一个工作室空间里搭建了三个大型布景，我们的艺术总监让·潘在不到 24 小时内就完成了效果图。布景在短短三天内就获得了批准并搭建完成。”

dictionary_entries.original: The shoot itself was equally intense: 48 shots across two days, all in-studio in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. Director of Photography Mate Toth Widamon shot largely on steadicam to ensure fluid motion and rapid resets, adding production value without sacrificing speed. And with MSI’s team based in Taiwan, the shoot was entirely remote, with a live-streamed client monitor keeping things seamless across borders.
dictionary_entries.translated: 拍摄本身同样紧张：两天内完成了48个镜头，全部在越南胡志明市的摄影棚内拍摄。摄影指导Mate Toth Widamon主要使用斯坦尼康进行拍摄，以确保运动流畅且能快速重置，在不牺牲速度的情况下提高了制作价值。而且，由于MSI的团队位于台湾，整个拍摄过程完全是远程进行的，通过实时流媒体的客户监视器，保证了跨国界的无缝衔接。.

dictionary_entries.original: “Our goal was to create something that didn’t feel rooted in any one region,” Lorenz explains. “The casting, wardrobe, production design — everything had to feel international, while still being doable here in Vietnam.”
dictionary_entries.translated: “我们的目标是创造一种不局限于任何一个地区的东西，”洛伦兹解释道。“选角、服装、美术设计——所有的一切都必须感觉是国际化的，同时又能在这里越南完成。”

dictionary_entries.original: The final result is a sleek yet warm, human-centric brand film that communicates MSI’s business-to-business identity without losing the high-gloss confidence the brand is known for in its gaming line. It’s a strong signal that MSI isn’t just stepping into the business world — it’s moving with style and purpose.
dictionary_entries.translated: 最终的成果是一部造型时尚又不失温馨、以人为本的品牌影片，它在传达MSI的 B2B 定位的同时，并没有失去该品牌在其游戏系列中广为人知的耀眼自信。这发出了一个强烈的信号，表明MSI不仅仅是进入商用领域——它正以时尚和目标进军。.
