dictionary_entries.original: For Bambu Lab’s latest innovation, we helped introduce Vortek, a breakthrough in multi-material 3D printing. Designed to eliminate wasteful “purge towers” and color-change downtime, Vortek reimagines how printers swap materials through a fully automatic, wireless hotend system. Our film visualizes years of engineering ambition distilled into a single elegant solution — bringing audiences inside the precision, complexity, and excitement behind Bambu Lab’s boldest leap forward since the X1.
dictionary_entries.translated: 为了帮助隆重推出博瑞科，这是 Bambu Lab 在多材料 3D 打印领域的最新创新，是一项突破。博瑞科旨在消除浪费的“清洗塔”和换色停机时间，通过全自动无线热端系统重新构想打印机更换材料的方式。我们的影片将多年工程创新的精髓浓缩成一个优雅的解决方案——让观众深入了解 Bambu Lab 自 X1 以来最大胆飞跃的精准度、复杂性和激动人心的过程。.

dictionary_entries.original: For Govee’s "Shining With Govee" Halloween 2025 campaign, we brought a full cinematic flair to the world of smart lighting. Across four themed films, our team transformed ordinary homes into eerie, movie-ready showcases—where every flicker, hue, and glow told its own spooky story. From fog-filled driveways to dancing spectral lights, the series celebrates Govee’s wide range of outdoor and indoor lighting, proving that with the right setup, you can turn your home into the ultimate haunted spectacle.
dictionary_entries.translated: 在 Govee 的 "闪耀 Govee "万圣节 2025 宣传活动中，我们为智能照明世界带来了十足的电影风格。在四部主题影片中，我们的团队将普通家庭变成了阴森恐怖的电影展示厅，每一个闪烁、色调和光芒都在诉说着自己的诡异故事。从雾气弥漫的车道到舞动的幽灵灯，该系列展示了 Govee 广泛的室外和室内照明产品，证明只要设置得当，就能将您的家变成终极闹鬼奇观。.

dictionary_entries.translated: 导演简介：12 个问题问 Vantage Pictures 的 Alexis Odiowei

dictionary_entries.original: Director’s Brief: 12 Questions is a new Q&A series from Campaign Brief Asia that shines a spotlight on the broad mix of talent shaping Asia’s commercial directing scene. Kicking off the series is Alexis Odiowei of Vantage Pictures.
dictionary_entries.translated: 导演简报：12 个问题》是 Campaign Brief Asia 新推出的问答系列，聚焦于塑造亚洲商业导演舞台的各类人才。Vantage Pictures 的 Alexis Odiowei 是该系列的开篇人物。.

dictionary_entries.original: 1. Describe your directing style in one paragraph.
dictionary_entries.translated: 1.用一个段落描述您的导演风格。.

dictionary_entries.original: My directing style blends physical humour, uncanny situations and visually stimulating cinematography. I’m always trying to create little moments that make you chuckle while watching and hopefully leave a lasting impression.
dictionary_entries.translated: 我的导演风格融合了肢体幽默、不可思议的情境和视觉刺激的电影拍摄。我一直在努力创造一些小瞬间，让你在观看的时候会心一笑，并希望给你留下深刻的印象。.

dictionary_entries.original: 2. Was there a specific ad that made you think, “I want to do this for a living”?
dictionary_entries.translated: 2.是否有一个特定的广告让你觉得 “我想以此为生”？

dictionary_entries.original: There was no one particular ad that made me think I wanted to do this for a living, but there’s lots of ads that stick in my mind when I think about what I love about advertising when it’s done well. Some of them are Tango – Orange Man Advert, Guinness – The Surfer, Cadburys – Gorilla, Sainsbury’s – 1914
dictionary_entries.translated: 没有一个特别的广告让我觉得我想以此为生，但当我想到我喜欢的广告中哪些做得好时，有很多广告会在我脑海中留下深刻印象。其中包括探戈--橙色人广告、健力士--冲浪者、嘉堡士--大猩猩、森斯伯里--1914。
3.您最喜欢的电视广告是什么？

dictionary_entries.original: My all time favourite TVC is probably
dictionary_entries.translated: 我最喜欢的电视广告可能是

dictionary_entries.original: . I think it’s a visual masterpiece that powerfully captures the brand messaging and draws on themes of struggle, patience and triumph, making it not only incredibly memorable but also relatable. Many ads today are inspired by other ads but this commercial’s inspiration was art and literature.
dictionary_entries.translated: . .我认为这是一部视觉杰作，它有力地捕捉到了品牌信息，汲取了奋斗、耐心和胜利的主题，不仅令人过目难忘，而且贴近生活。如今，许多广告的灵感都来自其他广告，但这个广告的灵感却来自艺术和文学。.

dictionary_entries.original: Well the Guinness ad is my favourite from my country. My favourite campaign from Asia is an ad that was produced for
dictionary_entries.translated: 我最喜欢我国的健力士（Guinness）广告。我最喜欢的亚洲广告是为

dictionary_entries.translated: 为一家地方电视台拍摄越南的农历新年

dictionary_entries.original: . It is a great mix of traditional Vietnamese culture, contemporary dance and stunning imagery.
dictionary_entries.translated: . .它将越南传统文化、现代舞蹈和令人惊叹的图像完美融合在一起。.

dictionary_entries.original: 5. In your experience, what’s the secret to a smooth director-agency-client vibe?
dictionary_entries.translated: 5.根据您的经验，导演--经纪公司--客户之间和谐相处的秘诀是什么？

dictionary_entries.original: I think trust is the secret to a smooth vibe among all the parties mentioned. When we have trust amongst all parties there is less second guessing and the creatives are allowed to do what they need to do to make something magical.
dictionary_entries.translated: 我认为，信任是所有各方之间保持顺畅氛围的秘诀。当各方都相互信任时，猜测就会减少，创意人员就可以做他们需要做的事情，创造出神奇的作品。.

dictionary_entries.original: 6. Where do you go (or what do you do) when you need to recharge your creative batteries?
dictionary_entries.translated: 6.当你需要给创意电池充电时，你会去哪里（或做什么）？

dictionary_entries.original: This is very important for me as I am director, but also a production company owner so it’s sometimes hard to find time outside of the commercial production sphere. Downtime from directing doesn’t always equate to downtime from the industry, as I still have to be concerned with the day to day of my business. However, I try to make time for a few things to recharge creatively and also more generally. Creatively I embark on personal projects outside of the commercial sphere. I usually try to keep these projects small so they can be completed in a timely manner and it also takes me back to that DIY feeling early in my career of just shooting with friends.
dictionary_entries.translated: 这对我来说非常重要，因为我既是导演，也是制片公司的老板，所以有时很难在商业制片领域之外找到时间。从导演工作中抽出的时间并不总是等同于从行业中抽出的时间，因为我仍然需要关心我的日常业务。不过，我还是会尽量抽出时间做一些事情，为创作充电，同时也为自己充电。在创意方面，我会在商业领域之外开展个人项目。我通常会尽量保持这些项目的小型化，以便及时完成，这也让我回到了职业生涯早期与朋友一起拍摄的那种 DIY 感觉。.

dictionary_entries.original: I’m also an avid martial artist and have been engaged in some form of martial arts training since I was a child. My current passion is Brazilian Jiu Jitsu. I train 3-4 times a week and compete 2-3 times a year. This gives me another passion completely removed from directing that allows me to be artistic in a different way.
dictionary_entries.translated: 我还是一名狂热的武术家，从小就开始接受某种形式的武术训练。我目前最热衷的是巴西柔术。我每周训练 3-4 次，每年参加 2-3 次比赛。这给了我另一种完全不同于导演的激情，让我能以不同的方式进行艺术创作。.

dictionary_entries.original: 7. Ever had a happy accident on set that turned out to be a game-changer?
dictionary_entries.translated: 7.有没有在拍摄现场遇到过意外，结果却改变了游戏规则？

dictionary_entries.original: I think the best happy accident, or I guess stroke of luck I’ve had, was when shooting with a poodle. We had a shot where we crash zoom into the poodle after it has gotten a silly haircut. Somehow the dog just understood the comic timing and it tilted it’s head with a bemused expression on it’s face just as the crash zoom landed on it. It just fit perfectly with the emotion we were trying to create.
dictionary_entries.translated: 我觉得我遇到过的最好的意外，或者说是最幸运的一次，就是和一只贵宾犬一起拍摄的时候。我们有一个镜头，在狮子狗剪了一个愚蠢的发型后，我们把镜头拉近到它身上。不知怎么的，这只贵宾犬就理解了这个滑稽的时机，它歪着脑袋，脸上带着困惑的表情，就在这时，变焦镜头落在了它的身上。这与我们想要营造的情绪完美契合。.

dictionary_entries.original: 8. Is there a mentor or person who has had a big impact on your career?
dictionary_entries.translated: 8.是否有对您的职业生涯产生重大影响的导师或人士？

dictionary_entries.original: My Uncle used to take me to the cinema a lot as a kid and I would just always be watching movies with him. So I would say he was the first person to really open my eyes to filmmaking.
dictionary_entries.translated: 我叔叔小时候经常带我去电影院，我总是和他一起看电影。他是第一个让我真正了解电影制作的人。.

dictionary_entries.original: 9. What’s the next big thing in commercial filmmaking? Explain.
dictionary_entries.translated: 9.商业电影制作的下一个热点是什么？解释一下。.

dictionary_entries.original: I think with the rise of AI I think there will be a return to real stories. I think audiences will want to see more human stories and there will be a big shift towards branded documentaries and maybe even some more long-form documentaries connected to brands.
dictionary_entries.translated: 我认为，随着人工智能的兴起，真实故事将会回归。我认为观众会希望看到更多的人性故事，品牌纪录片将出现重大转变，甚至可能出现更多与品牌相关的长篇纪录片。.

dictionary_entries.original: 10. If you could direct a dream ad for any brand, which brand would you choose?
dictionary_entries.translated: 10.如果你能为任何品牌执导一则梦幻广告，你会选择哪个品牌？

dictionary_entries.original: I think over the years I might have been Nando’s biggest customer so I think a commercial for them would be one way of them paying me back for my patronage. Otherwise as a martial artist I would love to make a commercial for the UFC.
dictionary_entries.translated: 我想多年来我可能一直是南多公司最大的客户，因此我认为为他们拍摄广告是他们回报我的一种方式。另外，作为一名武术家，我很想为终极格斗锦标赛（UFC）拍一个广告。.

dictionary_entries.original: 11. If you could give one tip to an aspiring TVC director, what would it be?
dictionary_entries.translated: 11.如果您能给有抱负的 TVC 导演一个建议，您会是什么？

dictionary_entries.original: I would advise two things. One, try to become knowledgeable in a specific area of the industry. A lot of great directors come from other backgrounds. Whether it’s an art background, acting post-production or cinematography, this can really help inform the style of director you become. Two, just start directing whether it’s music videos for a friend or making a short film or whatever it might be.
dictionary_entries.translated: 我有两个建议。第一，努力学习行业内某一特定领域的知识。很多伟大的导演都有其他背景。无论是艺术背景、表演后期制作还是电影摄影，这都能真正帮助你形成自己的导演风格。其次，无论是为朋友拍摄音乐录影带，还是制作短片或其他任何形式的作品，都可以开始执导。.

dictionary_entries.original: 12. What are your top 3 ads you’ve directed?
dictionary_entries.translated: 12.您执导过的前 3 个广告是什么？

dictionary_entries.original: These are the ads that people seem to enjoy most from the ones I’ve directed:
dictionary_entries.translated: 在我执导的广告中，人们似乎最喜欢这些广告：

dictionary_entries.original: Director’s Brief: 12 Questions with Alexis Odiowei at Vantage Pictures | Vantage Pictures
dictionary_entries.translated: 总监简报：12 个问题与 Alexis Odiowei 在 Vantage Pictures | Vantage Pictures

dictionary_entries.original: Director’s Brief: 12 Questions is a new Q&A series from Campaign Brief Asia that shines a spotlight on the broad mix of talent shaping Asia’s commercial directing scene. Kicking off the series is Alexis Odiowei of Vantage Pictures.
dictionary_entries.translated: 导演简报：12 个问题》是 Campaign Brief Asia 新推出的问答系列，聚焦于塑造亚洲商业导演舞台的各类人才。Vantage Pictures 的 Alexis Odiowei 是该系列的开篇人物。.

dictionary_entries.original: Director’s Brief: 12 Questions is a new Q&A series from Campaign Brief Asia that shines a spotlight on the broad mix of talent shaping Asia’s commercial directing scene. Kicking off the series is Alexis Odiowei of Vantage Pictures.
dictionary_entries.translated: 导演简报：12 个问题》是 Campaign Brief Asia 推出的一个新的问答系列，聚焦于塑造亚洲商业导演形象的各类人才。来自 Vantage Pictures 的 Alexis Odiowei 是该系列的开篇人物。.

dictionary_entries.original: Shot entirely on location in Almaty, Kazakhstan, the film blends grounded storytelling with surreal visual metaphors—highlighting just how far the OnePlus Pad 3 pushes the boundaries of what a creative tablet can be. The decision to shoot in Kazakhstan wasn’t just for the dramatic mountain backdrops. “We needed access to a modern airport. We needed diversity in our cast. And we needed locations that didn’t look like a generic studio backlot,” says Paul Moore, Vantage Pictures Director. “Almaty gave us all of that—and more.”
dictionary_entries.translated: 这部电影完全在哈萨克斯坦阿拉木图实景拍摄，将具象化的叙事与超现实的视觉隐喻相结合——凸显了 OnePlus Pad 3 在创意平板电脑领域突破界限的程度。选择在哈萨克斯坦拍摄，不仅仅是为了戏剧性的山景。“我们需要现代化的机场。我们需要多样化的演员阵容。我们需要看起来不像普通摄影棚内景的拍摄地点，”Paul Moore，Vantage Pictures 导演说道。“阿拉木图给了我们所有这些，甚至更多。”

dictionary_entries.original: The film follows three high-performance creatives—a game producer, an industrial designer, and a travel content creator—each unlocking their flow state using the Pad 3’s standout features. Scenes include cloning effects to visualize multitasking, stylus-drawn motorcycles that materialize into full-scale concept bikes, and airport lounges transformed into mobile editing bays.
dictionary_entries.translated: 该影片讲述了一位游戏制作人、一位工业设计师和一位旅行内容创作者这三位高绩效创意人士的故事，他们利用 Pad 3 的出众功能解锁了他们的心流状态。场景包括用于可视化多任务处理的克隆效果，从中可以具象化出全尺寸概念自行车的触控笔绘制的摩托车，以及机场休息室转变为移动编辑室。.

dictionary_entries.original: Music and sound design was handled by Two AM Music. Kit Kuan Leong, Two AM Music’s Audio Director, said: “We designed the music and sound to echo the film’s central theme, clearing mental clutter and embracing ease. Each musical shift follows the characters’ journey, flowing seamlessly across moods while anchored by a simple motif. On the sound design side, we leaned into contrast: from the chaos of sensory overload to the crisp clarity of tech precision, letting every transition breathe and build with intention.”
dictionary_entries.translated: 音乐和音效设计由Two AM Music负责。Two AM Music的音频总监Kit Kuan Leong表示：“我们设计的音乐和音效旨在呼应影片的核心主题，即扫除杂念，拥抱轻松。每一处音乐的转变都紧随角色的旅程，在简约的动机支撑下，在不同情绪间无缝过渡。在音效设计方面，我们尝试了对比：从感官过载的混乱到技术精准的清脆，让每一次过渡都能自然而然地、有目的地酝酿和发展。’

dictionary_entries.original: The result? A fast-paced, premium-feeling, visually immersive spot that challenges conventional expectations of what a tablet campaign should look like—and reminds us that creativity isn’t limited by place, time, or tools.
dictionary_entries.translated: 结果？这是一个快节奏、充满高端质感、视觉沉浸感强的广告，挑战了人们对平板电脑广告的传统认知——并提醒我们，创造力不受地点、时间或工具的限制。.

dictionary_entries.original: Vantage Pictures drops cinematic global campaign for OnePlus Pad 3 launch | Vantage Pictures
dictionary_entries.translated: Vantage Pictures 为一加平板 3 发布推出电影级全球宣传活动 | Vantage Pictures

dictionary_entries.original: To bring that message to life, Vantage Pictures, one of Southeast Asia’s most exciting production companies, stepped in to craft this direct to client campaign that was as bold as it was thoughtful. Directed by Alexis Odiowei and shot entirely in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, the four-film series fused situational comedy and emotional honesty to challenge traditional beauty advertising—and connect with women on their own terms.
dictionary_entries.translated: 为了让这个信息焕发活力，Vantage Pictures，一家东南亚最令人兴奋的制作公司，介入创作了这个直接面向客户的广告活动，它既大胆又周到。由Alexis Odiowei执导，并完全在越南胡志明市拍摄，这个四部电影系列融合了情景喜剧和情感真诚，以此挑战传统的美容广告——并以女性自己的方式与她们建立联系。.

dictionary_entries.original: “At its core, this campaign was about helping women feel confident in their own skin,” said Odiowei. “Whether in an intimate moment or at the beach, we wanted them to feel empowered—not pressured.” The creative team developed two “Leave the Lights On” films centered around women in private, empowering situations, and two comedy-driven spots that played up relatable, awkward moments—with Ulike’s device as the subtle confidence boost in each story.
dictionary_entries.translated: “归根结底，这次活动旨在帮助女性对自己充满信心，”Odiowei 说。“无论是在私密时刻还是在海滩上，我们都希望她们感到赋权——而不是感到压力。”创意团队制作了两部以女性在私密、赋权情境为中心的“开灯”广告片，以及两部以具有相关性、尴尬时刻为卖点的搞笑广告——Ulike 的设备在每个故事中都扮演着微妙的自信助推器。.

dictionary_entries.original: Navigating a product in the personal care category demanded a careful tone. “We were dealing with something intimate, and didn’t want to alienate or patronize anyone,” said Odiowei. “So the storytelling had to be inclusive, humorous, but always respectful.” That mindset shaped everything from casting to art direction to wardrobe.
dictionary_entries.translated: 在个人护理产品类别中进行导航需要谨慎的语气。“我们在处理一些私人的事情，不想疏远或怠慢任何人，”Odiowei 说。“因此，故事情节必须是包容的、幽默的，但始终保持尊重。”这种心态塑造了从选角到艺术指导再到服装的一切。.

dictionary_entries.original: Custom-built sets reflected lived-in, realistic spaces—far from the typical sterile or idealized beauty settings. This authenticity was key to breaking beauty tropes and resonating with real women.
dictionary_entries.translated: 定制的布景反映了真实的生活空间，而非通常的刻板或理想化的美学环境。这种真实性是打破了美容的陈词滥调并引起真实女性共鸣的关键。.

dictionary_entries.original: “Vietnam allowed us to stretch the budget while still achieving high-end execution,” said James Duong, Executive Producer at Vantage Pictures. “We built four detailed sets, sourced a diverse cast locally and from Bangkok, and worked with some of the best crews in the region.”
dictionary_entries.translated: “越南让我们在预算内实现了高端的制作水准，”James Duong，Vantage Pictures的执行制片人说道。“我们搭建了四个细节丰富的场景，在当地和曼谷招募了多元化的演员，并与该地区一些最优秀的剧组合作。”

dictionary_entries.original: With more brands turning to Vietnam for high-end production solutions, Vantage Pictures is leading the way. “Every time we host a new client in Vietnam, they’re blown away by what’s possible here,” added Duong. “From infrastructure to talent, Vietnam is ready for the global stage.”
dictionary_entries.translated: 随着越来越多的品牌转向越南寻求高端生产解决方案，Vantage Pictures 正引领潮流。Duong 补充道：“每次我们在越南接待新客户，他们都对这里可能实现的成就感到震惊。从基础设施到人才，越南已经为全球舞台做好了准备。”

dictionary_entries.original: Confidence in every frame: Ulike taps Vantage Pictures for humorous beauty campaign | Vantage Pictures
dictionary_entries.translated: 每一帧都自信：Ulike 携手Vantage Pictures打造幽默美妆宣传活动 | Vantage Pictures

dictionary_entries.original: Screenshot from 'Ulike - Love Doesnt Have To Be Painful' commercial spot, produced by Vantage Pictures, a global video production agency.
dictionary_entries.translated: 由全球视频制作公司 Vantage Pictures 制作的 'Ulike - Love Doesnt Have To Be Painful '广告片截图。.

dictionary_entries.original: Govee’s haunted light show: Vantage Pictures turns Vietnam suburb into a horror film set
dictionary_entries.translated: 戈维的鬼魅灯光秀：Vantage Pictures 将越南郊区变成恐怖片场景

dictionary_entries.original: When smart lighting brand Govee approached Vantage Pictures with a Halloween brief, the idea was as eerie as it was illuminating – a campaign inspired by The Shining.
dictionary_entries.translated: 当智能照明品牌 Govee 向 Vantage Pictures 提出万圣节活动的要求时，Vantage Pictures 的想法既阴森恐怖又充满照明效果--活动灵感来自《闪灵》。.

dictionary_entries.original: “Govee gave us a great starting point,” says Executive Producer James Duong. “We loved the play on words between shining and light — it connected perfectly to Govee’s core product. From there, we built it into a full campaign: one hero film and three short Alexa co-branded spots.”
dictionary_entries.translated: “Govee 为我们提供了一个绝佳的起点，”执行制片人 James Duong说。“我们很喜欢”闪耀’和‘光’之间的文字游戏——它完美地契合了 Govee 的核心产品。从那时起，我们将其扩展为一个完整的活动：一部主影片以及三个与 Alexa 联合品牌的短片。”

dictionary_entries.original: Shot entirely in Phan Thiết, Vietnam the campaign’s suburban setting was meticulously art-directed to feel like small-town America.
dictionary_entries.translated: 本次广告大片全程在越南藩切拍摄，其郊区背景经过精心布置，旨在营造出美国小镇的感觉。.

dictionary_entries.original: “We looked at multiple cities in Vietnam — Ho Chi Minh City, Đà Lạt — and finally found the perfect neighbourhood in Phan Thiết,” added Duong. “The architecture and street layout gave us that American suburban feel, and we could light and control an entire block.”
dictionary_entries.translated: “我们在越南考察了多个城市——胡志明市、大叻——最终在藩切找到了完美的街区，”杨补充道。“这里的建筑和街道布局让我们感觉就像在美国郊区，而且我们可以照亮并控制整个街区。”

dictionary_entries.original: Nearly two tons of Govee lighting hardware were incorporated into the house: in windows, props, and furniture, allowing the light to move naturally through the scene.
dictionary_entries.translated: 房子里安装了近两吨 Govee 照明硬件：在窗户、道具和家具中，让光线能够自然地穿过场景。.

dictionary_entries.original: Director Salihin Ramli recalls the surreal energy on set. “The joy was in finding that sweet spot where light, fear, and laughter all collide. I had an incredible time working with a cast and crew who brought this hauntingly fun world to life.”
dictionary_entries.translated: 导演萨利欣·拉姆利回忆起片场那种超现实般的能量。“乐趣在于找到光影、恐惧和欢笑交织在一起的那个甜蜜点。与将这个令人毛骨悚然又充满乐趣的世界呈现在观众眼前的演员和剧组人员一起工作，我度过了一段非常愉快的时光。”

dictionary_entries.original: “Lighting a light product is tricky,” said Duong. “You have to make it look beautiful while it’s performing in the scene.”
dictionary_entries.translated: “照亮一个灯光产品很棘手，”Duong说。“你必须让它在场景中表演时看起来很美。”

dictionary_entries.original: To pull it off, the crew rigged a massive truss above the house, combining traditional fixtures with Govee’s smart lighting systems. Most of the scenes were lit primarily by the products themselves — deep purples, blues, and golds that blended seamlessly with cinematic light.
dictionary_entries.translated: 要实现这一目标，剧组在家宅上方搭建了一个巨大的桁架，将传统灯具与Govee的智能照明系统相结合。大部分场景主要由产品本身进行布光——深紫色、蓝色和金色与电影光效无缝融合。.

dictionary_entries.original: “It was like running a live concert,” Duong says. “We synced the Govee app to DMX controls, pre-programmed every cue, and synced it all to choreography. Once it started, everything — lights, camera, and performance — moved together in rhythm.”
dictionary_entries.translated: “这就像在举办一场现场演唱会，”Duong 表示。“我们将 Govee 应用与 DMX 控制同步，预先编程了每一个信号，并将其全部与编舞同步。一旦开始，所有东西——灯光、摄像机和表演——都随着节奏一起律动。”

dictionary_entries.original: Govee’s haunted light show: Vantage Pictures turns Vietnam suburb into a horror film set | Vantage Pictures
dictionary_entries.translated: Govee 的恐怖灯光秀：Vantage Pictures 将越南郊区变成恐怖电影片场 | Vantage Pictures

dictionary_entries.original: Vantage Pictures and realme turn nightlife into an AI-powered dream in “Live For Real” campaign
dictionary_entries.translated: Vantage Pictures 和 realme 在 “Live For Real ”活动中将夜生活变成人工智能驱动的梦想

dictionary_entries.original: When realme set out to launch its new 15 Series 5G, the brief was simple: make it feel alive. What emerged was Live For Real – a high-voltage night odyssey that pulses with energy, style, and movement. Produced by Vantage Pictures and directed by Guy Bolandi, the film transforms an ordinary night out into a dreamlike blend of AI magic and disco-era glamour.
dictionary_entries.translated: 当 realme 开始推出其全新 15 系列 5G 时，要求很简单：让它充满活力。于是，《Live For Real》应运而生--这是一部充满活力、时尚和动感的高压夜间奥德赛。这部影片由 Vantage Pictures 制作，Guy Bolandi 执导，将一个普通的夜晚变成了人工智能魔法与迪斯科时代魅力的梦幻结合。.

dictionary_entries.original: At its heart, Live For Real follows a young woman as she leaves the office and steps into the night. One moment she’s waiting at a bus stop, the next she’s lost in music and light — her realme 15 capturing every beat of her journey.
dictionary_entries.translated: Live For Real 的核心讲述了一位年轻女子下班后踏入夜色的故事。有那么一刻，她还在公交站台等待，下一刻，她就沉醉在音乐和灯光中——她的 realme 15 捕捉了她旅程中的每一个节拍。.

dictionary_entries.original: “We wanted to show how AI can elevate real life — how technology makes the ordinary feel cinematic,” says Alexis Odiowei, Creative Director at Vantage Pictures.
dictionary_entries.translated: “我们希望展示人工智能如何提升现实生活——技术如何让平凡变得具有电影感，”Vantage Pictures的创意总监 Alexis Odiowei表示。.

dictionary_entries.original: That idea crystallizes in a striking sequence where her outfit morphs from workwear to nightlife chic — a vibrant reflection of the phone’s own AI-powered transformations.
dictionary_entries.translated: 这个想法在一个引人注目的序列中得以鲜明体现，她的服装从工作装变成了夜场风尚——这极具活力地呼应了手机本身由人工智能驱动的变形。.

dictionary_entries.original: “The film isn’t really set in any specific era,” Bolandi explains. “It lives somewhere between the ’70s and ’80s — that Studio 54 energy — with a modern touch. The lighting, the wardrobe, the camera movement… everything was inspired by that world.”
dictionary_entries.translated: “这部电影并没有设定在任何特定的时代，”玻兰迪解释道。“它介于70年代和80年代之间——那种54号工作室的能量——并带有一点现代感。灯光、服装、镜头运动……一切都受到了那个世界的启发。’

dictionary_entries.original: The location at Nu Boyana Studios in Bulgaria, with its New York City backlot, became the perfect stand-in for that golden-age nightlife. “Even the entrance looked like Studio 54,” Bolandi laughs. “Once we lit it, it came alive — shimmering, colorful, and full of motion.”
dictionary_entries.translated: 保加利亚 Nu Boyana 工作室的纽约街景成了那个黄金时代夜生活的完美替代品。“连入口都看起来像 Studio 54，”Bolandi 笑着用。“一旦我们点亮它，它就活了起来——闪烁着，色彩斑斓，充满动感。”

dictionary_entries.original: Finding the right performer was another stroke of luck. The lead — discovered by a production assistant.
dictionary_entries.translated: 找到合适的演员是另一件幸运的事。主演——是被一名助理制片人发现的。.

dictionary_entries.original: Bolandi encouraged her to improvise, letting the camera capture real spontaneity. “My process is about trust,” he says. “You build an environment where the performer can just be. That’s when something authentic happens.”
dictionary_entries.translated: 博兰迪鼓励她即兴表演，让摄像机捕捉真实的自发性。“我的过程是关于信任，”他说。“你建立一种环境，让表演者可以随心所欲。那时就会发生真实的事情。”

dictionary_entries.original: The Live For Real campaign rolls out globally — across Southeast Asia, Eastern Europe, Russia, South America, and India — in multiple formats, from hero film to verticals.
dictionary_entries.translated: "Live For Real" 活动将在全球范围内推出，覆盖东南亚、东欧、俄罗斯、南美和印度，并以多种形式呈现，从主打影片到垂直内容。.

dictionary_entries.original: “It’s a film about energy,” says Odiowei. “About stepping into the night and being your truest self. Whether you’re in Mumbai or Madrid, that feeling is the same.”
dictionary_entries.translated: “这是一部关于能量的电影，”欧迪维说。“关于走进黑夜，做最真实的自己。无论你在孟买还是马德里，那种感觉都是一样的。”

dictionary_entries.original: For Bolandi, the project was deeply personal — a chance to recreate the nightlife he’s always admired.
dictionary_entries.translated: 对于博兰迪来说，这个项目是充满个人情感的——这是一个重现他一直以来所钦佩的夜生活的机会。.

dictionary_entries.original: “I truly live and breathe those eras,” he reflects. “Studio 54, the ’70s, that New York pulse — all updated with a modern twist. Honestly, that’s the kind of world I’d want to live in. That’s how I see my parties.”
dictionary_entries.translated: “我真的活在并呼吸着那些时代，”他沉思道。“工作室54、70年代、纽约的脉搏——所有的一切都用现代的风格更新了。老实说，那样的世界才是我想要的生活。我的派对就是这样的。’

dictionary_entries.original: Vantage Pictures and realme turn nightlife into an AI-powered dream in “Live For Real” campaign | Vantage Pictures
dictionary_entries.translated: Vantage Pictures 与 realme 在“Live For Real”活动中将夜生活打造成人工智能驱动的梦想 | Vantage Pictures

dictionary_entries.original: Rather than rely on CGI, Vantage leaned heavily on practical effects: full prosthetic zombies, silicone bone textures, and makeup sessions lasting up to eight hours.
dictionary_entries.translated: 与其依赖 C G I，Vantage 则大量采用了实景特效：逼真的假肢僵尸、硅胶骨骼纹理以及长达八小时的化妆过程。.

dictionary_entries.original: “It gave the film that tactile realism,” Duong says. “The hardest part was timing — syncing light cues with the dancers and effects. When it all hit perfectly, it was pure magic.”
dictionary_entries.translated: “这赋予了电影那种触手可及的真实感，”Duong 说。“最难的部分是时机——将灯光提示与舞者和特效同步。当一切都完美契合时，那就是纯粹的魔法。”

dictionary_entries.original: “Vietnam offers the best of both worlds,” says Duong. “You can build big, shoot fast, and still keep it high quality. The local crews are incredible — technical, creative, and passionate. Everyone goes the extra mile.”
dictionary_entries.translated: “越南两全其美，”Duong说。“你可以大规模制作，快速拍摄，同时保持高质量。当地的摄制组非常棒——技术精湛，富有创意，充满热情。每个人都会付出额外的努力。”

dictionary_entries.original: He believes this project showcases Vietnam’s rising reputation as a global production hub. “It proves we can execute large-scale lighting and practical effects at an international level,” he adds.
dictionary_entries.translated: 他认为这个项目展示了越南作为全球制造中心日益增长的声誉。“这证明了我们可以达到国际水平，执行大型灯光和特效，”他补充道。.

dictionary_entries.original: After three straight night shoots, the wrap was emotional. “Seeing the rough cuts on set and realizing it all worked — that was a huge moment,” Duong recalls. “Everyone brought something special,” he says. “Our lead actor Rory added humor and personality that made it all come alive.”
dictionary_entries.translated: 经过连续三晚的拍摄，杀青的场面十分感人。Duong回忆道：“在片场看到粗剪片段，意识到一切都奏效了——那是一个重要的时刻。”他说：“每个人都贡献了特别的东西。我们的首席演员罗里（Rory）加入了幽默和个性，让一切都鲜活起来。”

dictionary_entries.original: For Vantage Pictures, it’s not just a Halloween campaign — it’s a benchmark for what’s possible in Vietnam.
dictionary_entries.translated: 对于Vantage Pictures来说，这不仅仅是一个万圣节活动—— it’s a benchmark for what’s possible in Vietnam.

dictionary_entries.original: Director’s Brief: 12 Questions with Zacharia Lorenz at Vantage Pictures
dictionary_entries.translated: 导演简介：12 个问题问 Vantage Pictures 的 Zacharia Lorenz

dictionary_entries.original: Director’s Brief: 12 Questions is a new Q&A series from Campaign Brief Asia that shines a spotlight on the broad mix of talent shaping Asia’s commercial directing scene. The latest installment features Vantage Pictures director Zacharia Lorenz.
dictionary_entries.translated: 导演简报：12 个问题》是 Campaign Brief Asia 推出的一个新的问答系列，聚焦塑造亚洲商业导演舞台的各类人才。最新一期的嘉宾是 Vantage Pictures 的导演 Zacharia Lorenz。.

dictionary_entries.original: Describe your directing style in one paragraph.
dictionary_entries.translated: 我指导的风格是协作和富有远见的，旨在为所有参与人员创造一个支持性的和鼓舞人心的环境。我重视开放的沟通和思想的交流，并努力赋予我的演员和工作人员在创作过程中发挥其独特才能和经验。我的目标是通过鼓励艺术家探索他们的潜在能力，并共同将一个共同的愿景变为现实，从而创造出深刻而难忘的表演。.

dictionary_entries.original: My favorite projects are story-driven “documercials” and product launch films for tech brands, where we explore the human condition behind cutting-edge innovation. These two categories are stylistically different, so I don’t try to force a fixed approach—the tone and technique should always serve the brief.
dictionary_entries.translated: 我最喜欢的一些项目是故事驱动的“纪录片式广告”和科技品牌的发布会影片，在这些项目中，我们探索前沿创新背后的人性。这两类项目在风格上差异很大，所以我不会试图强行采用固定的方法——语调和技巧应始终为项目服务。.

dictionary_entries.original: That said, for most of my product work, I love getting weird with camera—mounting rigs in unexpected places, playing with macro probe lenses, and crafting dynamic sequences that feel like a rollercoaster ride through the product’s design and internals.
dictionary_entries.translated: 话虽如此，在我从事的大部分产品工作中，我喜欢用相机玩出花样——把摄像机架设在意想不到的地方，玩微距探测镜头，并创作出动感十足的序列，感觉就像坐过山车般穿越产品的设计和内部构造。.

dictionary_entries.original: I also prefer slower, more intentional pacing when the concept allows. So many commercials rush to hold attention—understandable in the age of social—but there’s power in letting certain shots breathe. When clients are open to that rhythm, the work always feels more memorable to me.
dictionary_entries.translated: 我也更喜欢缓慢、更具意图性的节奏，只要概念允许。许多广告为了吸引注意力而匆忙——在社交媒体时代这是可以理解的——但让某些镜头有喘息的空间是很有力量的。当客户愿意接受这种节奏时，这部作品给我的感觉总是更令人难忘。.

dictionary_entries.original: Was there a specific ad that made you think, “I want to do this for a living”?
dictionary_entries.translated: 有什么特定的广告让你觉得，“我想以此为生”？

dictionary_entries.original: Not exactly. After uni, my sights were still set on working—commercials weren’t really on my radar. Then I got the opportunity to work at DJI in Shenzhen. As I was considering the idea of upending my life in the States, they released
dictionary_entries.translated: 不完全是。大学毕业后，我仍然专注于工作——商业广告并不在我考虑的范围内。然后，我获得了在深圳大疆工作的机会。当我考虑要颠覆我在美国的生活时，他们发布了

dictionary_entries.original: A New Perspective for the new Phantom 3 campaign
dictionary_entries.translated: Phantom 3 系列推广的新视角

dictionary_entries.original: Back then, drones were still new. People weren’t used to seeing mid-altitude aerials in that sweet spot—higher than a crane, lower than a helicopter. Today they’re so common, but at the time I was pretty blown away by it. The film captured this sense of exploration that really hit. It inspired the adventurer in me & pushed my decision to move overseas.
dictionary_entries.translated: 那时，无人机还很新。人们还不习惯看到那种恰到好处的中空航拍——比起重机高，比直升机低。如今它们如此普遍，但当时我对此印象极其深刻。电影捕捉到了一种探索感，着实打动了我。它激发了我内心的冒险精神，并促使我决定去海外发展。.

dictionary_entries.original: I’ve now been in Asia for over a decade. So in a way, the spot didn’t just influence my career, it reshaped my life. DJI opened the door to some unforgettable experiences and through that journey I realized commercial directing was where I wanted to be.
dictionary_entries.translated: 我在亚洲已经待了十多年了。所以，在某种程度上，这个地方不仅影响了我的职业生涯，也重塑了我的生活。大疆为我打开了一些难忘经历的大门，并在这次旅程中，我意识到商业导演才是我真正想要从事的领域。.
你最喜欢的电视广告是哪个？

dictionary_entries.original: “Favorite” depends on the day, honestly. But two spots come to mind—not just as inspiration, but as reflections of my own stylistic leanings.
dictionary_entries.translated: “最喜欢的”说实话，取决于哪一天。但有两个地方能想到——不仅仅是作为灵感，而是我个人风格取向的反映。.

dictionary_entries.original: Microsoft’s Surface Laptop Studio launch film
dictionary_entries.translated: 微软Surface Laptop Studio发布影片

dictionary_entries.original: . It nails everything I want in a tech product ad: clean, minimalist design; sleek motion control that pulls us through the product like a theme park ride; and seamlessly integrated macro CGI that reveals internal hardware in a way that’s both informative and mesmerizing. It’s fun to watch but still communicates key selling points clearly. The “Pure Imagination” cover was also a perfect music choice—emotive without being overbearing. I’ve referenced that film more times than I can count.
dictionary_entries.translated: . 它完美地契合了我对科技产品广告的所有期望：简洁、极简的设计；流畅的动态控制，将我们像游乐园的游乐设施一样带入产品；以及无缝集成的宏观 CGI，以一种既具信息性又引人入胜的方式揭示了内部硬件。观看它很有趣，但仍然清晰地传达了关键的卖点。“纯粹的想象”的翻唱也是一个完美的音乐选择——富有情感但不压抑。我已经无数次引用那部电影了。.

dictionary_entries.original: is one of my favorite examples of a branded documercial done right. Reuben Wu’s surreal light-painting visuals speak for themselves. Anna Smoronova is a phenomenal DOP, balancing energy with space to breathe. You get chaotic close-ups, fast-cut FPV transitions, then suddenly you’re lingering on vast, cinematic wides. That emotional rhythm suits the thematic blend of innovation, nature, and craftsmanship perfectly. It doesn’t feel like an ad—it feels like a glimpse into something real. That’s always the tone I aim for in my own docu-style work.
dictionary_entries.translated: 这是我最喜欢的优秀品牌纪录片式广告的例子之一。 Reuben Wu 超现实的光绘视觉效果本身就说明了一切。Anna Smoronova 是一个出色的摄影指导，在动感与留白之间找到了平衡。你能看到混乱的特写镜头、快速剪辑的 FPV 转场，然后突然间你便沉浸在宽广、电影感的远景镜头中。这种情感节奏完美地契合了创新、自然和工艺相结合的主题。它不像是广告——它感觉就像瞥见了真实的事物。这正是我自己在纪实风格作品中一直追求的基调。.

dictionary_entries.original: What’s your all-time favorite TVC/Campaign from your country?
dictionary_entries.translated: 您最喜欢的本国电视广告/宣传活动是哪个？

dictionary_entries.original: Off the top of my head, Spike Jonze never fails to inspire the filmmaker in me. I grew up on his films and music videos, and his commercials are just as memorable.
dictionary_entries.translated: 凭心而论，斯派克·琼斯总是能激发我内心的电影制作人。我看着他的电影和音乐视频长大，他的广告也同样令人难忘。.

dictionary_entries.original: I love that his spots don’t take themselves too seriously. They’re unpretentious and playful—you can tell the whole crew had a blast making them. It’s branded content, but it’s not pushing tech specs or some big message. He taps into the pure joy of entertainment—something all advertisers should keep in mind, even when the brief is product-heavy.
dictionary_entries.translated: 我喜欢他的斑点并不那么认真。它们低调而有趣——你可以看出整个团队制作它们时玩得很开心。这是品牌内容，但它并没有推销技术规格或某个宏大信息。他触及了娱乐的纯粹乐趣——这是所有广告商都应该牢记的，即使在简介中产品很多的情况下也是如此。.

dictionary_entries.original: In your experience, what’s the secret to a smooth director-agency-client vibe?
dictionary_entries.translated: 在我看来，导演、代理公司和客户之间良好合作关系的秘诀是什么？

dictionary_entries.original: Think like a contractor, not an artist.
dictionary_entries.translated: 像承包商一样思考，而不是像艺术家。.

dictionary_entries.original: As filmmakers, of course we want to create work that inspires us. But don’t get distracted by personal taste and lose sight of the brief. This ain’t the indie film business. As a commercial director, you’re hired to deliver a piece that fits the client’s brand and goals.
dictionary_entries.translated: 作为电影制作人，我们当然想创造能激励我们的作品。但不要被个人品味所干扰，而忽略了简报。这里不是独立电影行业。作为一名商业导演，你被雇佣来交付一件符合客户品牌和目标的作品。.

dictionary_entries.original: If an architect is hired to design a minimalist office, their client won’t be thrilled to receive a gaudy Art Deco mockup. Same goes for us. Do your research, analyze the brief, gather references, communicate clearly, and set expectations early. Don’t wait until the PPM to pitch your wild one-take idea that’s gonna clean house at Cannes Lions.
dictionary_entries.translated: 如果聘请建筑师设计极简主义办公室，客户收到浮夸的装饰艺术效果图肯定不会满意。我们也是如此。做足功课，分析简报，收集参考资料，清晰沟通，并及早设定预期。切勿等到 PPM（项目管理）会议才提出你那个能在戛纳国际创意节大获全胜的奇思妙想。.

dictionary_entries.original: You’ll struggle to succeed if you’re tunnel-visioned by artistic ambition. Embrace the balancing act of collaboration…be creative, advocate for your decisions, but stay within the bounds of the brief.
dictionary_entries.translated: 如果艺术野心让你固执己见，你将难以成功。拥抱协作的平衡之道……要富于创造力，坚持你的决定，但要遵循项目的宗旨。.

dictionary_entries.original: What do you do when you need to recharge your creative batteries?
dictionary_entries.translated: 当我需要为我的创造力充电时，我会做些什么

dictionary_entries.original: Cooking is a good reset for me. Meditative but creative. I get to work with my hands, follow a clear recipe, and have room to improvise. I love the rhythm of prep & the reward of sharing a meal with my girlfriend. Seeing her enjoy it is gratifying, like presenting a cut to a happy client. If I hadn’t gone into filmmaking, I probably would’ve pursued the culinary arts.
dictionary_entries.translated: 烹饪对我来说是一种很好的调适。既有冥想的成分，又富有创意。我能动手操作，遵循明确的食谱，同时也有即兴发挥的空间。我喜欢准备食物的节奏，以及与女友分享一顿饭的满足感。看到她享受美食，让我觉得欣慰，就像把一件作品呈现给一个满意的客户一样。如果我没有从事电影制作，我大概会投身于烹饪艺术。.

dictionary_entries.original: That, and video games. Huge nerd for open-world RPGs, survival sims, and strategy games. The hours I’ve spent on Bethesda titles, Cities: Skylines, and Civ VII… a lot. It’s how I unwind while still engaging that problem-solving part of the brain.
dictionary_entries.translated: 还有，电子游戏。我非常痴迷于开放世界角色扮演游戏、生存模拟游戏和策略游戏。我在 Bethesda 的游戏、Cities: Skylines 和 Civ VII 上花了无数时间……非常多。这是我在放松的同时，还能调动解决问题的大脑部分的方式。.

dictionary_entries.original: Ever had a happy accident on set that turned out to be a game-changer?
dictionary_entries.translated: 在片场有过什么意想不到的“快乐意外”，最终却改变了游戏规则吗？

dictionary_entries.original: Can’t think of any accidents that turned out better than what we’d planned… but I have a fun story about the perils of prototypes & the importance of having the right support on set.
dictionary_entries.translated: 想不出有什么意外比我们计划的更好……但我有一个关于原型设备风险以及在片场拥有正确支持重要性的有趣故事。.

dictionary_entries.original: We’re in Iceland, shooting a launch film for DJI’s new industrial platform. We were documenting how Reykjavík search & rescue teams use drones in real-world emergencies. In a rush to meet our travel deadline, DJI’s engineers 3D printed plastic drone arms instead of the proper carbon fiber tubes.
dictionary_entries.translated: 我们在冰岛拍摄大疆新款工业平台的宣传片。我们正在记录雷克雅未克搜救队如何在真实的紧急情况下使用无人机。为了赶上旅行截止日期，大疆的工程师们打印了塑料无人机臂，而不是使用了合适的碳纤维管。.

dictionary_entries.original: We arrive at this tiny ramshackle S&R outpost in the middle of nowhere. We open the cases and, to my horror, the arms of every product snapped during the trip. Fortunately, our drone op was EU Creative Director Ferdinand Wolf, who’s not only a world-class pilot but an experienced engineer. By some miracle, he found an old broomstick with exactly the right diameter. He scavenged some rusty tools from the outpost, chopped it up, and reinforced the broken arms.
dictionary_entries.translated: 我们抵达了这个偏远地区一个摇摇欲坠的搜索与救援前哨站。我们打开箱子，令我惊恐的是，所有产品的臂都因为旅途颠簸而断裂了。幸运的是，我们的无人机操作员是欧盟创意总监费迪南德·沃尔夫（Ferdinand Wolf），他不仅是世界级的飞行员，还是一位经验丰富的工程师。不知怎么的，他找到了一根直径恰到好处的旧扫帚柄。他从前哨站搜刮了一些生锈的工具，把它切开了，并加固了断裂的臂。.

dictionary_entries.original: We shot four full days on a remote glacier, flying full-throttle with enterprise drones basically held together by splinters…didn’t have a single issue. We were on the brink of total failure but with Ferdi’s quick thinking and expertise, we returned with spectacular footage & a solid campaign.
dictionary_entries.translated: 我们在偏远的冰川上拍摄了四个整天，驾驶着企业无人机全速飞行，它们基本上是用木屑粘合起来的……但没有出现任何问题。我们曾处于彻底失败的边缘，但凭借 Ferdi 的快速思考和专业知识，我们带回了精彩的素材和一项成功的宣传活动。.

dictionary_entries.original: Moral of the story: if you’re working with unreleased tech, always bring an engineer.
dictionary_entries.translated: 故事的寓意：如果你在使用未发布的尖端技术，一定要带上一位工程师。.

dictionary_entries.original: Is there a mentor or person who has had a big impact on your career?
dictionary_entries.translated: 是否有导师或对您的职业生涯产生重大影响的人？

dictionary_entries.original: What’s the next big thing in commercial filmmaking? Explain.
dictionary_entries.translated: 商业电影的下一个大事件是什么？请解释。.

dictionary_entries.original: If you could direct a dream ad for any brand, which brand would you choose?
dictionary_entries.translated: 如果您能为某个品牌拍摄一部梦想中的广告，您会选择哪个品牌？

dictionary_entries.original: If you could give one tip to an aspiring TVC director, what would it be?
dictionary_entries.translated: 如果你能给一位有抱负的 TVC 导演一个建议，那会是什么？

dictionary_entries.original: What are your top 3 ads you’ve directed?
dictionary_entries.translated:
我执导的广告中，排名前三的是：
1.  [广告名称 1]
2.  [广告名称 2]
3.  [广告名称 3]

dictionary_entries.original: Director’s Brief: 12 Questions with Zacharia Lorenz at Vantage Pictures | Vantage Pictures
dictionary_entries.translated: 导演访谈：与Zacharia Lorenz在Vantage Pictures的12个问题 | Vantage Pictures

dictionary_entries.original: Director’s Brief: 12 Questions is a new Q&A series from Campaign Brief Asia that shines a spotlight on the broad mix of talent shaping Asia’s commercial directing scene. The latest installment features Vantage Pictures director Zacharia Lorenz.
dictionary_entries.translated: 导演简报：12 个问题》是 Campaign Brief Asia 推出的一个新的问答系列，聚焦于塑造亚洲商业导演舞台的各类人才。最新一期的嘉宾是 Vantage Pictures 的导演 Zacharia Lorenz。.

dictionary_entries.original: Plenty of folks have influenced me over the years, but number one would have to be my high school film teacher, Aaron Passmore. He opened my eyes to the artistry of filmmaking beyond the Hollywood blockbusters I grew up on. Until then, my exposure to cinema was pretty limited—but in his class, we watched Kubrick, Hitchcock, Bergman, Kurosawa, Wong Kar-wai… and suddenly, I saw film as something far deeper than just entertainment.
dictionary_entries.translated: 多年来，有很多人影响了我，但排名第一的无疑是我的高中电影老师亚伦·帕斯莫尔 (Aaron Passmore)。他让我看到了好莱坞大片之外的电影艺术，而我从小看的都是这类电影。在那之前，我对电影的接触非常有限——但在他的课上，我们看了库布里克、希区柯克、伯格曼、黑泽明、王家卫…… 突然间，我发现电影远不止是娱乐，它还有更深邃的内涵。.

dictionary_entries.original: His passion for the craft was infectious. He genuinely loved sharing it with his students, and that energy made a huge impression on me. I couldn’t wait to get to class—and often found myself skipping other periods just to sneak into the editing bay and learn more about FCP7. He made film feel like a world I wanted to live in, not just study from the outside. Looking back, his class was where the spark really caught fire.
dictionary_entries.translated: 他对这门手艺的热情极具感染力。他真心喜欢与学生分享，而这种能量对我产生了巨大的影响。我迫不及待地想去上课——甚至经常逃掉其他课程，偷偷溜进剪辑室，学习更多关于 FCP7 的知识。他让电影感觉就像一个我想置身其中的世界，而不仅仅是从外部去研究。回想起来，他的课才是我真正燃起激情的起点。.

dictionary_entries.original: The cynic in me says AI will continue to dominate. As global markets expand, timelines shrink, and the demand for content accelerates, AI will become more pervasive—whether for streamlining workflows or generating visuals outright. The possibilities are exciting, but there’s a real risk of it dulling critical thinking and draining joy from the craft.
dictionary_entries.translated: 我骨子里的愤世嫉俗者认为，人工智能将继续占据主导地位。随着全球市场扩张、时间不断压缩，对内容的需求加速，人工智能将变得更加普遍——无论是用于简化工作流程还是直接生成视觉内容。这些可能性令人兴奋，但同时也存在削弱批判性思维和剥夺创作乐趣的真实风险。.

dictionary_entries.original: The romantic in me hopes the pendulum swings the other way—toward authenticity. As audiences grow weary of that soulless, artificial gloss of AI-gen content, they’ll start to crave real people having real experiences. Maybe brands will recognize this and reinvest in more live-action. Maybe AI gets so good that “real” becomes irrelevant.
dictionary_entries.translated: 我内心的浪漫主义者希望钟摆会转向另一个方向——走向真实。随着观众对人工智能生成内容的这种冰冷、虚假的“光鲜感”感到厌倦，他们将开始渴望真实的人们拥有真实的体验。也许品牌会认识到这一点，并重新投资于更多的真人场景。也许人工智能会变得如此出色，“真实”将变得无关紧要。.

dictionary_entries.original: , and I was deeply moved by everything she stands for. The ethos behind Doug Tompkins, Yvon Chouinard, and the fashion empires they built—not for excess, but to fund conservation & ecological restoration.
dictionary_entries.translated: , ，我被她所代表的一切深深打动。Doug Tompkins、Yvon Chouinard 以及他们建立的时尚帝国背后的精神——不是为了挥霍，而是为了资助保护和生态恢复。.

dictionary_entries.original: There’s purity in the way they’ve redirected success toward something greater than themselves. As an outdoor enthusiast, I can’t think of a more meaningful brand to collaborate with. Stories like theirs give me hope for humanity.
dictionary_entries.translated: 他们将成功导向比自身更伟大目标的纯粹性令人钦佩。作为一名户外爱好者，我实在想不到有比这更具意义的品牌可以合作了。他们的故事让我对人类充满希望。.

dictionary_entries.original: Don’t tie your self-worth to every job.
dictionary_entries.translated: 不要把你的自我价值与每一份工作挂钩。.

dictionary_entries.original: This industry moves fast. If you measure yourself by how “creative” or “cinematic” each commercial turns out, you’ll burn out or get bitter. You ain’t always get that dream brief. Sometimes it’s about craft. Sometimes it’s about client rapport & paying the bills. Either way, treat each project professionally and just leave the duds behind when they’re done.
dictionary_entries.translated: 这个行业发展很快。如果你用“创意”或“电影感”来衡量每一支广告作品，你会筋疲力尽或变得愤世嫉俗。你并不总是能接到那个梦想中的项目。有时，这关乎手艺。有时，这关乎客户关系和支付账单。无论哪种情况，都要专业地对待每一个项目，完成后就把那些不成功的作品抛诸脑后。.

dictionary_entries.original: You’re not being hired to prove your brilliance—you’re hired to solve problems, communicate clearly, and lead a team through creative complexity. That’s your real value. Ironically, the less you chase approval, the more trust you tend to earn.
dictionary_entries.translated: 您被雇佣来是为了解决问题，清晰沟通，并带领团队克服创意上的复杂性，而不是为了证明您的才华。这才是您真正的价值所在。讽刺的是，您越是不去追求认同，您往往越能赢得信任。.

dictionary_entries.original: Directing commercials is a long game. Build trust. Stay adaptable. Keep your ego in check. And save the passion projects for when your name’s number one on the call sheet.
dictionary_entries.translated: 执导广告片是一场持久战。建立信任。保持适应性。控制你的自负。并将你的热情项目留到你的名字出现在点名单的首位时。.

dictionary_entries.original: This one’s more about the experience than the final product—though I still love the film, it’s not my best technical piece.
dictionary_entries.translated: 这次更多的是关于体验，而不是最终产品——尽管我仍然喜欢这部电影，但它并不是我技术上最好的作品。.

dictionary_entries.original: Working with Jimmy Chin was certainly a fanboy moment. I loved climbing & adventure sports growing up—so traversing the Greenland fjords for 9 days, bunking in a log cabin, scouting avi conditions, sending glaciers at sunset with some of the top ski-mountaineers…it was unforgettable. And a reminder of how much I love docu-style spots where we get to join technology, craftsmanship & natural beauty. The project had everything I care about: good people, wild locations, and a brand that trusted us to tell the story honestly.
dictionary_entries.translated: 与吉米·奇恩一起工作绝对是一个粉丝时刻。我从小就热爱攀岩和冒险运动——所以在格陵兰峡湾穿越了9天，住在一个小木屋里，侦察了雪崩条件，在日落时分与一些顶级滑雪登山者一起穿越冰川……这真是难忘。这提醒了我我多么喜欢纪录片风格的体育作品，在那里我们可以将技术、工艺和自然美景结合起来。这个项目拥有我所关心的一切：优秀的人、原始的地点，以及一个信任我们真实讲述故事的品牌。.

dictionary_entries.original: This campaign seemed doomed… right up until it wasn’t. Despite a tight budget, brutal timeline, and high-stakes technical objective, it ended up being one of my favorite documercial shoots.
dictionary_entries.translated: 这项活动似乎注定要失败……直到它没有。尽管预算紧张、时间紧迫且技术目标风险很高，但它最终成为了我最喜欢的纪录片拍摄项目之一。.

dictionary_entries.original: We had to capture authentic astrophotography shots of the moon with the OnePlus 12—no AI, no Photoshop stitching. We shot two days in California’s Alabama Hills with photographer Joshua Cripps and a skeleton crew. A week before flying, it looked grim: bad weather, buggy prototype phones, and unusable test shots. But during the tech recce, the stars just aligned. Skies cleared, OnePlus’s team got us a firmware update, Josh mapped his shots, and my DOP Martin Buzora gave me loads of new ideas for scenes/coverage.
dictionary_entries.translated: 我们不得不使用一加 12 拍摄真实的月球天文摄影照片——没有人工智能，也没有 Photoshop 拼接。在加州的阿拉巴马山，我们与摄影师 Joshua Cripps 和少量工作人员一起拍摄了两天。出发前一周，情况看起来很糟糕：天气恶劣，原型手机有问题，拍摄的照片也无法使用。但在技术考察期间，一切都恰到好处了。天空放晴，一加团队给我们更新了固件，Josh 规划了他的拍摄，我的摄影总监 Martin Buzora 也给了我很多关于场景/覆盖的新想法。.

dictionary_entries.original: The final piece feels great & genuinely demonstrates the product’s capabilities in real-world conditions. Those are the wins that stick with you.
dictionary_entries.translated: 最后的作品感觉很棒，并且真正展示了产品在真实世界中的能力。这些胜利会让你久久不能忘怀。.

dictionary_entries.original: I like to learn something new on every project & this one gave me a chance to explore the world of 3D printing, something that’s always fascinated me.
dictionary_entries.translated: 我喜欢在每个项目中学习新东西，而这个项目让我有机会探索一直让我着迷的 3D 打印世界。.

dictionary_entries.original: It was my first time working with a motion control arm… “shooting robots with robots” as we liked to say on set. We aimed for that fast, rollercoaster vibe of my favorite Microsoft spots and I think we pulled it off well, especially on a much tighter budget. The CGI was a big hurdle, but the overall experience was a big step forward in my ability to illustrate complex tech with style.
dictionary_entries.translated: 这是我第一次使用运动控制臂……就像我们在片场常说的，“用机器人射击机器人”。我们模仿了我最喜欢的微软广告那种快速、过山车般的劲头，而且我认为我们做得很好，尤其是在预算更紧张的情况下。CGI（电脑生成图像）是一个巨大的障碍，但总的来说，这次经历在我在艺术地展示复杂技术方面的能力上迈出了一大步。.

dictionary_entries.original: Director’s Brief: 12 Questions is a new Q&A series from Campaign Brief Asia that shines a spotlight on the broad mix of talent shaping Asia’s commercial directing scene. The latest installment features Vantage Pictures director Zacharia Lorenz.
dictionary_entries.translated: 导演简报：12 个问题》是 Campaign Brief Asia 推出的一个新的问答系列，聚焦于塑造亚洲商业导演舞台的各类人才。最新一期的嘉宾是 Vantage Pictures 的导演 Zacharia Lorenz。.

dictionary_entries.original: We partnered with realme to create the global launch film for its new realme C85 5G smartphone. Shot entirely in Ho Chi Minh City, the campaign turns everyday street life into a fast-paced playground of waterproof chaos—pushing the phone’s durability to its limits through a series of high-energy, disaster-filled moments. Featuring a fun, tongue-in-cheek voiceover and practical liquid effects captured on Phantom high-speed cameras, the film celebrates Southeast Asia’s working-class grit with cinematic flair, transforming the C85 into a bold, street-smart hero built for real-world endurance.
dictionary_entries.translated: 我们与realme合作，为其新款realme C85 5G智能手机打造了全球发布影片。该影片全部在胡志明市拍摄，将日常的街头生活变成了快节奏的防水混乱游乐场——通过一系列充满活力的灾难性时刻，将手机的耐用性推向极限。影片采用轻松幽默的画外音和在Phantom高速摄影机上捕捉到的实用液体特效，以电影般的风格庆祝东南亚劳动人民的坚韧不拔，将C85塑造成一款为现实世界耐用性而打造的、大胆、街头智慧的英雄。.

dictionary_entries.original: For this campaign, we brought Mammotion’s YUKA Mini 2 to life through a playful, performance-driven lens — treating a compact robot mower with the same cinematic respect you’d give a hero product twice its size.
dictionary_entries.translated: 在这次宣传活动中，我们通过一个有趣的、以性能为导向的镜头，让 Mammotion 的 YUKA Mini 2 跃然纸上--我们以对待两倍于其尺寸的英雄产品的电影般的尊重来对待这款小巧的机器人割草机。.

dictionary_entries.original: Our approach focused on clarity and character: clean visual storytelling, confident camera language, and moments of subtle humor that highlighted the product’s autonomy without overcomplicating the message. By blending lifestyle realism with polished product cinematography, we created a campaign that feels smart, approachable, and distinctly modern — showcasing intelligent automation in a way that’s both engaging and visually elevated.
dictionary_entries.translated: 我们的方法注重清晰度和特色：简洁的视觉故事、自信的镜头语言和微妙的幽默时刻，既突出了产品的自主性，又不会使信息过于复杂化。通过将生活现实主义与精良的产品摄影相融合，我们创造出了一个给人感觉聪明、平易近人、现代感十足的广告，以一种既吸引人又提升视觉效果的方式展示了智能自动化。.
詹姆斯-杜昂、约书亚-迪克森

dictionary_entries.original: Commercial spot for Bitget’s GetAgent, the AI-powered trading assistant, featuring LALIGA football star Julián Álvarez.
dictionary_entries.translated: Bitget的AI交易助手GetAgent的商业广告，由西甲球星胡利安·阿尔瓦雷斯（Julián Álvarez）出演。.

dictionary_entries.original: For this latest spot, we built a sharp visual parallel between elite sport and intelligent trading — anchored by LALIGA football superstar Julián Álvarez. Known for his instinct, precision, and ability to strike at exactly the right moment, Álvarez became the perfect metaphor for decision-making powered by intelligence.
dictionary_entries.translated: 在最新的广告片中，我们在精英体育和智能交易之间建立了鲜明的视觉平行关系--以 LALIGA 足球巨星 Julián Álvarez 为核心。阿尔瓦雷斯以他的直觉、精准和在正确时刻出击的能力而闻名，他成为了智慧决策的完美隐喻。.

dictionary_entries.original: We crafted a high-energy film that blends the cinematic language of top-tier football with a clean, tech-forward aesthetic. Through performance-driven pacing, dynamic framing, and a confident visual rhythm, the piece captures the tension of the decisive moment — where preparation meets timing, and the right call changes everything.
dictionary_entries.translated: 我们精心制作了一部充满活力的影片，将顶级足球的电影语言与简洁、前卫的科技美学融为一体。通过以表演为导向的节奏、动态框架和自信的视觉节奏，影片捕捉到了决定性时刻的紧张感--准备工作与时机的结合，正确的决定改变了一切。.
克里斯蒂娜-阿尔卡萨尔-德赫萨

dictionary_entries.original: Vantage Pictures is a high-end commercial film production company and production services company based in Vietnam and Hong Kong, specializing in TV commercials, product videos, brand films, and branded documentaries for global brands. We provide full-scale commercial production and production services in Vietnam and across Asia, working extensively with consumer tech, AI, robotics, food and beverage, and automotive companies.
dictionary_entries.translated: Vantage Pictures 是一家高端商业电影制作公司和制作服务公司，总部设在越南和香港，专门为全球品牌制作电视广告、产品宣传片、品牌宣传片和品牌纪录片。我们在越南和亚洲各地提供全面的商业制作和制作服务，广泛与消费科技、人工智能、机器人、食品饮料和汽车公司合作。.

dictionary_entries.original: Branded documentary production at Vantage Pictures blends authentic human storytelling with high-end commercial craft. We create character-driven films that explore innovation, enterprise technology, and consumer electronics through real people and real environments. Designed for brands seeking credibility and emotional depth, our documentary work combines immersive cinematography, natural performances, and disciplined production to deliver powerful long-form and mid-form films for digital, broadcast, and corporate platforms.
dictionary_entries.translated: Vantage Pictures 的品牌纪录片制作融合了真实的人物故事和高端的商业工艺。我们通过真实的人物和真实的环境，制作以人物为驱动力的影片，探索创新、企业技术和消费电子产品。我们的纪录片作品专为追求可信度和情感深度的品牌而设计，将身临其境的电影摄影、自然的表演和严谨的制作相结合，为数字、广播和企业平台提供强有力的长篇和中篇影片。.
现代汽车 - 人类进步

dictionary_entries.original: Commercial filmmaking behind the scenes at Vantage Pictures offers insight into the craft, technical execution, and creative problem-solving behind our campaigns. These articles explore cinematography, art direction, VFX, color grading, production design, and on-set decision-making that shape each project from concept to final delivery. Designed for brands, producers, and filmmakers alike, our behind-the-scenes posts reveal the production expertise and disciplined workflow that drive high-end commercial film production.
dictionary_entries.translated: Vantage Pictures 背后的商业电影制作，让您深入了解我们的宣传活动背后的工艺、技术执行和创意问题解决方案。这些文章探讨了电影摄影、艺术指导、视觉特效、调色、制作设计以及从概念到最终交付的每个项目的现场决策。我们的幕后文章专为品牌、制片人和电影制作人设计，揭示了推动高端商业电影制作的专业制作知识和严谨的工作流程。.

dictionary_entries.original: Vantage Pictures creates beauty and cosmetics commercials that elevate product storytelling through refined lighting, tactile macro cinematography, and emotionally resonant performance direction. We translate formulation, texture, and brand identity into visually striking campaigns designed for digital, broadcast, and retail platforms. Our beauty production work balances aesthetic sophistication with strategic messaging to help brands stand out in competitive global markets.
dictionary_entries.translated: Vantage Pictures 制作美容和化妆品广告，通过精致的灯光、触感微距摄影和情感共鸣的表演指导，提升产品故事性。我们将配方、质地和品牌形象转化为视觉冲击力极强的广告，专为数字、广播和零售平台而设计。我们的美容制作作品兼顾美学精致和战略信息，帮助品牌在竞争激烈的全球市场中脱颖而出。.

dictionary_entries.original: Beauty and cosmetics commercials by Vantage Pictures combine refined cinematography, product detail, and strategic brand storytelling.
dictionary_entries.translated: Vantage Pictures 制作的美容和化妆品广告结合了精致的摄影、产品细节和战略性的品牌故事。.

dictionary_entries.original: Vantage Pictures is a global commercial film production company creating cinematic brand films and product launches for technology and international brands.
dictionary_entries.translated: Vantage Pictures 是一家全球商业影像制作公司，为科技企业和国际品牌制作品牌影片、商业广告和产品发布影片。

dictionary_entries.original: Vantage Pictures is a globally operating commercial film production company creating cinematic brand films, product launch campaigns, and high-impact technology commercials for ambitious companies worldwide. We collaborate with fast-growing innovators and established global brands to craft visually refined, strategically grounded films that elevate product storytelling and brand identity.
dictionary_entries.translated: Vantage Pictures 是一家面向全球市场的商业影像制作公司，专注于品牌影片、产品发布广告以及科技类商业广告制作。我们与快速成长的创新企业和成熟的全球品牌合作，通过视觉精致、策略清晰的影片提升品牌故事与产品价值。

dictionary_entries.original: A core specialty of our studio is helping Asian technology brands — particularly from China — connect with Western audiences through premium, internationally positioned campaigns. From robotics and AI to consumer electronics and next-generation hardware, we translate complex innovation into emotionally resonant visual storytelling.
dictionary_entries.translated: 我们的核心优势之一，是帮助亚洲科技品牌（尤其是中国企业）通过国际化水准的广告影片，与欧美市场建立更有效的沟通。

dictionary_entries.original: Beyond technology, our portfolio spans lifestyle, automotive, energy, sport, and documentary-driven brand films — all executed with disciplined production standards, cinematic craft, and cross-border expertise.
dictionary_entries.translated: 除了科技领域，我们的作品还涵盖生活方式、汽车、能源、体育以及纪录片风格的品牌影片。所有项目均以严谨的制作标准、电影级视觉语言以及跨境制作经验完成。
了解更多关于我们的信息

dictionary_entries.original: Commercial film crew insights from Vantage Pictures spotlight the directors, producers, cinematographers, editors, and specialists who shape our productions. These posts feature perspectives from our founders, in-house team, and trusted freelance collaborators, sharing practical knowledge about filmmaking, production workflows, and industry trends. Through firsthand experience and professional insight, this category reflects the expertise and collaborative culture behind our commercial film production company.
dictionary_entries.translated: 来自 Vantage Pictures 的商业电影摄制组洞察力，聚焦那些影响我们制作的导演、制片人、摄影师、剪辑师和专家。这些文章从我们的创始人、内部团队和值得信赖的自由合作者的角度出发，分享有关电影制作、制作工作流程和行业趋势的实用知识。这类文章通过第一手经验和专业见解，反映了我们商业电影制作公司背后的专业知识和协作文化。.

dictionary_entries.original: Vantage Pictures produces commercial campaigns and branded films for companies operating in Singapore’s innovation-driven market. We combine strategic clarity with cinematic craft to deliver polished campaigns tailored to regional and international audiences. Our Singapore productions emphasize efficiency, refined visual language, and disciplined execution across technology, finance, and lifestyle sectors.
dictionary_entries.translated: Vantage Pictures 为在新加坡创新驱动型市场运营的公司制作商业广告系列和品牌影片。我们将战略清晰度与电影制作工艺相结合，为区域和国际受众量身打造精美的广告系列。我们在新加坡的制作在科技、金融和生活方式领域注重效率、精致的视觉语言和严谨的执行。.

dictionary_entries.original: Singapore commercial video production by Vantage Pictures delivers refined, cinematic campaigns for regional and global brands.
dictionary_entries.translated: Vantage Pictures 制作的新加坡商业视频，为区域和全球品牌打造精炼的影院级广告。.

dictionary_entries.original: Based in Ho Chi Minh City, Vantage Pictures produces high-end commercial campaigns and branded films for leading Vietnamese companies across finance, FMCG, and consumer brands. We combine international production standards with local insight, delivering cinematic storytelling and disciplined execution tailored to Vietnam’s rapidly evolving market.
dictionary_entries.translated: Vantage Pictures 总部位于胡志明市，为越南领先的金融、快速消费品和消费品牌公司制作高端商业广告和品牌宣传片。我们将国际制作标准与本土洞察相结合，提供电影般的叙事和严谨的执行，以适应越南快速发展的市场。.

dictionary_entries.original: Vietnam commercial video production by Vantage Pictures delivers cinematic campaigns for finance, FMCG, and consumer brands.
dictionary_entries.translated: 越南商业视频制作 Vantage Pictures 为金融、快速消费品和消费品牌提供电影级广告宣传。.

dictionary_entries.original: Vantage Pictures produces consumer electronics commercials that highlight design, functionality, and user experience through clean, modern visual storytelling. From smartphones and laptops to smart devices and accessories, we craft product-focused campaigns that combine macro detail, lifestyle integration, and polished motion graphics. Our electronics production work delivers clarity, sophistication, and measurable commercial impact.
dictionary_entries.translated: Vantage Pictures 制作消费类电子产品广告，通过简洁、现代的视觉故事突出设计、功能和用户体验。从智能手机和笔记本电脑到智能设备和配件，我们精心制作以产品为中心的宣传片，将宏观细节、生活方式整合和精良的动态图形结合在一起。我们的电子产品制作作品清晰、精致，具有可衡量的商业影响力。.

dictionary_entries.original: Consumer electronics commercials by Vantage Pictures combine product precision, lifestyle storytelling, and high-end cinematography.
dictionary_entries.translated: Vantage Pictures 制作的消费电子产品广告集产品精确性、生活方式故事性和高端摄影于一体。.

dictionary_entries.original: Vantage Pictures produces FMCG (fast-moving consumer goods) commercials designed for speed, clarity, and visual impact. From food and beverage campaigns to household and lifestyle products, we create engaging short-form and brand-driven films that highlight product benefits while reinforcing long-term brand positioning. Our FMCG production process prioritizes efficiency, strong visual hooks, and disciplined execution across regional and global markets.
dictionary_entries.translated: Vantage Pictures 制作快速消费品（FMCG）广告片，旨在提高速度、清晰度和视觉冲击力。从食品和饮料广告到家居和生活用品，我们制作引人入胜的短片和以品牌为导向的影片，在突出产品优势的同时强化长期的品牌定位。我们的快速消费品制作流程将效率、强烈的视觉冲击力和跨区域及全球市场的严格执行放在首位。.

dictionary_entries.original: FMCG commercials by Vantage Pictures deliver fast-paced, visually engaging campaigns for food, beverage, and lifestyle brands.
dictionary_entries.translated: Vantage Pictures 制作的快速消费品广告片为食品、饮料和生活方式品牌提供快节奏、有视觉冲击力的宣传活动。.

dictionary_entries.original: Vantage Pictures produces AI and robotics films that communicate advanced engineering with clarity and cinematic impact. We craft product launches, branded documentaries, and commercial campaigns that make intelligent systems accessible and visually engaging. Our AI and robotics productions combine technical precision, motion design, and narrative structure to translate innovation into powerful visual storytelling.
dictionary_entries.translated: Vantage Pictures 制作人工智能和机器人影片，以清晰的画面和电影效果传达先进的工程技术。我们精心制作产品发布、品牌纪录片和商业宣传片，使智能系统易于理解并具有视觉吸引力。我们的人工智能和机器人作品结合了技术精度、动作设计和叙事结构，将创新转化为强大的视觉故事。.

dictionary_entries.original: AI and robotics films by Vantage Pictures translate advanced technology into clear, cinematic brand narratives.
dictionary_entries.translated: Vantage Pictures 制作的人工智能和机器人影片将先进技术转化为清晰、电影化的品牌叙事。.

dictionary_entries.original: Vantage Pictures crafts hospitality and tourism films that capture atmosphere, experience, and destination identity. From luxury resorts to boutique hotels and travel campaigns, we translate physical spaces into emotionally engaging visual narratives. Our hospitality productions combine cinematic landscapes, refined interior cinematography, and lifestyle storytelling to help brands inspire travel and build lasting perception.
dictionary_entries.translated: Vantage Pictures 精心制作酒店和旅游宣传片，捕捉氛围、体验和目的地特征。从豪华度假村到精品酒店和旅游宣传活动，我们将实体空间转化为富有情感的视觉叙事。我们的酒店产品将电影景观、精致的室内摄影和生活方式故事相结合，帮助品牌激发旅游灵感并建立持久的印象。.

dictionary_entries.original: Hospitality and tourism films by Vantage Pictures capture atmosphere and destination identity through cinematic storytelling.
dictionary_entries.translated: Vantage Pictures 制作的酒店和旅游宣传片通过电影故事捕捉氛围和目的地特征。.

dictionary_entries.original: Vantage Pictures specializes in technology commercial production for consumer electronics, AI, robotics, software, and advanced hardware brands. We transform complex innovation into visually compelling narratives that balance technical clarity with emotional impact. From product launches to branded documentaries and commercial spots, our tech productions combine strategic messaging, cinematic craft, and disciplined execution to help forward-thinking companies communicate with confidence.
dictionary_entries.translated: Vantage Pictures 专注于消费电子、人工智能、机器人、软件和先进硬件品牌的技术商业制作。我们将复杂的创新转化为引人入胜的视觉叙事，在技术清晰度和情感冲击力之间取得平衡。从产品发布到品牌纪录片和商业广告，我们的科技产品结合了战略信息、电影制作工艺和严谨的执行力，帮助具有前瞻性思维的公司自信地进行沟通。.

dictionary_entries.original: Technology commercials and product launch films by Vantage Pictures turn complex innovation into clear, cinematic brand storytelling.
dictionary_entries.translated: Vantage Pictures 制作的技术广告和产品发布影片将复杂的创新转化为清晰、电影化的品牌故事。.

dictionary_entries.original: Vantage Pictures develops financial services campaigns that communicate trust, innovation, and accessibility through clear and compelling storytelling. We produce commercial spots, brand films, and product explainers for banks, fintech companies, and digital payment platforms, translating complex services into confident, human-centered narratives. Our finance video production combines strategic clarity with polished cinematic execution to build credibility and engagement.
dictionary_entries.translated: Vantage Pictures 开发金融服务活动，通过清晰、引人入胜的故事讲述，传达信任、创新和可及性。我们为银行、金融科技公司和数字支付平台制作商业广告、品牌宣传片和产品说明，将复杂的服务转化为自信的、以人为本的叙述。我们的金融视频制作将清晰的战略与精良的电影执行相结合，以建立可信度和参与度。.

dictionary_entries.original: Financial services videos by Vantage Pictures communicate trust and innovation through strategic, cinematic storytelling.
dictionary_entries.translated: Vantage Pictures 制作的金融服务视频通过战略性、电影化的故事讲述方式传递信任和创新。.

dictionary_entries.original: Vantage Pictures produces high-performance automotive commercials that combine cinematic storytelling with precision engineering visuals. From dynamic driving sequences to studio-based product reveals, we craft automotive films that highlight innovation, performance, and brand identity. Our automotive production work blends technical accuracy, controlled lighting, motion design, and disciplined execution to deliver powerful campaigns for manufacturers, mobility brands, and next-generation transportation companies.
dictionary_entries.translated: Vantage Pictures 制作高性能的汽车广告片，将电影故事与精密工程视觉效果相结合。从动态驾驶片段到演播室产品展示，我们精心制作的汽车宣传片突出创新、性能和品牌形象。我们的汽车制作工作融合了技术精度、灯光控制、动作设计和严谨的执行，为制造商、移动品牌和新一代运输公司提供强大的宣传活动。.

dictionary_entries.original: Automotive commercials by Vantage Pictures combine cinematic storytelling, precision visuals, and high-end production for global mobility brands.
dictionary_entries.translated: Vantage Pictures 为全球汽车品牌制作的汽车广告结合了电影故事、精确视觉效果和高端制作。.

dictionary_entries.original: Vantage Pictures produces cinematic fashion films that merge visual artistry with commercial precision. From editorial-style campaigns to brand-driven launch films, we create fashion content that captures movement, texture, and identity with clarity and impact. Our fashion productions combine elevated lighting, dynamic camera language, and intentional creative direction to deliver bold visual statements for modern fashion brands.
dictionary_entries.translated: Vantage Pictures 制作的电影式时尚影片将视觉艺术与商业精确性融为一体。从社论风格的宣传片到以品牌为导向的发布影片，我们制作的时尚内容能清晰地捕捉运动、质感和身份。我们的时尚作品结合了高光照明、动态镜头语言和有意的创意指导，为现代时尚品牌提供大胆的视觉陈述。.

dictionary_entries.original: Fashion films by Vantage Pictures blend editorial style and commercial precision to deliver bold, cinematic brand campaigns.
dictionary_entries.translated: Vantage Pictures 的时尚影片融合了编辑风格和商业精准度，提供大胆、电影化的品牌宣传。.

dictionary_entries.original: Vantage Pictures produces commercial campaigns and branded films for US-based companies and international brands targeting the American market. Our productions balance cinematic storytelling with disciplined commercial strategy, delivering impactful product launches, technology films, and brand-driven campaigns designed for digital and broadcast distribution.
dictionary_entries.translated: Vantage Pictures 为美国公司和面向美国市场的国际品牌制作商业广告活动和品牌宣传片。我们的制作在电影叙事和严谨的商业策略之间取得平衡，交付具有影响力的产品发布、技术宣传片以及为数字和广播渠道设计的品牌驱动型广告活动。.

dictionary_entries.original: US commercial video production by Vantage Pictures delivers cinematic brand films and product launches for modern companies.
dictionary_entries.translated: Vantage Pictures 提供的美国商业视频制作服务，为现代企业打造影院级品牌影片和产品发布。.

dictionary_entries.original: Vantage Pictures delivers high-end commercial and branded content production for Chinese brands expanding domestically and internationally. With extensive experience working with leading consumer tech and electronics companies, we combine global production standards with a deep understanding of regional market expectations. Our China productions focus on precision execution, cinematic storytelling, and scalable campaigns designed for digital and broadcast platforms.
dictionary_entries.translated: Vantage Pictures 为拓展国内和国际市场的中国品牌提供高端商业和品牌内容制作服务。凭借与领先消费科技和电子产品公司合作的丰富经验，我们将全球制作标准与对区域市场期望的深刻理解相结合。我们在中国的制作注重精准执行、电影化故事讲述，以及为数字和广播平台设计的可扩展活动。.

dictionary_entries.original: Video production in China by Vantage Pictures delivers cinematic commercial campaigns for leading consumer tech and global brands.
dictionary_entries.translated: Vantage Pictures 在中国的视频制作为领先的消费科技和全球品牌提供电影般的商业宣传。.

dictionary_entries.original: Vantage Pictures creates drone product videos and commercial campaigns that showcase performance, reliability, and real-world application. Combining aerial expertise with high-end cinematography, we produce films that demonstrate flight capability, engineering precision, and use-case storytelling. Our drone productions balance technical detail with cinematic energy to position brands as leaders in aerial innovation.
dictionary_entries.translated: Vantage Pictures 制作无人机产品视频和商业宣传片，展示其性能、可靠性和实际应用。我们将航空专业技术与高端电影摄影相结合，制作出能够展示飞行能力、工程精度和使用案例故事的影片。我们的无人机制作兼顾技术细节和电影能量，将品牌定位为空中创新的领导者。.

dictionary_entries.original: Drone product videos by Vantage Pictures showcase aerial performance, engineering precision, and cinematic storytelling.
dictionary_entries.translated: Vantage Pictures 制作的无人机产品视频展示了空中性能、工程精度和电影故事。.

dictionary_entries.original: Vantage Pictures delivers high-energy waterproof chaos in global campaign for the new realme C85 smartphone
dictionary_entries.translated: Vantage Pictures 在全新 realme C85 智能手机的全球宣传活动中提供高能防水混沌产品

dictionary_entries.original: With a playful superhero tone and the vibrant street culture of Vietnam, realme’s latest smartphone campaign by Vantage Pictures pushes durability and waterproofing to the extreme.
dictionary_entries.translated: realme的最新智能手机广告由Vantage Pictures拍摄，以俏皮的超级英雄为基调，展现越南生机勃勃的街头文化，将耐用性和防水性推向极致。.

dictionary_entries.original: International production house Vantage Pictures has unveiled an exhilarating global launch film for the new realme C85 5G, a device positioned as the ultimate companion for young, hardworking users who spend their days outdoors. Shot entirely in Ho Chi Minh City, the spot highlights the C85’s durability, waterproof capabilities and long-lasting battery through a series of high-energy disaster-filled scenarios designed to push the phone to its limits.
dictionary_entries.translated: 国际制作公司 Vantage Pictures 为新款 realme C85 5G 推出了一部激动人心的全球发布影片。这款手机定位为专为户外辛勤工作的年轻用户打造的终极伴侣。影片全程在胡志明市拍摄，通过一系列充满高能量的灾难场景，将手机的耐用性、防水能力和超长电池续航能力推向极限，充分展现了 C85 的强大性能。.

dictionary_entries.original: , co-founder of Vantage Pictures, and shot by Singaporean cinematographer Kelvin Chew, the campaign taps into Southeast Asia’s working-class spirit while maintaining a premium cinematic feel. Set against the vibrant streets of Vietnam, from roadside eateries to narrow tube houses and the constant flow of motorbikes, the film captures the region’s unique rhythm and color, blended with English signage to keep it globally accessible.
dictionary_entries.translated: , __Vantage Pictures__的联合创始人，并由新加坡摄影师Kelvin Chew掌镜，此次宣传活动旨在激发东南亚劳动阶层的精神，同时保持高品质的电影感。影片以越南充满活力的街景为背景，从路边餐馆到狭窄的筒子楼，再到川流不息的摩托车流，捕捉了该地区独特的节奏和色彩，并融入了英文标识，使其具有全球可及性。.

dictionary_entries.original: “Our client wanted the phone to feel like a superhero, something that could take on anything,” says Lorenz. “So we leaned into a playful, self-aware tone for the voiceover, almost like a kid bragging on a playground. The phone talks big because it really can back it up.”
dictionary_entries.translated: “我们的客户希望这款手机感觉像个超级英雄，什么都能应付，”Lorenz说。“所以我们采用了俏皮、自我意识的语调来配音，就像一个孩子在操场吹牛一样。这款手机说大话是有底气的。”

dictionary_entries.original: To emphasize waterproofing and durability, the team crafted a string of chaotic set pieces involving splashes, spills, storms and everyday work-site hazards. The visual language is fast, bold and kinetic, filled with dynamic camera movement, speed ramps and slow-motion liquid shots that heighten the sense of playful destruction.
dictionary_entries.translated: 为了强调防水性和耐用性，团队创作了一系列混乱的场景，包括飞溅、泼洒、风暴以及日常的工地危险。视觉语言快速、大胆且充满动感，充满了动态的镜头运动、变速切换和慢动作液体拍摄，从而增强了充满乐趣的破坏感。.

dictionary_entries.original: Behind the scenes, the production leaned heavily into fast, flexible camera movement to keep pace with a packed two-day schedule. The team relied on Steadicam not only for smooth motion but also for speed, allowing them to move quickly between setups without time-consuming dolly tracks or jib rigs. Outdoor scenes were brought to life with full rain machines that soaked an entire Vietnamese street, creating controlled downpours that blended naturally with the city’s chaotic energy.
dictionary_entries.translated: 幕后制作人员大量运用了快速、灵活的摄影机运动，以跟上紧凑的两天拍摄日程。团队不仅依赖斯坦尼康（Steadicam）来实现平稳的运动，还依靠它来提高效率，从而能够快速地在不同布景之间切换，而无需耗时安装轨道车或摇臂。室外场景通过大型造雨机得以生动呈现，淋湿了整条越南街道，制造出可控的倾盆大雨，与城市混乱的活力自然地融为一体。.

dictionary_entries.original: The tight production timeline also meant there was no opportunity for elaborate 3D animation. Everything had to be created in-camera, with only minimal VFX for cleanups and simple 2D enhancements. This approach placed even more weight on the practical effects team, who engineered custom liquid rigs to launch the phone into precise mid-air collisions with timed streams of water. These sequences were captured on a Phantom high-speed camera at 1000 FPS, resulting in dramatic slow-motion impacts that showcase the C85’s waterproof design with striking clarity. Pulling off this level of practical work on such a compressed schedule became one of the campaign’s biggest technical achievements.
dictionary_entries.translated: 紧张的制作时间也意味着没有机会进行复杂的 3D 动画制作。所有内容都必须在相机内完成，只有极少的视觉特效用于清理和简单的 2D 增强。这种方法给实拍特效团队带来了更大的压力，他们设计了定制的液体装置，以精确地将手机发射到空中，与定时喷射的水流发生碰撞。这些场景使用 Phantom 高速摄像机以每秒 1000 帧的速度拍摄，产生了惊人的慢动作冲击效果，清晰地展示了 C85 的防水设计。在如此紧迫的时间内完成如此高水平的实拍工作，成为了此次活动最大的技术成就之一。.

dictionary_entries.original: “I wanted the film to feel energetic, fun and unapologetically messy,” Lorenz adds. “The C85 is built for people who work with their hands, mechanics, delivery riders, street vendors. We wanted to honor that world while elevating it with premium cinematography and stylized action.”
dictionary_entries.translated: “我希望这部电影感觉充满活力、有趣且毫不掩饰地混乱，”洛伦兹补充道。“C85是为那些靠双手工作的人，比如机械师、送货员、街头小贩而打造的。我们希望在用高端的摄影和风格化的动作来提升他们世界的同时，也向他们的世界致敬。”

dictionary_entries.original: The client’s openness to showcasing Southeast Asian culture helped shape the aesthetic. Bustling street life, tiny plastic tables, smoky food stalls, busy local markets and the everyday grind of outdoor work become the backdrop for the phone’s heroic resilience. The result is a campaign that feels rooted, authentic and globally relatable.
dictionary_entries.translated: 客户愿意展示东南亚文化，这有助于塑造了此次广告的整体美学。熙熙攘攘的街头生活、小小的塑料桌椅、烟雾缭绕的食摊、繁忙的当地市场以及户外工作的日常辛劳，都成为了这款手机顽强耐用、表现出色的背景。最终，这个广告系列给人一种根植于本地、真实可信且具有全球共鸣的感觉。.

dictionary_entries.original: Bitget, the world’s largest Universal Exchange (UEX), has launched a three-film campaign starring Julián Álvarez, fusing elite-level football with next-generation trading technology.
dictionary_entries.translated: 全球最大的通用交易所（UEX）Bitget 推出了由胡利安-阿尔瓦雷斯（Julián Álvarez）主演的三部电影宣传片，将精英足球与新一代交易技术完美融合。.

dictionary_entries.original: Created in collaboration with LALIGA and produced by Vantage Pictures, the campaign brings Bitget’s flagship products – Onchain, GetAgent, and Universal Exchange (UEX) – to life through Álvarez’s unmistakable on-pitch intensity. The films use Alvarez’s on-field precision, anticipation, and strategic timing as metaphors for how modern traders can navigate digital markets more effectively.
dictionary_entries.translated: 该广告与 LALIGA 合作创作，由 Vantage Pictures 制作，通过 Álvarez 在球场上无与伦比的表现力，将 Bitget 的旗舰产品 Onchain、GetAgent 和 Universal Exchange (UEX) 展现得栩栩如生。影片以阿尔瓦雷斯在球场上的精准度、预见性和战略时机为隐喻，讲述了现代交易者如何更有效地驾驭数字市场。.

dictionary_entries.original: Directed by Paul Moore, the films were shot in Madrid, Spain under an extremely tight schedule: Álvarez was available for just four hours to capture all his shots. The team relied on extensive rehearsals with a stand-in, and a tightly engineered shot plan to ensure every take counted.
dictionary_entries.translated: 影片由 Paul Moore 执导，在西班牙马德里拍摄，时间非常紧迫：Álvarez 只有四个小时的时间来拍摄所有镜头。拍摄团队与替身进行了大量排练，并制定了严密的拍摄计划，以确保每一个镜头都有价值。.

dictionary_entries.original: “We had one or two takes per shot,” Moore explains. “It was high-pressure filmmaking – but with total preparation and a locked plan, everything moved with precision.”
dictionary_entries.translated: “摩尔解释说：”我们每个镜头都要拍摄一到两次。“这是一次高压拍摄--但有了充分的准备和锁定的计划，一切都进行得非常精确。”

dictionary_entries.original: The campaign not only showcases Bitget’s most advanced trading tools, but also deepens its partnership with LALIGA, reinforcing the brand’s growing credibility at the intersection of world-class sport and financial technology.
dictionary_entries.translated: 此次活动不仅展示了 Bitget 最先进的交易工具，还加深了与 LALIGA 的合作关系，巩固了该品牌在世界级体育和金融技术交汇点日益增长的信誉。.

dictionary_entries.original: The Mammotion YUKA Mini 2 robot mower delivers effortless automated lawn care in this cinematic product campaign produced by Vantage Pictures.
dictionary_entries.translated: Mammotion YUKA Mini 2 机器人割草机在这部由 Vantage Pictures 制作的电影产品宣传片中实现了毫不费力的自动草坪护理。.

dictionary_entries.original:
For this campaign, we brought Mammotion’s YUKA Mini 2 to life through a playful, performance-driven lens — treating a compact robot mower with the same cinematic respect you’d give a hero product twice its size.

Our approach focused on clarity and character: clean visual storytelling, confident camera language, and moments of subtle humor that highlighted the product’s autonomy without overcomplicating the message. By blending lifestyle realism with polished product cinematography, we created a campaign that feels smart, approachable, and distinctly modern — showcasing intelligent automation in a way that’s both engaging and visually elevated.
dictionary_entries.translated:
在这次宣传活动中，我们通过一个有趣的、以性能为导向的镜头，让 Mammotion 的 YUKA Mini 2 跃然纸上--以电影的手法对待一个小巧的机器人割草机，就像对待一个比它大一倍的英雄产品一样。

我们的拍摄方法注重清晰度和个性：简洁的视觉故事、自信的镜头语言和微妙的幽默时刻，既突出了产品的自主性，又不会使信息过于复杂化。通过将生活现实主义与精良的产品摄影相融合，我们创造出了一个让人感觉聪明、平易近人、现代感十足的广告，以一种既吸引人又提升视觉效果的方式展示了智能自动化。.

dictionary_entries.original: Dive into the Bitget crypto campaign production where Álvarez's skills redefine modern trading in dynamic new films.
dictionary_entries.translated: 深入了解 Bitget 的加密货币活动制作，阿尔瓦雷斯的技能在动态新影片中重新定义了现代交易。.

dictionary_entries.original: Created in collaboration with LALIGA and produced by Vantage Pictures, the campaign brings Bitget’s flagship products – Onchain, GetAgent, and Universal Exchange (UEX) – to life through Álvarez’s unmistakable on-pitch intensity. The films use Alvarez’s on-field precision, anticipation, and strategic timing as metaphors for how modern traders can navigate digital markets more effectively. Directed by Paul Moore, the films were shot in Madrid, Spain under an extremely tight schedule: Álvarez was available for just four hours to capture all his shots. The team relied on extensive rehearsals with a stand-in, and a tightly engineered shot plan to ensure every take counted.
dictionary_entries.translated: 该广告与 LALIGA 合作，由 Vantage Pictures 制作，通过阿尔瓦雷斯无与伦比的球场表现力，将 Bitget 的旗舰产品 Onchain、GetAgent 和 Universal Exchange（UEX）展现得栩栩如生。影片以阿尔瓦雷斯在场上的精准度、预见性和战略时机为隐喻，讲述了现代交易者如何更有效地驾驭数字市场。影片由 Paul Moore 执导，在西班牙马德里拍摄，时间非常紧迫：Álvarez 只有四个小时的时间来拍摄所有镜头。拍摄团队与替身进行了大量排练，并制定了严密的拍摄计划，以确保每一个镜头都有价值。.

dictionary_entries.translated: 世界杯冠军胡利安-阿尔瓦雷斯（Julián Álvarez）出演了 Bitget 的 GetAgent 广告，这是由 Vantage Pictures 制作的全球加密货币交易广告。.

dictionary_entries.original:
For this latest spot, we built a sharp visual parallel between elite sport and intelligent trading — anchored by LALIGA football superstar Julián Álvarez. Known for his instinct, precision, and ability to strike at exactly the right moment, Álvarez became the perfect metaphor for decision-making powered by intelligence.

We crafted a high-energy film that blends the cinematic language of top-tier football with a clean, tech-forward aesthetic. Through performance-driven pacing, dynamic framing, and a confident visual rhythm, the piece captures the tension of the decisive moment — where preparation meets timing, and the right call changes everything.
dictionary_entries.translated:
在最新的广告片中，我们在精英体育和智能交易之间建立了鲜明的视觉平行关系--以 LALIGA 足球巨星 Julián Álvarez 为核心。阿尔瓦雷斯以他的直觉、精准和在正确时刻出击的能力而闻名，他成为了智慧决策的完美隐喻。

我们精心制作了一部充满活力的影片，将顶级足球的电影语言与简洁、前卫的科技美学融为一体。通过以表演为导向的节奏、动态框架和自信的视觉节奏，影片捕捉到了决定性时刻的紧张感--准备与时机的结合，正确的决定改变了一切。.

dictionary_entries.original: Download our Vietnam filming location guide featuring diverse commercial shoot locations and production insights for international crews.
