dictionary_entries.original: Download our Vietnam Location Guide, a curated production resource designed for international agencies, producers, and commercial film teams planning shoots across the country. This guide highlights diverse filming locations in Vietnam — from modern cityscapes and industrial zones to tropical coastlines, mountain landscapes, and remote natural environments — helping you evaluate creative possibilities before your production begins.
dictionary_entries.translated: 下载我们的《越南外景拍摄指南》，这是一份专为国际机构、制片人和计划在越南拍摄的商业电影团队设计的制作资源。本指南重点介绍越南的各种拍摄地点--从现代化的城市景观和工业区到热带海岸线、山地景观和偏远的自然环境--帮助您在制作开始前评估创意的可能性。.

dictionary_entries.original: Created by the team at Vantage Pictures, the guide reflects real-world production experience supporting global commercial shoots throughout Vietnam.
dictionary_entries.translated: 该指南由 Vantage Pictures 团队制作，反映了在越南各地支持全球商业拍摄的实际制作经验。.

dictionary_entries.original: Commercial spot production at Vantage Pictures focuses on high-impact, short-form campaigns designed for entertainment, engagement, and brand recall. From 30 to 90-second television and digital commercials, we create visually compelling spots that prioritize storytelling, tone, and audience connection over product-heavy messaging. With a commercial film production approach grounded in strong concepts, precise pacing, and cinematic execution, our team delivers memorable campaigns that perform across broadcast, online, and social platforms.
dictionary_entries.translated: Vantage Pictures 的商业广告制作专注于高影响力、短篇幅的广告活动，旨在吸引娱乐、互动和品牌记忆。从 30 到 90 秒的电视和数字广告，我们创造具有视觉吸引力的广告，重视故事叙述、情感基调和观众连接，而非产品信息堆砌。我们的团队以实实在在的创意、精准的节奏和电影般的执行力作为商业影片制作的基础，交付在广播、线上和社交平台上表现出色的难忘广告活动。.

dictionary_entries.original: Product video production for tech brands is a specialty of Vantage Pictures, focused on translating advanced features into clear, cinematic storytelling. From smartphones and consumer electronics to robotics and smart hardware, we craft product-focused films that balance technical precision with visual impact. Our approach combines strategic messaging, refined cinematography, and commercial-level production execution to create launch videos and product campaigns that elevate positioning while clearly communicating performance and innovation.
dictionary_entries.translated: Vantage Pictures专注于为科技品牌制作产品视频，将先进的功能转化为清晰、电影化的叙事。从智能手机、消费电子产品到机器人和智能硬件，我们精心打造以产品为中心、兼具技术精准度和视觉冲击力的影片。我们的方法结合了战略信息传递、精湛的摄影和商业级别的制作执行，以创作上市视频和产品宣传活动，提升品牌定位，同时清晰地传达性能和创新。.

dictionary_entries.original: Learn about the making of the OPPO Mother's Day commercial, where childhood memories meet innovative technology for a fun twist.
dictionary_entries.translated: 了解 OPPO 母亲节广告的制作过程，让童年记忆与创新科技相映成趣。.

dictionary_entries.original: “I felt that utilising this trend would serve numerous purposes. First off, it would add an element of fun to the video, as often content centered around Mother’s Day is very sentimental and emotional,” he says. “We wanted to be a bit more lighthearted in our approach and the device of recreating childhood moments allowed the family to be more playful. Secondly, we wanted to show off the OPPO Reno7 Pro’s portrait mode. Showcasing old family photos side-by-side with the images taken on the OPPO Reno7 Pro illustrated the quality of the Portrait Mode feature in a natural way that ensured we didn’t have to call out specific features or take away from the story. Finally, we wanted to speak to OPPO’s target audience in a language that they understand. It seems every other month there is a new social media trend, this is a staple of the way in which Gen-Z audiences communicate with each other. Tapping into one of these trends allowed us to align the OPPO brand and their younger target demographics.”
dictionary_entries.translated: “我觉得利用这一趋势可以达到很多目的。首先，它可以为视频增添趣味元素，因为围绕母亲节的内容往往非常感伤和情绪化，”他说。“我们想采用更轻松愉快的方式，而重现童年时光的装置可以让这个家庭更有趣。其次，我们想展示 OPPO Reno7 Pro 的人像模式。将家庭老照片与 OPPO Reno7 Pro 拍摄的照片并排展示，以一种自然的方式诠释了人像模式功能的品质，确保我们不必强调特定功能，也不会脱离故事情节。最后，我们希望用 OPPO 目标受众所能理解的语言与他们对话。似乎每隔一个月就会出现一种新的社交媒体趋势，这是新一代受众相互交流的主要方式。利用这些趋势之一，我们可以将 OPPO 品牌与他们的年轻目标人群结合起来”。”

dictionary_entries.translated: 了解 Vantage Pictures 如何制作华硕商用的 “升级到不可思议 ”广告，这是一部由 Byron McKenzie 执导的动态广告片。.

dictionary_entries.original: Leading technology brand ASUS Business has launched its latest campaign, ‘Upgrade to Incredible’. The spots take the viewer on a journey across different business industries, exploring the incredible possibilities of growth when companies upgrade with ASUS.
dictionary_entries.translated: 领先的技术品牌华硕商用推出了最新广告 ‘升级到不可思议’。广告片将带领观众穿越不同的商业行业，探索企业与华硕一起升级所带来的难以置信的增长可能性。.

dictionary_entries.original: ECD at Byron McKenzie Kiefer McKenzie says: “Rather than just seeing upgrading as a chore to improve hardware, the campaign aims to get key decision makers to see it as an opportunity to improve everything. It’s a way for ASUS Business to begin a conversation with their potential customers and to get them to redefine what ‘upgrading’ can mean to their business.”
dictionary_entries.translated: Byron McKenzie 的 ECD Kiefer McKenzie 说：“这次活动的目的是让关键决策者将升级视为改善一切的机会，而不是仅仅将升级视为改善硬件的苦差事。这是华硕商用与潜在客户展开对话的一种方式，让他们重新定义'升级'对企业的意义‘。’

dictionary_entries.original: The ‘Upgrade to Incredible’ campaign will be launched through various digital channels, including online video and social media.
dictionary_entries.translated: 升级到不可思议 ‘活动将通过各种数字渠道推出，包括在线视频和社交媒体。.

dictionary_entries.original: Director Alexis Odiowei opens a window into a couple’s world. In this new commercial spot for the OnePlus Y-Series smart TV, we follow the journey of a young couple as they experience their first months living together.
dictionary_entries.translated: 导演 Alexis Odiowei 为我们打开了一扇通往情侣世界的窗户。在这支 OnePlus Y 系列智能电视的全新广告片中，我们跟随一对年轻夫妇一起经历了他们共同生活的第一个月。.

dictionary_entries.original: These little snapshots throughout the couple’s relationship felt like universal moments to which audiences of any cultural background could relate. However, focusing on such a ubiquitous story also came with its own challenges… The execution had to feel authentic & believable, as the subject matter is so familiar. The Vantage Pictures team carried out extensive casting in Cape Town, South Africa to find the perfect couple that would bring this story to life. The result was natural chemistry between the two lead characters that speaks for itself on screen.
dictionary_entries.translated: 这对夫妻关系中的这些小插曲，让任何文化背景的观众都能产生共鸣。然而，关注这样一个无处不在的故事也有其自身的挑战......由于主题是如此熟悉，执行起来必须真实可信。Vantage Pictures 团队在南非开普敦进行了广泛的选角工作，以找到能将这个故事娓娓道来的完美情侣。结果，两位主角之间自然而然地产生了化学反应，这在银幕上是不言而喻的。.

dictionary_entries.original: bitget and vantage pictures team up to inject humour into crypto trading
dictionary_entries.translated: bitget 和 vantage pictures 联手为加密货币交易注入幽默元素

dictionary_entries.original: See how the Bitget crypto campaign production invites viewers to rethink trading through humor and clever storytelling.
dictionary_entries.translated: 看看 Bitget 的加密货币宣传片是如何通过幽默和巧妙的故事吸引观众重新思考交易的。.

dictionary_entries.original: Leading global cryptocurrency exchange and web3 company, Bitget has partnered with Vantage Pictures, a leading film production company to launch the new “Trade Smarter” marketing campaign. Filmed in Bangkok, the four films—invite viewers into humorous scenarios where clever thinking transforms the ordinary into the extraordinary. Directed by Paul Moore, the campaign departs from the typical high-stakes tone of financial ads, infusing a touch of joy and relatability into trading.
dictionary_entries.translated: 全球领先的加密货币交易所和网络3公司Bitget与领先的电影制作公司Vantage Pictures合作，推出全新的 “更聪明地交易 ”营销活动。这四部电影在曼谷拍摄，邀请观众进入幽默的场景，通过巧妙的思维将平凡变为非凡。该活动由 Paul Moore 执导，一改金融广告中典型的高风险基调，为交易注入了一丝欢乐和亲和力。.

dictionary_entries.original: Reflecting on the creative process, director Paul Moore said, “When we set out to make these films, the idea was to keep it fun and light but still impactful. Trading, like life, is about making smart moves, and we wanted to show that in a way that’s engaging and relatable. We hope that sense of fun truly connects with people.”
dictionary_entries.translated: 在回顾创作过程时，导演 Paul Moore 说：“当我们开始制作这些影片时，我们的想法是既要轻松有趣，又要有冲击力。交易和生活一样，都需要采取明智的行动，我们希望以一种引人入胜、贴近生活的方式来展现这一点。我们希望这种趣味性能真正与人们产生共鸣。”

dictionary_entries.original: Vugar Usi Zade, COO of Bitget, also shared, “This campaign is all about human moments—those small, relatable situations where a smart decision can make all the difference. The humour comes from real life. We didn’t just want to talk about smart trading; we wanted to show how trading can be incorporated into daily life.”
dictionary_entries.translated: Bitget 首席运营官 Vugar Usi Zade 也分享道：“这次广告活动的主题是人性的瞬间--在那些细小、贴近生活的场景中，一个明智的决定可以让一切变得不同。幽默来自真实生活。我们不仅想谈论智能交易，还想展示如何将交易融入日常生活。”

dictionary_entries.original: Each film centres on the simple idea that thinking outside the box can lead to significant rewards—a message that resonates with Bitget’s global user base. From creating a glamorous looking trip to Paris in your living room to turning a mundane Zoom meeting into a jet-ski adventure, the spots offer a fresh perspective on the world of crypto trading.
dictionary_entries.translated: 每部影片都围绕着一个简单的理念：跳出思维定式，就能获得丰厚回报--这一理念与 Bitget 的全球用户群产生了共鸣。从在您的客厅里创造一次华丽的巴黎之旅，到将一次平淡无奇的中联重科会议变成一次水上摩托探险，这些短片为加密货币交易世界提供了一个全新的视角。.

dictionary_entries.original: The “Trade Smarter” campaign is set to roll out globally throughout 2024, reaching markets worldwide.
dictionary_entries.translated: 贸易更聪明 “活动将于 2024 年在全球推出，覆盖全球市场。.

dictionary_entries.original: “The challenge was to take everyday chores, like cleaning your house, and give it a surreal twist. Projects that like this are always fun as they challenge us creatively and allow us to play around with the possibilities of commercial filmmaking,” director Alexis Odiowei noted.
dictionary_entries.translated: “我们面临的挑战是将日常琐事，比如打扫房间，赋予超现实的色彩。导演 Alexis Odiowei 指出：”这样的项目总是很有趣，因为它们对我们提出了创造性的挑战，让我们能够发挥商业电影制作的可能性。.

dictionary_entries.original: bitgets humorous human moments shake up crypto trading
dictionary_entries.translated: Bitget 富有人情味的幽默时刻搅动加密货币交易

dictionary_entries.original: Explore the Bitget crypto trading commercial that highlights trading smarter with humor and creativity in financial advertising.
dictionary_entries.translated: 探索 Bitget 加密货币交易的商业广告，该广告以幽默和创意的方式突出智能交易，为金融广告注入活力。.

dictionary_entries.original: So, we rolled up our sleeves and worked closely with the Bitget team to craft a concept that showcases real human moments where making a smart decision changes everything. That’s when ‘Smart Steps, Big Leaps’ was born – it just felt right. We brainstormed about 12 different ideas and, after some tough calls, narrowed it down to the four you’re seeing now.
dictionary_entries.translated: 于是，我们撸起袖子，与Bitget团队密切合作，构思了一个能够展现真实人性时刻的概念，说明一个明智的决定可以改变一切。 ‘Smart Steps, Big Leaps’（睿智之步，飞跃之大）由此诞生——感觉很合适。我们集思广益，提出了大约12个不同的想法，经过一番艰难的抉择，最终精选出大家现在看到的这四个。.

dictionary_entries.original: Paul: We tossed around a bunch of scenarios where everyday folks solve problems with clever ideas. One idea I loved was about a football fan struggling to watch a game due to two tall men blocking his view. Frustrated, he builds a huge throne of empty beer mugs to elevate himself so he can watch the game. It was so weird and absurd! We were so close to making that one. In the end, we chose stories that were more practical to shoot and would really resonate with Bitget’s audience.
dictionary_entries.translated: 保罗我们讨论了很多日常生活中人们用巧妙创意解决问题的场景。我喜欢的一个点子是，一个足球迷因为两个高个子挡住了他的视线而无法观看比赛。沮丧之余，他用空啤酒杯做了一个巨大的宝座，把自己垫高，这样就能看比赛了。这太奇怪、太荒诞了！我们差一点就能做出这样的故事了。最后，我们选择了更实用的故事进行拍摄，这样才能真正引起 Bitget 受众的共鸣。.

dictionary_entries.original: Paul: That’s a tough one, but I’d have to go with Mandatory Meeting. We’ve all been stuck in those endless, pointless Zoom calls, right? So when our guy decides to ditch it all for a jet ski adventure, it’s so absurd and unexpected. It still makes me laugh every time.
dictionary_entries.translated: 保罗：这很难选，但我还是会选“强制会议”。我们都曾被困在那些没完没了、毫无意义的Zoom会议里，对吧？所以当他决定抛下一切去玩水上摩托时，这太荒谬、太出乎意料了。每次想起来都觉得好笑。.

dictionary_entries.original: Paul: Filming in Bangkok was fantastic. It’s cost-effective and offers a wealth of international talent – actors who can really perform, not just stand there and look good. The western-style homes and beach locations also fit our needs perfectly for this global campaign.
dictionary_entries.translated: 保罗在曼谷拍摄非常棒。这里的成本效益高，国际人才济济--演员可以真正表演，而不仅仅是站在那里好看。这里的西式住宅和海滩外景也完全符合我们这次全球宣传活动的需要。.

dictionary_entries.original: One big challenge was our location move from a home film set to a beach jet ski scene. You’d think in Thailand that’s easy, but the nearest natural beach was two hours away, which didn’t fit our tight schedule. We got creative and found a man-made beach lake much closer. It saved us time and gave us better control without worrying about waves disrupting the shoot.
dictionary_entries.translated: 一个巨大的挑战是我们的拍摄地点从家庭电影场景转移到了海滩摩托艇场景。在泰国，你会觉得这很容易，但最近的天然海滩也要两个小时的车程，这不符合我们紧凑的日程安排。我们发挥创意，找到了一个更近的人工沙滩湖。这样既节省了时间，又能更好地控制拍摄，不用担心海浪会影响拍摄。.

dictionary_entries.original: Paul: Casting was a breeze. In Thailand, casting agencies really go the extra mile. They don’t just send audition tapes – they film entire scenes based on our storyboard, complete with makeup, wardrobe, props, and even edit it to music. It made it so much easier to visualise the final product and get the client’s approval.
dictionary_entries.translated: 保罗选角很容易。在泰国，选角机构真的是不遗余力。他们不只是寄来试镜带，还会根据我们的故事板拍摄整个场景，包括化妆、服装、道具，甚至还会根据音乐进行剪辑。这让我们更容易想象出最终产品并获得客户的认可。.

dictionary_entries.original: Paul: I just want to give a huge shoutout to everyone involved. Shooting four separate spots in four days was ambitious to say the least. But the collaboration between Bitget, the Vantage Pictures production team, and our amazing local crew at Triton made it all possible. Couldn’t have done it without them.
dictionary_entries.translated: Paul：我想向所有参与者致以崇高的敬意。在四天内拍摄四个不同的广告点，至少可以说是一个雄心勃勃的计划。但 Bitget、Vantage Pictures 制作团队以及我们在 Triton 的出色本地团队之间的合作使这一切成为可能。没有他们，这一切都不可能实现。.

dictionary_entries.original: Explore the challenges of the OnePlus 12 commercial campaign in the era of generative AI and visual authenticity.
dictionary_entries.translated: 探索生成式人工智能和视觉真实性时代 OnePlus 12 广告宣传所面临的挑战。.

dictionary_entries.original: said, “I was sweating bullets just days out from shooting. We were still wrestling with prototype bugs and deliberating locations, trying to piece together some semblance of a story that was unfolding into a logistical nightmare. But as soon as Josh took us out for a pre-scout, all the stars aligned. I was blown away by the location, our crew was small but nimble, and the obstacles we had to overcome really paved the way for a potent behind the scenes story. It was the kind of experience that reminds you to trust the process and find solace in the struggle.”
dictionary_entries.translated: 说，“在距离拍摄还有几天的时候，我已经汗流浃背了。我们还在和原型错误搏斗，斟酌拍摄地点，试图拼凑出一个故事的雏形，而这个故事的展开却成了一场后勤噩梦。但当乔希带我们进行预勘察时，所有的星星都对准了我们。拍摄地点让我大开眼界，我们的摄制组小而灵活，而我们必须克服的障碍也为一个精彩的幕后故事铺平了道路。这种经历提醒你要相信过程，在奋斗中寻找慰藉”。”

dictionary_entries.original: High-end commercial film for BRINC Guardian drone, directed by Vantage Pictures—showcasing next-generation DFR technology, real-time response capabilities, and cinematic product storytelling.
dictionary_entries.translated: BRINC Guardian 无人机的高端广告片，由 Vantage Pictures 执导--展示下一代 DFR 技术、实时响应能力和电影化的产品故事。.

dictionary_entries.original:
Shot on location in Cape Town, this project for Mammotion explores a more cinematic approach to product storytelling—grounding advanced robotics in real-world environments that feel expansive, natural, and lived-in. Directed by Alexis Odiowei, the film leans into contrast: precision technology operating seamlessly within rugged terrain, shifting light conditions, and organic landscapes.

Our focus was on balancing clean, product-driven visuals with a sense of atmosphere and scale. Rather than over-explaining functionality, we let movement, composition, and environment do the heavy lifting—building a visual language that feels intuitive and confident. The result is a piece that positions the product through tone and context, not just features, while maintaining a strong, premium aesthetic throughout.
dictionary_entries.translated:
Mammotion 的这一项目在开普敦取景拍摄，探索了一种更加电影化的产品叙事方法--将先进的机器人技术融入到真实世界的环境中，让人感受到广阔、自然和生活气息。本片由 Alexis Odiowei 执导，影片采用对比手法：精密技术在崎岖的地形、多变的光线条件和有机景观中无缝运行。

我们的重点是在简洁、产品驱动的视觉效果与氛围和规模感之间取得平衡。我们没有过多地解释功能，而是让运动、构图和环境来完成这些繁重的工作，从而建立起一种让人感觉直观而自信的视觉语言。最终，作品通过基调和背景，而不仅仅是功能，对产品进行了定位，同时始终保持了强烈、优质的美感。.

dictionary_entries.original: BRINC Guardian – Next Generation of Response
dictionary_entries.translated: BRINC 守护者 - 下一代响应系统

dictionary_entries.original:
BRINC Guardian is a next-generation Drone as First Responder (DFR) platform designed for modern public safety operations. Produced by Vantage Pictures, this launch film uses a grounded, real-time narrative to showcase how autonomous drones integrate with law enforcement workflows—from dispatch and pursuit to containment and rescue.

Filmed across California and Vietnam, the production combines real police collaboration, a custom-built Real-Time Crime Center (RTCC), and advanced drone technology to highlight key capabilities including thermal imaging, autonomous deployment, and Starlink connectivity. The result is an authentic, scenario-driven portrayal of how drone systems are transforming emergency response.
dictionary_entries.translated:
BRINC Guardian 是专为现代公共安全行动设计的下一代 "无人机第一响应者"（DFR）平台。这部发布影片由 Vantage Pictures 制作，采用接地气的实时叙事方式，展示了自主无人机如何与执法工作流程相结合--从调度和追捕到围堵和救援。

影片在加利福尼亚州和越南拍摄，结合了真实的警务合作、定制的实时犯罪中心（RTCC）和先进的无人机技术，突出了热成像、自主部署和星链连接等关键功能。该片以真实的场景为导向，描述了无人机系统如何改变应急响应。.

dictionary_entries.translated: Vantage Pictures 打造了 Mammotion LUBA 3 的电影级首发产品宣传活动

dictionary_entries.original: In an increasingly competitive category, where functionality often leads the narrative,
dictionary_entries.translated: 在一个竞争日益激烈的领域，功能性常常占据主导地位，,

dictionary_entries.original: latest campaign for Mammotion Luba 3 takes a different route, treating a robotic lawn mower with the same cinematic ambition as a high-performance vehicle.
dictionary_entries.translated: Mammotion Luba 3 的最新宣传活动采取了不同的路线，以与高性能汽车相同的电影野心来对待割草机器人。.

dictionary_entries.original: Shot in Cape Town, the film leans into a product-first approach while elevating it through striking visuals, controlled pacing, and a carefully constructed relationship between man and machine.
dictionary_entries.translated: 这部电影在开普敦拍摄，采取了以产品为先的方法，同时通过令人惊叹的视觉效果、有条不紊的节奏以及精心构建的人与机器之间的关系来提升产品。.

dictionary_entries.original: At the heart of the project was a clear shift in direction, both creatively and strategically.
dictionary_entries.translated: 项目的核心在于明确的转变，无论是创意上还是战略上。.

dictionary_entries.original: “The first brief was actually quite open,” says director Alexis Odiowei. “The client shared a number of automotive references and wanted something sleek, with a stronger focus on the product itself. Previously, we’d leaned more into lifestyle storytelling, but this time the direction was very much product-first, almost like a car commercial.”
dictionary_entries.translated: “最初的简报实际上非常开放，”导演 Alexis Odiowei说。“客户提供了一些汽车参考，并想要一些时尚的东西，同时更侧重于产品本身。以前，我们更侧重于生活方式的叙事，但这一次，方向非常注重产品，几乎就像一则汽车广告。”

dictionary_entries.original: That pivot set the tone for the entire production. By reframing the Luba 3 as a piece of high-performance technology rather than a purely functional tool, the
dictionary_entries.translated: 这次的转变定下了整个产品的主调。通过将 Luba 3 重新定位为高性能技术产品，而非仅仅是功能性工具，

dictionary_entries.original: team were able to build a more elevated visual language around it.
dictionary_entries.translated: 团队能够围绕它建立一种更高级的视觉语言。.

dictionary_entries.original: “Once we locked into that direction, it gave the whole team clarity,” adds producer James Duong. “Every decision, from locations to camera movement was reinforcing the same idea.”
dictionary_entries.translated: “一旦我们确定了那个方向，整个团队就有了清晰的目标，”制作人James Duong补充道。“从选景到镜头运动的每一个决定，都在强化同一个想法。”

dictionary_entries.original: While the initial concept didn’t include a human presence, the final film introduces a single, composed lead character, a decision that became central to the storytelling.
dictionary_entries.translated: 虽然最初的概念中不包含人类存在，但最终的电影引入了一个冷静的主角，这一决定最终成为了故事叙述的核心。.

dictionary_entries.original: “I felt introducing one strong character would create a better contrast,” Odiowei explains. “It gave us a way to represent the target audience and build a relationship between human and machine.”
dictionary_entries.translated: “我认为引入一个强大的角色能创造更好的对比，”奥迪奥维解释道。“它为我们提供了一种代表目标受众以及建立人与机器之间关系的方式。”

dictionary_entries.original: Rather than acting as a traditional protagonist, the character functions more as a visual counterpart to the product, his movements, stillness, and perspective echoing the machine’s precision and control.
dictionary_entries.translated: 与其扮演传统的主角，这个角色更像是产品的视觉化身，他的动作、静止和视角都呼应着机器的精确和控制。.

dictionary_entries.original: “There’s almost a ‘man and machine’ dynamic running through it,” he adds. “That rhythm was something we thought about quite early on.”
dictionary_entries.translated: “他补充道：‘其中几乎有一种’人与机器’的动态。”“这种节奏是我们早期就考虑到的。”

dictionary_entries.original: “Without that human presence, it risked feeling too abstract,” says Duong. “The character gives the audience a way in.”
dictionary_entries.translated: “没有了人的存在，它有可能会显得过于抽象，”Duong说。“角色让观众有了切入点。”

dictionary_entries.original: One of the key creative challenges was transforming a highly functional product into something aspirational.
dictionary_entries.translated: 一个关键的创意挑战在于将一款功能性极强的产品转化为一个令人向往的物品。.

dictionary_entries.original: “A big part of it was finding that synergy between the character and the machine,” says Odiowei. “That helped elevate it beyond just function.”
dictionary_entries.translated: “其中很大一部分是我们找到了角色和机器之间的协同作用，”奥迪奥维说。“这有助于将其提升到超越单纯功能性的层面。”

dictionary_entries.original: The team also leaned heavily into abstract 3D sequences to reinforce that shift, particularly in the opening moments, where the product is introduced in a more stylised, almost sci-fi environment.
dictionary_entries.translated: 团队还大力运用抽象的 3D 序列来强化这种转变，尤其是在开场时刻，产品在一个更具风格化、近乎科幻的环境中呈现。.

dictionary_entries.original: “That gave it a sense of innovation and scale,” he continues. “It helped position it as something more advanced.”
dictionary_entries.translated: “这赋予了它创新和规模感，”他继续说道。“它有助于将其定位为更先进的东西。”

dictionary_entries.original: “There was a really tight collaboration between live-action and 3D from early on,” says Duong. “That’s what made it feel cohesive rather than two separate layers.”
dictionary_entries.translated: “从早期开始，真人拍摄和 3D 之间就建立了非常紧密的合作关系，”Duong 说。“这使得它感觉浑然一体，而不是两个独立的部分。”

dictionary_entries.original: With control and precision at the core of the product, those ideas needed to be expressed visually rather than explained.
dictionary_entries.translated: 产品的核心在于控制和精确，因此这些理念需要通过视觉来表达，而不是解释。.

dictionary_entries.original: “The visual language was built around power, control, and forward-looking technology,” Odiowei explains. “We used cinematic 3D breakdowns to express that, almost deconstructing the product in a way that feels visual rather than technical.”
dictionary_entries.translated: “视觉语言围绕着力量、控制和前瞻性技术构建，”奥迪奥维解释道。“我们用电影般的 3D 解析来表达这一点，几乎以一种视觉而非技术的方式解构产品。”

dictionary_entries.original: Despite its cinematic tone, the film remains grounded in product functionality, something the team were careful to preserve.
dictionary_entries.translated: 尽管影片具有电影般的基调，但它仍然立足于产品功能性，这是团队小心翼翼要保留的。.

dictionary_entries.original: “The client didn’t want it to feel like a straight product intro,” says Odiowei. “So we focused on showing rather than telling.”
dictionary_entries.translated: “客户不希望它感觉像一个直白的 the product 介绍，” Odiowei 说。“所以我们侧重于”展示’而非‘告知’。”

dictionary_entries.original: “You still get all the features,” adds Duong. “But they’re embedded in a more cinematic experience.”
dictionary_entries.translated: “你仍然可以获得所有功能，”Duong补充道。“但它们被嵌入到更具电影感的体验中。”

dictionary_entries.original: To give the Luba 3 a stronger on-screen identity, the team approached it less like a household device and more like a vehicle.
dictionary_entries.translated: 为了让 Luba 3 拥有更强的屏幕识别度，团队将其视为一辆交通工具，而不是一个家用电器。.

dictionary_entries.original: “We got very low to the ground to make it feel big and important,” says Odiowei. “And we treated it almost like a car, using dynamic camera moves.”
dictionary_entries.translated: “我们把镜头放得很低，来营造宏伟和重要的感觉，”Odiowei 说。“我们处理它的方式几乎像对待汽车一样，使用了动态的镜头运动。”

dictionary_entries.original: Odiowei added: “Most of my work leans more towards comedy, so it was nice to move into something more serious and cinematic.”
dictionary_entries.translated: 奥迪奥维补充道：“我的大部分作品都偏向喜剧，所以能尝试一些更严肃、更具电影感的作品感觉很棒。”

dictionary_entries.original: “I’m most proud of how the live-action and 3D came together.”
dictionary_entries.translated: “我最自豪的是真人与三维动画的结合。”

dictionary_entries.original: Vantage Pictures translates next-gen drone tech into gritty storytelling for BRINC
dictionary_entries.translated: Vantage Pictures 将下一代无人机技术转化为 BRINC 的写实叙事

dictionary_entries.original: to produce the launch film for its next-generation public safety drone, Guardian, the brief was ambitious: move beyond “Drone as First Responder 101” and show what the next phase of the category looks like.
dictionary_entries.translated: 为了制作其下一代公共安全无人机 Guardian 的发布影片，其简报要求雄心勃勃：超越“无人机作为第一响应者 101”，并展示该类别的下一阶段是什么样子。.

dictionary_entries.original: Instead of a traditional product video, Vantage built a real-time, multi-scenario narrative – a robbery, vehicle pursuit, and nighttime arrest, water rescue, and remote fire response – all designed to reveal the system’s capabilities through action rather than explanation.
dictionary_entries.translated: 万特奇没有制作传统的产品视频，而是构建了一个实时、多场景的叙事——一次抢劫、车辆追捕、夜间逮捕、水上救援和远程火灾响应——所有这些设计都通过实际行动而非解释来揭示系统的能力。.

dictionary_entries.original: “We didn’t want this to be an endless stack of specs and features,” says director
dictionary_entries.translated: “我们不希望这是一堆没完没了的技术规格和功能列表，”导演说

dictionary_entries.original: . “The goal was to make the technology feel intuitive, so everything was built around the real workflows of first response teams.”
dictionary_entries.translated: . “目标是让技术感觉直观，因此所有内容都围绕一线响应团队的实际工作流程构建。”

dictionary_entries.original: The story begins with a jewelry store robbery and escalates into a coordinated, multi-unit response. It revolves around the Real-Time Crime Center (RTCC), where drone ops, analysts, and field units converge, creating a stark contrast between chaos in the field and clarity in the control room.
dictionary_entries.translated: 故事始于一家珠宝店抢劫案，随后升级为一次协调一致、多部门联动响应。故事围绕实时犯罪中心（RTCC）展开，无人机操作、分析师和现场单位在此汇聚，形成了现场的混乱与指挥室的清晰鲜明的对比。.

dictionary_entries.original: To balance scale and efficiency, the production was split across two countries.
dictionary_entries.translated: 为了平衡规模和效率，生产被分散到两个国家。.

dictionary_entries.original: Exterior action sequences were shot in Newport Beach, California, with extensive support from local public safety agencies. The Newport Beach Police Department and Lifeguard Operations Division provided active-duty personnel, vehicles, locations, and logistical support – enabling complex scenes like a robbery and pursuit to be executed with a high degree of realism.
dictionary_entries.translated: 外景动作场面在加州纽波特海滩拍摄，得到了当地公共安全部门的大力支持。纽波特海滩警察局和救生员运营部门提供了现役人员、车辆、场地和后勤支持，使得抢劫和追逐等复杂场景得以高度逼真地执行。.

dictionary_entries.original: “Their level of support was incredible,” says executive producer James Duong. “They weren’t just participants – they were collaborators. That made a huge difference to what we could accomplish with our budget.”
dictionary_entries.translated: “他们的支持水平令人难以置信，”执行制片人James Duong说道。“他们不仅仅是参与者——他们是合作者。这让我们的预算取得了巨大的成就。”

dictionary_entries.original: Meanwhile, the RTCC scenes were filmed on a custom-built set in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. This allowed the team to increase production value while maintaining full control over art direction and lighting without breaking the budget.
dictionary_entries.translated: 与此同时，RTCC的场景是在越南胡志明市一个定制搭建的摄影棚里拍摄的。这使得团队在不超出预算的情况下，提高了制作价值，同时还能完全掌控艺术指导和灯光。.

dictionary_entries.original: It also led to a unique casting choice: the lead actor portraying the drone operator is a former U.S. police officer now based in Vietnam, bringing real-world experience into the role.
dictionary_entries.translated: 这也导致了一个独特的选角：扮演无人机操作员的主演是一名美国前警察，目前居住在越南，他将真实的经历带入了角色。.

dictionary_entries.original: One of the key challenges was maintaining a consistent visual language across two very different environments. Cinematographers
dictionary_entries.translated: 其中一个关键挑战是在两个截然不同的环境中保持视觉语言的一致性。摄影师

dictionary_entries.original: (Saigon unit) aligned early on lensing, color, and lighting strategy to ensure the transition between locations felt seamless.
dictionary_entries.translated: （西贡团队）早期就在镜头运用、色彩和打光策略上达成一致，以确保不同场景之间的过渡感觉天衣无缝。.

dictionary_entries.original: “We weren’t trying to force a visual match – the environments are fundamentally different,” says Lorenz. “The goal was simply to make them feel like they belong to the same world.”
dictionary_entries.translated: “我们并不是试图强行在视觉上匹配——这些环境本质上是不同的，”洛伦兹说。“我们的目标只是让他们感觉像是属于同一个世界。”

dictionary_entries.original: The final film blends live-action footage with CGI and HUD overlays to accurately represent the drone platform’s capabilities, including autonomous deployment, thermal imaging, and Starlink integration.
dictionary_entries.translated: 最后这部电影将实拍素材与 CGI 和 HUD（平视显示器）叠加相结合，精确地展示了无人机平台的各项能力，包括自主部署、热成像和 Starlink 集成。.

dictionary_entries.original: The project was developed directly with BRINC, without an ad agency intermediary. VP of Strategy & Marketing Communications David Benowitz played a key role in shaping both logistics and narrative, coordinating public safety partners and contributing to the creative process.
dictionary_entries.translated: 该项目直接与 BRINC 合作开发，没有广告公司介入。战略与营销传播副总裁 David Benowitz 在塑造后勤和叙事方面发挥了关键作用，协调了公共安全合作伙伴并为创意过程做出了贡献。.

dictionary_entries.original: “We were excited by the way Vantage approached Guardian as a whole,” says Benowitz. “It’s not just about the drone—it’s about how it integrates seamlessly with the strict workflows of public safety agencies. First responders have little use for speculation on KSPs and user benefits. They face life-threatening situations daily, so our film needed to convey immediate value in real-world applications.”
dictionary_entries.translated: “我们对 Vantage 整体上来处理 Guardian 的方式感到兴奋，”Benowitz 说。“这不仅仅是关于无人机——而是关于它如何与公共安全机构严格的工作流程无缝集成。一线救援人员很少使用关于 KSP 和用户利益的猜测。他们每天都面临危及生命的状况，因此我们的影片需要传达在真实世界应用中的即时价值。”

dictionary_entries.original: That realism was shaped in large part by the Newport Beach Police Department, whose officers contributed both as talent and advisors. Their expertise influenced everything from blocking for the high-risk vehicle stop to radio comms dialogue, reflecting how these scenarios play out in the field.
dictionary_entries.translated: 这种写实感在很大程度上是由新港海滩警察局塑造的，该部门的警官既是演员也是顾问。他们的专业知识影响了从高风险车辆拦截的阻挡到无线电通信对话的一切，反映了这些场景在实际中的表现方式。.

dictionary_entries.original: BRINC founder and CEO Blake Resnick was also closely involved during production in California, reviewing shots on set and helping refine key moments to align with his vision for the company.
dictionary_entries.translated: BRINC 的创始人兼首席执行官 Blake Resnick 在加州公司的制作过程中也密切参与，在片场审阅镜头，并帮助打磨关键时刻，以实现他公司的愿景。.

dictionary_entries.original: At a broader level, the film reflects a shift in how drone technology is positioned within public safety.
dictionary_entries.translated: 在更宏观的层面上，这部电影反映了无人机技术在公共安全领域定位的变化。.

dictionary_entries.original: film from 2024, also produced by Vantage Pictures, focused on proving the concept of DFR (Drone as First Responder). Guardian aims to show what happens when those systems become fully integrated—autonomous, continuous, and scalable.
dictionary_entries.translated: 2024 年出品的电影，同样由 Vantage Pictures制作，聚焦于证明 DFR（无人机作为首要响应者）的概念。Guardian 旨在展示当这些系统完全集成——自主、连续且可扩展——时会发生什么。.

dictionary_entries.original: As outlined in the original brief, the goal was to present Guardian not just as an upgrade, but as a new operational standard.
dictionary_entries.translated: 正如原始简报中所述，目标是将 Guardian 不仅仅作为一个升级，而是作为一种新的操作标准来呈现。.

dictionary_entries.original: What defines the final film is its systems-driven approach. Rather than isolating individual features, the narrative unfolds as a continuous chain of events – mirroring the way the technology itself is designed to operate.
dictionary_entries.translated: 定义这部最终影片的是其系统驱动的方法。与其孤立地处理单个特征，不如将叙事作为一个连续的事件链展开——这与技术本身被设计成运行的方式相呼应。.

dictionary_entries.original: For Vantage, the project highlights one of its strengths as a production house: translating complex, emerging technologies into grounded, relatable storytelling.
dictionary_entries.translated: 对于 Vantage 来说，该项目凸显了其作为一家制作公司的优势之一：将复杂的新兴技术转化为切实、易于理解的故事。.

dictionary_entries.original: And in a rapidly evolving drone landscape, that clarity may be just as important as the technology itself.
dictionary_entries.translated: 在快速发展的无人机领域，这种清晰度甚至可能与技术本身同等重要。.

dictionary_entries.original: A talking dog, AI, and everyday chaos: behind Govee’s new campaign via Vantage Pictures
dictionary_entries.translated: 会说话的狗、人工智能和日常的混乱：Govee新广告活动背后的故事（来源：Vantage Pictures）

dictionary_entries.original: Govee has launched a new brand campaign, directed by Paul Moore and produced by
dictionary_entries.translated: Govee 推出了一项新的品牌宣传活动，该活动由 Paul Moore 执导，并由

dictionary_entries.original: , built around a simple insight: a home is never just one mood.
dictionary_entries.translated: , 围绕一个简单的见解：家从来不只有一种心情。.

dictionary_entries.original: The TVC is told through the perspective of the family dog, who watches the emotional rhythms of the household unfold around him. As the energy of the home shifts, Govee’s lighting subtly transforms with it – from warm ambient glows to colorful entertainment lighting and soft practical whites.
dictionary_entries.translated: 该电视广告通过一只家庭犬的视角讲述，它观察着家庭生活中情感的起伏。随着家庭氛围的变化，Govee 的灯光也会随之微妙地转变——从温暖的环境光到多彩的娱乐照明，再到柔和的实用白色灯光。.

dictionary_entries.original: Rather than aggressively selling tech features, the campaign leans into feeling.
dictionary_entries.translated: 该宣传活动不侧重于激进地推销技术功能，而是侧重于情感体验。.

dictionary_entries.original: “We didn’t want the lights to feel like gadgets,” said director Paul Moore. “We wanted them to feel like part of the emotional atmosphere of the home – almost like another character quietly reacting to everything happening around it.”
dictionary_entries.translated: “我们不希望这些灯给人一种”小玩意儿’的感觉，“导演Paul Moore说道，”我们希望它们能融入家庭的情感氛围之中——几乎就像另一个角色，默默地对周围发生的一切做出反应。”

dictionary_entries.original: The entire campaign was shot on a custom-built studio set in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam giving the filmmakers complete control over lighting, architecture, and camera movement while creating a premium cinematic look.
dictionary_entries.translated: 整个宣传活动是在越南胡志明市一个定制建造的影棚内拍摄的，这使得电影制作人能够完全控制灯光、建筑和摄像机运动，同时创造出极具质感的电影效果。.

dictionary_entries.original: But even with a controlled set, the shoot itself became complicated fast.
dictionary_entries.translated: 但即使是受控集，拍摄本身也很快变得复杂起来。.

dictionary_entries.original: The dog appears in almost every scene. So do the kids. And the Govee lights had to perform live during takes – often changing color or intensity at exact moments while actors, camera movement, and the dog’s actions all had to sync up naturally.
dictionary_entries.translated: 狗狗几乎出现在每一个镜头中。孩子们也是。Govee 灯需要在拍摄期间进行现场表演——通常会在精确的时刻改变颜色或强度，同时演员、摄像机运动和狗狗的表演都必须自然地同步。.

dictionary_entries.original: “It became weirdly choreographed,” Moore said. “You’d have a lighting cue happening while a kid is crossing frame, the dog needs to hit a mark, the camera’s moving, and we’re trying to make it still feel spontaneous and lived-in.”
dictionary_entries.translated: “它变得有些奇怪，像编排好的，”摩尔说。“当一个孩子穿过画面时，灯光提示会亮起，狗狗需要走到指定位置，摄影机在移动，而我们却要努力让这一切感觉依然自然且真实。”

dictionary_entries.original: With a compressed shooting schedule, the production began using AI in post-production to solve very specific performance timing issues rather than generate entirely fake imagery.
dictionary_entries.translated: 在压缩的拍摄日程下，制作团队开始在后期制作中使用人工智能来解决非常具体的表演节奏问题，而不是生成完全虚假的图像。.

dictionary_entries.original: Moore handled much of the AI work himself using Higgsfield and video model Seedance 2.0. Instead of replacing footage, he used the actual photographed scenes as a base – feeding the first and last frames of shots into the system along with prompts to create subtle in-between performance adjustments.
dictionary_entries.translated: 摩尔利用 Higgsfield 和 Seedance 2.0 视频模型亲自处理了大量人工智能工作。他并没有替换画面，而是将实际拍摄的场景作为基础——将镜头的第一帧和最后一帧以及提示词输入系统，以创建微妙的中间表演调整。.

dictionary_entries.original: The result wasn’t giant AI spectacle shots. It was small behavioral details.
dictionary_entries.translated: 结果不是宏大的 AI 奇观镜头。而是微小的行为细节。.

dictionary_entries.original: In some scenes, the dog was enhanced to look like he was sleeping. In another, a cheeky wink was added. In another, the timing of the dog jumping off the couch and interacting with the family was refined without requiring another hour of resets and animal wrangling on set.
dictionary_entries.translated: 在某些场景中，狗狗被处理得看起来像是在睡觉。在另一场景中，则加上了一个俏皮的眨眼。在还有一个场景中，狗狗从沙发上跳下并与家人互动的时机得到了优化，而无需在片场再花一个小时进行重设和驯导动物。.

dictionary_entries.original: Ironically, most viewers probably won’t notice any of it.
dictionary_entries.translated: 讽刺的是，大多数观众可能根本注意不到这一切。.

dictionary_entries.original: “To me, this is actually the best use of AI,” Moore explained. “You’re still shooting the real thing. Real dog. Real lighting. Real cinematography. Then you’re using AI almost like a modern VFX tool to help refine moments afterward. It’s honestly not that different philosophically from traditional visual effects workflows – it’s just way faster and more accessible.”
dictionary_entries.translated: “对我来说，这实际上是人工智能的最好用途，”摩尔解释说。“你仍然拍摄真实的东西。真实的狗。真实的光线。真实的电影制作。然后你几乎可以用人工智能来帮助后期润饰这些瞬间。说实话，这在哲学上与传统的视觉特效工作流程没有什么不同——它只是速度更快，更容易获得。”

dictionary_entries.original: That hybrid approach – practical filmmaking first, AI second – may end up being where a lot of commercial production is headed.
dictionary_entries.translated: 这种混合方法——即首先是实践电影制作，然后是人工智能——最终可能会成为许多商业制作的发展方向。.

dictionary_entries.original: The final film still feels warm, tactile, and human. And despite the technology involved, the commercial mostly succeeds because it captures something recognizable: the strange emotional rhythm of sharing a home with a dog.
dictionary_entries.translated: 尽管涉及技术，但最终的电影仍感觉温暖、有触感且充满人情味。这部广告之所以大部分成功，是因为它捕捉到了某种我们都能理解的东西：与狗共享一个家那种奇特的、充满情感的节奏。.

dictionary_entries.original: Vantage Pictures’ James Duong on bringing Chinese productions to Vietnam
dictionary_entries.translated: ’Vantage Pictures”与“James Duong”谈将中国作品引入越南

dictionary_entries.original: vantage pictures james duong on bringing chinese productions to vietnam
dictionary_entries.translated: avantaj 越南 阮仲 谈 越南 制作

dictionary_entries.original: Vantage Pictures' James Duong on bringing Chinese productions to Vietnam | Vantage Pictures
dictionary_entries.translated: Vantage Pictures' James Duong 谈将中国作品引入越南 | Vantage Pictures

dictionary_entries.original: For James Duong, Executive Producer at
dictionary_entries.translated: James Duong的执行制片人，任职于

dictionary_entries.original: , producing isn’t just about getting a shoot done – it’s about building a bridge.
dictionary_entries.translated: , 制作不仅仅是完成拍摄，它是在搭建一座桥梁。.

dictionary_entries.original: Over the past few years, Duong has quietly positioned Vietnam as a viable production hub for Chinese tech brands looking to go global—handling everything from high-speed product launches to complex, multi-market campaigns.
dictionary_entries.translated: 在过去的几年里，杨已经悄悄地将越南定位为中国科技品牌走向全球的可行生产中心——负责从高速产品发布到复杂的、多市场的广告活动等一切事宜。.

dictionary_entries.original: It’s a space that demands more than execution. It requires translation—of expectations, of workflows, and often, of mindset.
dictionary_entries.translated: 这是一个需要超越执行力的空间。它需要译介——关于期望、关于工作流程，以及通常，关于思维模式。.

dictionary_entries.original: And for Duong, that’s where the real work begins.
dictionary_entries.translated: 而对杨来说，真正的挑战才刚刚开始。.

dictionary_entries.original: You’ve been bringing Chinese tech projects into Vietnam. How did that start?
dictionary_entries.translated: 你是如何开始将中国科技项目引进越南的？

dictionary_entries.original: It wasn’t really a strategic move at the beginning.
dictionary_entries.translated: 起初这并不是一个真正的战略举措。.

dictionary_entries.original: Earlier in my career I spent several years at DJI, so I was already very close to the Shenzhen tech ecosystem. Once you work with a few brands there, word travels quickly.
dictionary_entries.translated: 在我职业生涯早期，我在大疆工作了几年，所以我对深圳的科技生态系统已经非常熟悉了。一旦你和那里的几个品牌合作过，消息就会传得很快。.

dictionary_entries.original: Some of the first projects came through those relationships, and then it naturally grew from there.
dictionary_entries.translated: 其中一些早期项目是通过这些关系获得的，然后自然而然地发展起来。.

dictionary_entries.original: What we realised quite quickly was that many of these companies want content that feels global—but they don’t necessarily want to produce everything in China.
dictionary_entries.translated: 我们很快意识到，许多这些公司想要一种感觉像是全球性的内容——但他们不一定希望所有内容都在中国生产。.

dictionary_entries.original: That’s where Vietnam and Southeast Asia started to make a lot of sense.
dictionary_entries.translated: 这正是越南和东南亚开始变得非常有意义的地方。.

dictionary_entries.original: It’s a mix of things. You have strong crews, competitive costs, and a production environment that can move fast. But more importantly, Vietnam doesn’t feel overly familiar in the way some other markets do, which is valuable for global campaigns.
dictionary_entries.translated: 这是多种因素的结合。你们有强大的团队、有竞争力的成本以及能够快速响应的生产环境。但更重要的是，越南不像其他一些市场那样过于熟悉，这对于全球性广告活动来说非常有价值。.

dictionary_entries.original: At the same time, it’s geographically and culturally close enough that Chinese clients feel comfortable working here. So you get this balance—an international feel, but still very operationally accessible.
dictionary_entries.translated: 同时，它在地理和文化上都足够近，让中国客户在这里工作感到自在。因此，您会获得这种平衡——既有国际化的感觉，又在运营上非常便捷。.

dictionary_entries.original: Another advantage is the crews, especially the art departments. They’re very capable and used to working quickly. For certain campaigns—particularly tech or product work—we often build environments from scratch to better control reflections, surfaces, and lighting.
dictionary_entries.translated: 另一个优势是团队，尤其是艺术部门。他们非常有能力，并且习惯于快速工作。对于某些广告活动——尤其是科技或产品类工作——我们经常从零开始构建环境，以更好地控制反射、表面和灯光。.

dictionary_entries.original: These builds are usually lightweight and modular, using materials like hiflex or soft panels rather than heavy construction. That allows the team to move quickly and make adjustments on set while keeping production efficient.
dictionary_entries.translated: 这些展台通常轻巧且模块化，使用 hi-flex 或软板等材料，而非重型建筑。这使得团队能够快速移动并在现场进行调整，同时保持高效率的制作。.

dictionary_entries.original: Building sets also allows us to fully realise the creative vision for the client. Everything can be customised to their needs, which means no two sets look the same. Each environment is designed specifically for the product and the campaign.
dictionary_entries.translated: 建筑布景还使我们能够充分实现客户的创意愿景。一切都可以根据他们的需求进行定制，这意味着没有两个布景看起来是相同的。每个场景都是专门为产品和宣传活动设计的。.

dictionary_entries.original: That level of customisation is important because it allows brands to express their identity through the environment—specific design language, small details, and meticulous attention that are unique to that brand. When done well, the set itself becomes part of the storytelling.
dictionary_entries.translated: 这种程度的定制很重要，因为它能让品牌通过环境——特定的设计语言、小细节以及品牌独有的精益求精——来表达其身份。如果做得好，场景本身就成为了叙事的一部分。.

dictionary_entries.original: So Vietnam works well both as a location and as a place where you can create controlled environments when the project requires it.
dictionary_entries.translated: 所以，越南既是一个理想的地点，也可以在项目需要时创建受控环境。.

dictionary_entries.original: What’s different about producing for Chinese tech brands?
dictionary_entries.translated: 生产中国科技品牌产品有什么不同？

dictionary_entries.original: The pace is probably the biggest difference. A lot of these companies operate in what people call the 996 culture—very intense work cycles where things move quickly and decisions happen fast.
dictionary_entries.translated: 节奏可能是最大的不同。许多这些公司都遵循着人们所说的“996文化”——工作周期非常紧张，事情进展迅速，决策也很快。.

dictionary_entries.original: They’re launching products constantly, and with how fast technology is evolving—especially in areas like AI, robotics, and consumer electronics—the marketing content has to keep up with that development. As a producer, it’s actually important to understand the product quite well. If you don’t understand the technology, it’s very difficult to shoot it properly or communicate its value visually.
dictionary_entries.translated: 他们不断推出新产品，而且随着技术（尤其是在人工智能、机器人和消费电子等领域）的飞速发展，营销内容也必须跟上这种发展。作为一名制作人，了解产品非常重要。如果你不了解技术，就很难拍好它或通过视觉传达它的价值。.

dictionary_entries.original: Another thing is the mindset. Many of these companies approach marketing almost like product development—they iterate quickly, test ideas, and refine things rapidly. So production has to be flexible and organised enough to keep up with that process.
dictionary_entries.translated: 另外一个方面是心态。这些公司中的许多公司以近乎产品开发的方式进行营销——他们快速迭代、测试想法并迅速完善。因此，生产必须足够灵活和有条理，才能跟上这个过程。.

dictionary_entries.original: At the same time, expectations are very high. Many of these brands closely study companies like Apple or Samsung—their marketing strategies and the level of polish in their campaigns—and aim to reach that same standard. The challenge is often achieving that level of quality within tighter timelines or budgets, so a big part of our job is finding smart production solutions that deliver premium results in a more efficient way.
dictionary_entries.translated: 与此同时，期望值也非常高。许多这样的品牌密切研究苹果或三星这样的公司——它们的营销策略以及广告宣传的精良程度——并力求达到同样的标准。挑战往往在于能够在更紧迫的时间或预算内达到这种质量水平，所以我们工作的重要组成部分是找到巧妙的制作解决方案，以更有效的方式交付高端成果。.

dictionary_entries.original: So you’re really operating in this space where things move very fast, but the standard can’t drop.
dictionary_entries.translated: 所以你是在这个领域运作，那里事物的发展速度非常快，但标准却不能降低。.

dictionary_entries.original: You’re essentially translating between different production cultures. What does that actually look like day-to-day?
dictionary_entries.translated: 你本质上是在翻译不同的制作文化。这在日常生活中具体是什么样的？

dictionary_entries.original: A lot of it starts with building trust. When you’re working with tech companies, clients want to feel that the producer actually understands the product and the brief—not just the logistics of the shoot. If you understand the technology and what the product is trying to achieve, it becomes much easier to communicate clearly with both the director and the client.
dictionary_entries.translated: 很多事情始于建立信任。在与科技公司合作时，客户希望感受到制片人真正理解产品和简报——而不仅仅是拍摄的后勤。如果你能理解技术和产品想要达成的目标，与导演和客户进行清晰的沟通就会容易得多。.

dictionary_entries.original: For me that’s quite important because I’m genuinely interested in technology. When you understand the product well, you can translate the brief more effectively into something visual.
dictionary_entries.translated: 对我来说这很重要，因为我确实对技术很感兴趣。当你真正了解产品时，就能更有效地将需求转化为视觉效果。.

dictionary_entries.original: The other part is cultural. Different markets simply work in different ways. A client might be very used to producing in one region where things are done a certain way, and then when they work somewhere else the process can feel quite different.
dictionary_entries.translated: 另一部分是文化因素。不同的市场运作方式本身就不同。客户可能非常习惯在一个地区生产，那里的做事方式是某一种，然后当他们在其他地方工作时，这个过程可能会感觉很不一样。.

dictionary_entries.original: So part of the job is helping everyone understand those differences and making sure expectations are aligned early—how production works here, how decisions move, how much prep is needed.
dictionary_entries.translated: 工作中有一部分是帮助大家理解这些差异，并确保尽早统一预期——了解这里的制作流程、决策过程以及所需的准备工作。.

dictionary_entries.original: In many ways the producer becomes the bridge between those worlds, making sure the creative idea, the technology behind the product, and the production process all connect smoothly.
dictionary_entries.translated: 在很多方面，制作人成为了这些领域的桥梁，确保创意、产品背后的技术和制作过程都能顺畅地连接起来。.

dictionary_entries.original: What kind of projects are you seeing more of now?
dictionary_entries.translated: 现在可以看到更多的什么项目？

dictionary_entries.original: Definitely more advanced tech and product work—robotics, AI-driven products, consumer electronics. But what’s changing is how the creative process around those campaigns is evolving.
dictionary_entries.translated: 肯定会有更多先进的技术和产品——机器人、人工智能驱动产品、消费电子产品。但正在改变的是围绕这些活动的创意过程的演变。.

dictionary_entries.original: Storytelling around tech products has always been important, but now with AI tools becoming more accessible, the scale of creative exploration is changing. Teams can test more ideas, visualize concepts faster, and push creative directions that might have been difficult or expensive before.
dictionary_entries.translated: 围绕科技产品的讲故事一直很重要，但现在随着人工智能工具越来越普及，创意探索的规模正在改变。团队可以测试更多的想法，更快地可视化概念，并推动以前可能困难或昂贵的创意方向。.

dictionary_entries.original: There’s a lot of discussion about AI replacing certain jobs, and in some areas it probably will. But if you use it properly, it can also expand what creatives are capable of doing. It allows directors and producers to experiment more and explore ideas that were previously impossible or impractical to execute.
dictionary_entries.translated: 关于人工智能将取代某些工作的讨论很多，在某些领域它确实会如此。但如果使用得当，它也能扩展创意人士的能力。它允许导演和制片人进行更多实验，并探索以前无法实现或不切实际的想法。.

dictionary_entries.original: So from a production perspective, the challenge now is balancing that—using AI as a tool to extend creative vision while still maintaining the craftsmanship and cinematic quality that audiences expect.
dictionary_entries.translated: 因此，从制作角度来看，现在的挑战在于平衡这一点——将人工智能用作扩展创意视野的工具，同时仍然保持观众期望的工艺和电影质量。.

dictionary_entries.original: Has that changed how you approach production?
dictionary_entries.translated: 这改变了你生产的方式吗？

dictionary_entries.original: Yes. With tech products you naturally become more precise—materials, reflections, lighting all need to be carefully controlled because the product itself is often the hero.
dictionary_entries.translated: 是的。有了科技产品，你自然会变得更加精准——材料、反射、光照都需要仔细控制，因为产品本身通常才是重点。.

dictionary_entries.original: But what’s interesting now is that not all “products” are physical anymore. Many of the things we’re promoting today are software, AI systems, or services that you can’t really hold in your hand. So the challenge becomes understanding what the technology actually does and translating that into something people can see and feel.
dictionary_entries.translated: 但现在有趣的是，“产品”不再全部是实体的了。我们今天推广的许多东西是软件、人工智能系统或服务，你实际上无法握在手中。因此，挑战在于理解技术实际上做了什么，并将其转化为人们能够看到和感受到的东西。.

dictionary_entries.original: Sometimes that means showing the product inside real human situations, sometimes it’s more storytelling—building a moment where the technology quietly solves a problem or improves someone’s life. The goal is always the same: the audience should feel why they might want to try or use it.
dictionary_entries.translated: 有时这意味着在真实的人类情境中展示产品，有时则更侧重于讲故事——构建一个技术默默解决问题或改善人们生活的时刻。目标始终是相同的：观众应该感受到他们为什么要尝试或使用它。.

dictionary_entries.original: AI tools are also becoming part of the workflow, especially for exploring ideas or visualizing concepts early. But I see them more as tools that support creativity rather than something that replaces it. The real work still comes from understanding the technology, the story behind it, and making it feel genuine for people watching.
dictionary_entries.translated: 人工智能工具也正在成为工作流程的一部分，尤其是在早期探索想法或可视化概念时。但我认为它们更多的是支持创造力的工具，而不是取代创造力的工具。真正的工作仍然来自于对技术的理解、故事的背景以及使其观众感到真实。.

dictionary_entries.original: What do you enjoy most about producing in this space?
dictionary_entries.translated: 在这个领域进行制作，您最喜欢的部分是什么？

dictionary_entries.original: Honestly, it’s the constant learning and problem-solving. Technology moves quickly, so I spend a lot of time staying close to new developments—AI, robotics, consumer electronics—and understanding how these products actually work. That helps when translating something technical into visuals that people can immediately understand.
dictionary_entries.translated: 坦白说，这在于不断的学习和解决问题。科技发展迅速，所以我花很多时间关注新技术——人工智能、机器人、消费电子产品——以及理解这些产品如何实际运作。这有助于将技术内容转化为人们一眼就能理解的视觉内容。.

dictionary_entries.original: For clients, that also means we can move faster and make better decisions during production. When the team understands both the technology and the production process, it becomes much easier to shape the right approach and avoid unnecessary trial and error.
dictionary_entries.translated: 对于客户而言，这意味着我们可以在生产过程中更快地采取行动，并做出更明智的决策。当团队同时了解技术和生产流程时，就更容易塑造正确的方法并避免不必要的试错。.

dictionary_entries.original: Every project has different constraints—locations, timelines, logistics—and bringing all of that together in a way that feels seamless on screen is really the part I enjoy the most.
dictionary_entries.translated: 每个项目都有不同的限制——地点、时间、后勤——并将所有这些因素以一种在荧幕上感觉天衣无缝的方式结合起来，这真是我最享受的部分。.

dictionary_entries.original: Vantage has been scaling pretty quickly. What’s been important in building the team?
dictionary_entries.translated: Vantage发展得相当快。在组建团队方面，哪些方面比较重要？

dictionary_entries.original: The goal has always been to build a team that can operate globally, not just locally. Vietnam is our base, but the mindset needs to be international—understanding how different markets and crews work.
dictionary_entries.translated: 目标一直都是建立一个可以全球运作的团队，而不仅仅是本地运作。越南是我们的基地，但心态需要是国际化的——理解不同市场和团队是如何运作的。.

dictionary_entries.original: One principle I often mention is “dùng lửa thử vàng.” People grow through real projects and real pressure. Challenging productions are what help the team develop.
dictionary_entries.translated: 我经常提到一个原则是“用火试金”。人们在真实的項目和真实的压力中成长。富有挑战性的制作有助于团队发展。.

dictionary_entries.original: At the same time, we focus on teaching proper workflows that are commonly used by crews around the world. That helps our team collaborate smoothly with international clients coming to Vietnam, and also prepares them to work abroad. It really goes both ways.
dictionary_entries.translated: 同时，我们还注重教授全球团队常用的规范工作流程。这有助于我们的团队与前来越南的国际客户顺利协作，也为他们将来在国外工作做好准备。这真的是双向受益。.

dictionary_entries.original: The idea is to build a team that stays adaptable, keeps learning, and is comfortable working on productions anywhere.
dictionary_entries.translated: 理念是建立一个适应性强、持续学习、能在任何地方进行制作的团队。.

dictionary_entries.original: What are clients actually looking for when they come to Vietnam now?
dictionary_entries.translated: 现在客户来越南到底在寻找什么？

dictionary_entries.original: Before, it was more about cost and flexibility. Now it’s about whether you can deliver at a global level.
dictionary_entries.translated: 以前，更多的是关于成本和灵活性。现在，则关乎你是否能在全球范围内交付。.

dictionary_entries.original: Clients want confidence that the work will stand alongside anything produced in more established markets.
dictionary_entries.translated: 客户希望有信心，他们委托的工作可以与任何在更成熟市场生产出的作品相媲美。.

dictionary_entries.original: So the conversation is less about “Can you do it?” and more about “Can you do it at this level, consistently?”
dictionary_entries.translated: 所以对话更多的是关于“你是否能做到？”而不是“你是否能达到这个水平，并且保持一致？”

dictionary_entries.original: And personally—what keeps you motivated in producing?
dictionary_entries.translated: 个人而言——是什么让您在创作过程中保持动力？

dictionary_entries.original: I enjoy building things—not just the projects themselves, but the systems behind them: the workflows, the relationships, the team.
dictionary_entries.translated: 我喜欢构建事物——不仅是项目本身，还有它们背后的系统：工作流程、人际关系、团队。.

dictionary_entries.original: Producing is a role where a lot of the work is invisible. If everything runs smoothly, it usually means many decisions were made quietly along the way. There’s something satisfying about that.
dictionary_entries.translated: 制片是一项工作中很多事务都处于“幕后”的。如果一切顺利，通常意味着在此过程中有许多决策都在悄无声息地做出。这一点令人很有成就感。.

dictionary_entries.original: I also enjoy sharing knowledge with the team. Teaching others forces you to organise your own thinking and refine what you’ve learned over time. At the same time, I often work with crew members who have decades of experience, and I learn a lot from seeing how they approach problems.
dictionary_entries.translated: 我也喜欢与团队分享知识。教导他人能迫使你整理自己的思路，并不断完善你随着时间的推移学到的东西。与此同时，我经常与拥有几十年经验的船员合作，通过观察他们处理问题的方式，我学到了很多。.

dictionary_entries.original: So it becomes a continuous cycle—staying curious, learning from people around you, organising that knowledge, and passing it on to the next generation of producers and crew.
dictionary_entries.translated: 这样就形成了一个持续的循环——保持好奇心，向周围的人学习，整理这些知识，然后将其传承给下一代的制作人和剧组成员。.

dictionary_entries.original: Finally, where do you see this going next?
dictionary_entries.translated: 最后，你认为接下来会如何发展？

dictionary_entries.original: I think production will become much more cross-border. Many tech brands are already thinking globally from the start, so campaigns are no longer tied to just one market.
dictionary_entries.translated: 我认为生产将变得更加跨境化。许多科技品牌从一开始就放眼全球，因此营销活动不再局限于单一市场。.

dictionary_entries.original: What excites me is building a system where production can move between regions intelligently—choosing the right location, the right crew, and the right environment for each project. Vietnam is a strong base, but the real opportunity is connecting different production ecosystems together.
dictionary_entries.translated: 让我兴奋的是构建一个系统，允许生产在不同地区之间智能地转移——为每个项目选择正确的地点、合适的团队和合适的环境。越南是一个强大的基地，但真正的机会在于将不同的制作生态系统连接起来。.

dictionary_entries.original: If we can keep refining that pipeline and collaboration across markets, I think some very interesting work will come from it.
dictionary_entries.translated: 如果我们能不断完善这个流程并加强跨市场的合作，我认为这将带来一些非常有趣的作品。.

Over the past few years, Duong has quietly positioned Vietnam as a viable production hub for Chinese tech brands looking to go global—handling everything from high-speed product launches to complex, multi-market campaigns.
