You can also request that we erase any personal data we hold about you. This does not include any data we are obliged to keep for administrative, legal, or security purposes.
gettext_entries.translated: 如果您在本网站拥有账户或发表过评论，您可以要求获得我们所持有的关于您的个人数据的导出文件，包括您向我们提供的任何数据。您也可以要求我们删除所持有的关于您的任何个人数据。这不包括我们出于行政、法律或安全目的而必须保留的任何数据。.

gettext_entries.original: Visitor comments may be checked through an automated spam detection service.
gettext_entries.translated: 访客的评论可能会通过自动垃圾邮件检测服务进行检查。.
按住Shift点击来编辑这个元素。
要编辑此小工具，按住Shift并点击鼠标。
点击来编辑这个小工具。

gettext_entries.original: Click to edit the site title.
Save my name, email, and website in this browser for the next time I comment.
gettext_entries.translated: 在此浏览器中保存我的显示名称、邮箱地址和网站地址，以便下次评论时使用。

gettext_entries.original: You must be logged in to post a comment.
gettext_entries.translated: 要发表评论，您必须先登录。

gettext_entries.original: Logged in as %1$s. Edit your profile. Log out?
gettext_entries.translated: 以 %1$s 的身份登录。 编辑您的个人资料。 注销？

gettext_entries.original: Your email address will not be published.
gettext_entries.translated: 您的电子邮箱地址不会被公开。
在回收站中未找到页面
区块样板已恢复为草稿。

gettext_entries.original: Collect technical data about my installation. The data will be used for technical analysis, plugin compatibility improvements and rarely for contacting the site admin in case of critical security releases or other issues related with the plugin proper functioning. We do not recommend opting out, as it may negatively impact the plugin performance. (A full list of the data to be collected can be found here)
gettext_entries.translated: 收集有关我的安装的技术数据。这些数据将用于技术分析、插件兼容性改进以及在出现重要安全发布或其他与插件正常运行相关的问题时联系网站管理员。我们不建议选择退出，因为这可能会对插件性能产生负面影响。(要收集的数据的完整列表请参见此处）
添加或删除区块样板分类

gettext_entries.original: Choose from the most used pattern categories
gettext_entries.translated: 从最常用的区块样板分类中选择

gettext_entries.original: A link to a pattern category.
gettext_entries.translated: 指向区块样板分类的链接。
区块样板分类列表导航
用逗号分隔区块样板分类

gettext_entries.original: %1$s %2$s isn't working as expected %3$s and you are not receiving updates or support! Make sure to %4$s activate your product subscription in %5$s%6$s to unlock all the features of %7$s.
gettext_entries.translated: %1$s %2$s 无法按预期运行 %3$s，并且您无法收到更新或支持！请确保在 %5$s%6$s 中 %4$s 激活您的产品订阅，以解锁 %7$s 的所有功能。.
了解更多搜索引擎优化

gettext_entries.original: WordPress database error: Processing the values for the following fields failed: %s. The supplied values may be too long or contain invalid data.
gettext_entries.translated: WordPress 数据库错误：处理以下字段的值失败：%s。提供的值可能太长或包含无效数据。

gettext_entries.original: Vivid cyan blue to vivid purple
Light green cyan to vivid green cyan
Luminous vivid amber to luminous vivid orange
gettext_entries.translated: 荧光琥珀色到荧光橙色

gettext_entries.original: Luminous vivid orange to vivid red
Very light gray to cyan bluish gray
Enter the email address you would like the notification email sent to.
gettext_entries.translated: 输入发送的通知邮件的电子邮件地址。

gettext_entries.original: When enabled, auto-formatting will insert paragraph breaks automatically. Disable auto-formatting when using HTML to create email notification content.
gettext_entries.translated: 当启用时，自动格式化将自动插入换行符。禁用，自动格式化时使用HTML创建电子邮件通知内容。

gettext_entries.original: Allows notification to be sent to different email addresses depending on values selected in the form.
gettext_entries.translated: 允许将根据在表单中选择的值发送通知到不同的电子邮件地址。

gettext_entries.original: Enter an authorized email address you would like the notification email sent from. To avoid deliverability issues, always use your site domain in the from email.
gettext_entries.translated: 输入您希望发送通知邮件的授权电子邮件地址。为避免发送问题，请务必在发件人电子邮件中使用您的网站域名。.

gettext_entries.original: Enter the name you would like the notification email sent from, or select the name from available name fields.
gettext_entries.translated: 输入你想发送的通知邮件名称，或选择可用的名称字段的名称。

gettext_entries.original: Enter the email address you would like to be used as the reply to address for the notification email.
gettext_entries.translated: 输入你想被用作电子邮件地址的电子邮件地址。

gettext_entries.original: Enter a comma separated list of email addresses you would like to receive a CC of the notification email.
gettext_entries.translated: 输入用逗号分隔的电子邮件地址列表，您希望这些地址接收抄送通知邮件。.

gettext_entries.original: Enter a comma separated list of email addresses you would like to receive a BCC of the notification email.
gettext_entries.translated: 输入一个逗号用分隔的你想收到秘密抄送通知邮件的电子邮件地址列表。

gettext_entries.original: When enabled, any files uploaded to File Upload fields will be attached to the notification email.
gettext_entries.translated: 启用后，上传到文件上传字段的任何文件都会附加到通知邮件中。.

gettext_entries.original: Limit the number of entries a form can generate and/or schedule a time period the form is active.
gettext_entries.translated: 限制条目的数量可以生成一种形式和/或安排一个时间段是活跃的。

gettext_entries.original: Enter a number in the input box below to limit the number of entries allowed for this form. The form will become inactive when that number is reached.
gettext_entries.translated: 在下面的输入框中输入一个数字来限制允许这个表单条目的数量。当表单达到这个数字时将变为非活跃，。

gettext_entries.original: Schedule a time period the form is active.
gettext_entries.translated: 安排一个时间周期内活跃的表单。

gettext_entries.original: Enable the honeypot to detect spam using multiple techniques.
gettext_entries.translated: 使 "巢穴 "能够使用多种技术检测垃圾邮件。.

gettext_entries.original: Check this option to enable a sliding animation when displaying/hiding conditional logic fields.
gettext_entries.translated: 选中此选项，在显示/隐藏条件逻辑字段时启用滑动动画。

gettext_entries.original: Check this option to enable Gravity Forms' legacy markup. This will hinder the accessibility of your form.
gettext_entries.translated: 选中此选项可启用 Gravity 表单的传统标记。这会妨碍表单的可访问性。.

gettext_entries.original: Enter the title of your form.
Enter a description for your form. This may be used for user instructions.
gettext_entries.translated: 输入您的表单的说明。这可用于用户指令。

gettext_entries.original: Select the default label placement.  Labels can be top aligned above a field, left aligned to the left of a field, or right aligned to the right of a field. This is a global label placement setting.
gettext_entries.translated: 选择默认标签位置。  标签可以在字段上方顶端对齐、在字段左侧左对齐或在字段右侧右对齐。这是一个全局标签位置设置。.

gettext_entries.original: Select the default description placement.  Descriptions can be placed above the field inputs or below the field inputs. This setting can be overridden in the appearance settings for each field.
gettext_entries.translated: 选择默认的描述位置。描述可以放置在该字段输入的上面或该字段输入的下面。这个设置可以为每个字段设置外观。

gettext_entries.original: Select the default validation message placement.  Validation messages can be placed above the field inputs or below the field inputs.
gettext_entries.translated: 选择默认的验证信息位置。  验证信息可以放在字段输入的上方或下方。.

gettext_entries.original: Select the default sub-label placement.  Sub-labels can be placed above the field inputs or below the field inputs. This setting can be overridden in the appearance settings for each field.
gettext_entries.translated: 选择默认的子标签放置。子标签可以放在字段输入的上面或字段输入的下面。这个设置可以为每个字段被设置外观。

gettext_entries.original: Select how you would like to indicate required fields.  You can choose either the default text or asterisk, or enter your own custom text.  If legacy markup is not enabled and you choose an asterisk, a legend will appear at the top of the form to explain the asterisk to users.
gettext_entries.translated: 选择表示必填字段的方式。  您可以选择默认文本或星号，也可以输入您自己的自定义文本。  如果未启用传统标记并选择星号，表单顶部会出现一个图例，向用户解释星号的含义。.

gettext_entries.original: Enter the text you would like to appear on the form submit button.
gettext_entries.translated: 输入您想在表单提交按钮上显示的文本。

gettext_entries.original: Enter the path to an image you would like to use as the form submit button.
gettext_entries.translated: 输入您想使用在表单提交按钮上的一个图像的路径。

gettext_entries.original: Enter the CSS class name you would like to use in order to override the default styles for this form.
gettext_entries.translated: 输入要用以覆盖这个表单默认样式CSS的类名称。

gettext_entries.original: Check this option to display the choices in columns instead of a single column.
gettext_entries.translated: 选中该选项可分栏而不是单栏显示选项。.

gettext_entries.original: Column Sort Direction determines how choices are ordered when displayed in multiple columns: Across fills left to right, then moves to the next row; Down fills top to bottom, then moves to the next column.
gettext_entries.translated: 列排序方向决定了多列显示时选项的排序方式：横向从左到右填充，然后移动到下一行；纵向从上到下填充，然后移动到下一列。.

gettext_entries.original: Enter the URL of a custom image to replace the default 'add item' icon. A maximum size of 16px by 16px is recommended
gettext_entries.translated: 输入自定义“添加选项”的按钮图片链接。图片的最大尺寸是16*16px。

gettext_entries.original: Enter the URL of a custom image to replace the default 'delete item' icon. A maximum size of 16px by 16px is recommended
gettext_entries.translated: 输入自定义“删除选项”的按钮图片链接。图片的最大尺寸是16*16px。

gettext_entries.original: Enter the text you would like the user to see on the confirmation page of this form.
gettext_entries.translated: 输入您希望用户在这个表单的确认页面上看到的文本。

gettext_entries.original: When enabled, auto-formatting will insert paragraph breaks automatically. Disable auto-formatting when using HTML to create the confirmation content.
gettext_entries.translated: 启用时，自动格式化将插入段落自动中断。禁用，自动格式化时使用HTML创建确认内容。

gettext_entries.original: Select the page you would like the user to be redirected to after they have submitted the form.
gettext_entries.translated: 选择您希望用户在提交表单后重新被重定向到页面。

gettext_entries.original: Enter the URL of the webpage you would like the user to be redirected to after they have submitted the form.
gettext_entries.translated: 输入您希望用户提交表单后被重定向到的网页的URL。
通过查询字符串传递数据

gettext_entries.original: To pass field data to the confirmation page, build a Query String using the 'Insert Merge Tag' drop down. %s..more info on querystrings »%s
gettext_entries.translated: 要将字段数据传递到确认页面，请使用 '插入合并标签 '下拉菜单创建查询字符串。%s...查询字符串的更多信息 »%s

gettext_entries.original: Enter the label of the form field.  This is the field title the user will see when filling out the form.
gettext_entries.translated: 输入表单字段的标签。这是外面用户在填写表单时会看到的标题。

gettext_entries.original: Enter the label for this HTML block. It will help you identify your HTML blocks in the form editor, but it will not be displayed on the form.
gettext_entries.translated: 输入该HTML块标签。它将帮助您识别您的HTML块的表单编辑器，但它不会显示在表单中。

gettext_entries.original: When enabled, margins are added to properly align the HTML content with other form fields.
gettext_entries.translated: 当启用时，边距被添加到适当与其他表单字段的HTML内容对齐。

gettext_entries.original: Select the visual theme for the reCAPTCHA field from the available options to better match your site design.
gettext_entries.translated: 选择用于reCAPTCHA字段的视觉主题，以更好的匹配您的网站设计。

gettext_entries.original: Select the type of CAPTCHA you would like to use.
gettext_entries.translated: 选择您想使用的验证码类型。

gettext_entries.original: Select the position of the badge containing the links to Google's privacy policy and terms.
gettext_entries.translated: 选择包含 Google 隐私政策和条款链接的徽章位置。.

gettext_entries.original: Select the custom field name from available existing custom fields, or enter a new custom field name.
gettext_entries.translated: 从现有自定义字段中选择自定义字段名称，或输入一个新的自定义字段名。

gettext_entries.original: Select the type of field from the available form fields.
gettext_entries.translated: 从可用的表单字段选择字段类型。

gettext_entries.original: Enter the maximum number of characters that this field is allowed to have.
gettext_entries.translated: 输入这个字段是允许的最大字符数。

gettext_entries.original: Enter the maximum number of rows that users are allowed to add.
gettext_entries.translated: 输入允许用户添加的最大行数。

gettext_entries.original: Select the type of inputs you would like to use for the date field. Date Picker will let users select a date from a calendar. Date Field will let users free type the date.
gettext_entries.translated: 选择要使用的日期字段的输入类型。日期选择器可以让用户从日历中选择日期。日期字段将让用户自由输入的日期。

gettext_entries.original: Select the type of address you would like to use.
gettext_entries.translated: 选择您想要使用的地址类型。

gettext_entries.original: Select the state you would like to be selected by default when the form gets displayed.
gettext_entries.translated: 选择您想要的默认选中时显示状态。

gettext_entries.original: Select the province you would like to be selected by default when the form gets displayed.
gettext_entries.translated: 选择您想要默认选中时显示的省份。

gettext_entries.original: Select the country you would like to be selected by default when the form gets displayed.
gettext_entries.translated: 选择您想要默认选中时显示的国家。

gettext_entries.original: For addresses that only apply to one country, you can choose to not display the country drop down. Entries will still be recorded with the selected country.
gettext_entries.translated: 对于仅适用于一个国家的地址，您可以选择不显示下拉菜单。条目仍将记录与所选择的国家。

gettext_entries.original: Check this box to prevent the extra address input (Address Line 2) from being displayed in the form.
gettext_entries.translated: 勾选此项，防止额外的地址输入(地址行2)被显示在表单中。

gettext_entries.original: Check this box to prevent the State field from being displayed in the form.
gettext_entries.translated: 勾选此项，阻止州字段被显示在表单中

gettext_entries.original: Check this box to prevent Province field from being displayed in the form.
gettext_entries.translated: 勾选此项，阻止省字段被显示在表单中

gettext_entries.original: Check this box to prevent the State/Province/Region from being displayed in the form.
gettext_entries.translated: 勾选此项，防止州/省/地区显示在表单中。

gettext_entries.original: Select the format you would like to use for the Name field.  There are 3 options, Normal which includes First and Last Name, Extended which adds Prefix and Suffix, or Simple which is a single input field.
gettext_entries.translated: 选择您想使用的名字字段格式。有三个选项，其中包名字和姓氏，扩展了前缀和后缀，或者说是一个简单的输入字段。

gettext_entries.original: Select the format of numbers that are allowed in this field. You have the option to use a comma or a dot as the decimal separator.
gettext_entries.translated: 允许选择数字的格式。您可以选择使用一个逗号或一个点作为小数分隔符。

gettext_entries.original: Check this box to prevent this field from being displayed in a non-secure page (i.e. not https://). It will redirect the page to the same URL, but starting with https:// instead. This option requires a properly configured SSL certificate.
gettext_entries.translated: 勾选此项，防止这个字段显示在一个不安全的页面上(例如：非https://)。它将重定向页面相同的UR，但从 https:// 开头。这个选项需要正确配置SSL证书。

gettext_entries.original: Select the format you would like to use for the date input.
gettext_entries.translated: 选择要用于输入日期的格式。

gettext_entries.original: Select the format you would like to use for the time field.  Available options are 12 hour (i.e. 8:30 pm) and 24 hour (i.e. 20:30).
gettext_entries.translated: 选择您想使用的时间字段格式。可用的选项是 12小时(如 8:30 pm)和 24小时(如20:30)。

gettext_entries.original: Enter the allowed file extensions for file uploads.  This will limit the type of files a user may upload.
gettext_entries.translated: 输入允许文件上传的文件扩展名。这将会限制用户可以上传文件的类型。

gettext_entries.original: Select this option to enable multiple files to be uploaded for this field.
gettext_entries.translated: 选择这个选项，使这个字段可以上传多个文件。

gettext_entries.original: Specify the maximum number of files that can be uploaded using this field. Leave blank for unlimited. Note that the actual number of files permitted may be limited by this server's specifications and configuration.
gettext_entries.translated: 指定文件可以上传使用的最大数量。留空为无限。注意，文件允许的实际数量可能会受到该服务器的规格和配置。

gettext_entries.original: Specify the maximum file size in megabytes allowed for each of the files.
gettext_entries.translated: 指定允许的每个文件的最大文件大小，以兆字节为单位的。

gettext_entries.original: Select the format you would like to use for the phone input.  Available options are domestic US/CANADA style phone number and international long format phone number.
gettext_entries.translated: 选择您想使用的电话输入格式。可用的选项是国内美国/加拿大国际长格式风格的电话号码和电话号码。

gettext_entries.original: Enter the description for the form field.  This will be displayed to the user and provide some direction on how the field should be filled out or selected.
gettext_entries.translated: 输入表单字段的描述。这将显示给用户，并提供在这个字段应该如何填写或选择一些方向。

gettext_entries.original: Select this option to make the form field required.  A required field will prevent the form from being submitted if it is not filled out or selected.
gettext_entries.translated: 选择这个选项我作为该表单要求的字段。一个要求的字段将防止表单被提交时不填写或选择。

gettext_entries.original: Select this option to limit user input to unique values only.  This will require that a value entered in a field does not currently exist in the entry database for that field.
gettext_entries.translated: 选择这个选项来限制用户输入惟一值。这将要求在字段中输入的值不存在于该字段的输入数据库中。

gettext_entries.original: Select this option to hide the field label in the form.
gettext_entries.translated: 选择此选项可隐藏表单中的字段标签。.

gettext_entries.original: Enter the minimum and maximum values for this form field.  This will require that the value entered by the user must fall within this range.
gettext_entries.translated: 输入该表单字段的最小和最大值。这将要求用户输入的值必须在该范围内。

gettext_entries.original: Enabling calculations will allow the value of this field to be dynamically calculated based on a mathematical formula.
gettext_entries.translated: 启用计算将使这个字段的值是基于一个数学公式动态计算的。

gettext_entries.original: Specify a mathematical formula. The result of this formula will be dynamically populated as the value for this field.
gettext_entries.translated: 指定一个数学公式。这个公式的结果将作为这个字段值的动态填充。

gettext_entries.original: Specify how many decimal places the number should be rounded to.
gettext_entries.translated: 指定小数点后多少位数应四舍五入。

gettext_entries.original: Enter the admin label of the form field.  Entering a value in this field will override the Field Label when displayed in the Gravity Forms administration tool.
gettext_entries.translated: 输入表单字段的管理标签。在这个字段中输入一个值将覆盖在Gravity表单管理工具中显示的字段标签。

gettext_entries.original: Enter values in this setting to override the Sub-Label for each field.
gettext_entries.translated: 在这个设置中输入值来重写每个字段的子标签。

gettext_entries.original: Select the label visibility for this field.  Labels can either inherit the form setting or be hidden.
gettext_entries.translated: 选择该字段的标签可见性。标签可以继承的表单设置或隐藏。

gettext_entries.original: Select the description placement.  Descriptions can be placed above the field inputs or below the field inputs.
gettext_entries.translated: 选择描述位置。描述可以放置在输入字段上面或输入字段的下面。

gettext_entries.original: Select the sub-label placement.  Sub-labels can be placed above the field inputs or below the field inputs.
gettext_entries.translated: 选择子标签放置。子标签可以放在字段输入的上面或字段输入的下面。

gettext_entries.original: Select a form field size from the available options. This will set the width of the field. Please note: if using a paragraph field, the size applies only to the height of the field.
gettext_entries.translated: 在可用选项中设置表单字段的尺寸。这将设置字段的宽度。请注意：文本字段的尺寸只有高度不同。

gettext_entries.original: Select the fields you'd like to use in this Name field and customize the Sub-Labels by entering new ones.
gettext_entries.translated: 选择您想这个名称字段中使用的字段，然后通过输入新的标签来定制子标签。

gettext_entries.original: Add Choices to this field. You can mark a choice as selected by default by using the radio buttons on the left.
gettext_entries.translated: 添加选择到这个字段。您可以在默认情况下，通过选择单选按钮左边使用默认的选择。

gettext_entries.original: Select the fields you'd like to use in this Address Field and customize the Sub-Labels by entering new ones.
gettext_entries.translated: 选择您想在该地址栏中使用的字段，并通过输入新的子标签来定制子标签。

gettext_entries.original: If you would like to pre-populate the value of a field, enter it here.
gettext_entries.translated: 如果您想预先填充一个字段的值，在这里输入它。

gettext_entries.original: The Placeholder will not be submitted along with the form. Use the Placeholder to give a hint at the expected value or format.
gettext_entries.translated: 占位符将不会随着表单提交。使用占位符在预期的值或格式上获得一个提示。

gettext_entries.original: Placeholders will not be submitted along with the form. Use Placeholders to give a hint at the expected value or format.
gettext_entries.translated: 占位符将不会随着表单提交。使用占位符在预期的值或格式上获得一个提示。

gettext_entries.original: Use Values Submitted in a Different Field
gettext_entries.translated: 在一个不同字段中提交使用的值

gettext_entries.original: Activate this option to allow users to skip this field and submit the values entered in the associated field. For example, this is useful for shipping and billing address fields.
gettext_entries.translated: 激活这个选项允许用户跳过这个字段，然后提交相关字段中输入的值。例如，这是用于送货和结算的地址字段。

gettext_entries.original: Enter the label to be displayed next to the check box. For example, "same as shipping address".
gettext_entries.translated: 输入要在复选框旁边显示的标签。例如，"送货地址"。

gettext_entries.original: Select the field to be used as the source for the values for this field.
gettext_entries.translated: 选择该字段作为这个字段值的来源

gettext_entries.original: Select this setting to display the option as activated by default when the form first loads.
gettext_entries.translated: 选择此设置，当表单第一次加载时默认激活以显示选项。

gettext_entries.original: Select this setting to let browsers help a user fill in a field with autocomplete.  You can enter a single autocomplete attribute or multiple attributes separated with a space.  Only use valid attributes: invalid attributes will not be saved.  Learn more about autocomplete in the %s accessibility documentation %s.
gettext_entries.translated: 选择此设置可让浏览器通过自动完成功能帮助用户填写字段。  您可以输入一个自动完成属性，也可以输入多个用空格分隔的属性。  只能使用有效属性：无效属性将不会保存。  有关自动完成的更多信息，请参阅 %s 辅助功能文档 %s。.

gettext_entries.original: If you would like to override the default error validation for a field, enter it here.  This message will be displayed if there is an error with this field when the user submits the form.
gettext_entries.translated: 如果您想重写一个字段的默认错误验证，在这里输入它。当用户提交表单时，如果有一个错误，该消息将被显示。

gettext_entries.original: Select the language you would like to use for the reCAPTCHA display from the available options.
gettext_entries.translated: 选择您想使用的reCAPTCHA可用选项显示的语言。

gettext_entries.original: Enter the CSS class name you would like to use in order to override the default styles for this field.
gettext_entries.translated: 输入您想使用的CSS类名称以覆盖这个字段的默认样式。

gettext_entries.original: Default option. The field is visible when viewing the form.
gettext_entries.translated: 默认选项。此字段在浏览表单时可见。

gettext_entries.original: The field is hidden when viewing the form. Useful when you require the functionality of this field but do not want the user to be able to see this field.
gettext_entries.translated: 此字段在浏览表单时将被隐藏。当你不希望用户填表时看见这个字段的时候，此功能很有用。

gettext_entries.original: The field is only visible when administering submitted entries. The field is not visible or functional when viewing the form.
gettext_entries.translated: 此字段仅当管理员提交表单时可见。该字段在浏览表单时不可见，也不起作用。

gettext_entries.original: Select the visibility for this field.
Define the choices for this field. If the field type supports it you will also be able to select the default choice(s) using a radio or checkbox located to the left of the choice.
gettext_entries.translated: 定义该字段的选项。如果字段类型支持，您还可以使用选项左侧的单选框或复选框选择默认选项。.

gettext_entries.original: Check this option to specify a value for each choice. Choice values are not displayed to the user viewing the form, but are accessible to administrators when viewing the entry.
gettext_entries.translated: 选中此选项为每个选择指定一个值。选择不显示给用户查看表单的值，但在查看该条目时，可访问管理员。

gettext_entries.original: Create rules to dynamically display or hide this field based on values from another field.
gettext_entries.translated: 创建基础另一个字段的值来动态地显示或隐藏这个字段的规则。

gettext_entries.original: By selecting this option, the %s jQuery script will be applied to this field, enabling search capabilities to Drop Down fields and a more user-friendly interface for Multi Select fields.
gettext_entries.translated: 选择该选项后，%s jQuery 脚本将应用于该字段，从而为下拉字段提供搜索功能，并为多选字段提供更友好的用户界面。.

gettext_entries.original: Check this option to add a "Select All" checkbox before the checkbox choices to allow users to check all the checkboxes with one click.
gettext_entries.translated: 选中该选项可在复选框选择前添加 "全选 "复选框，让用户只需单击一次即可选中所有复选框。.

gettext_entries.original: Check this option to add a text input as the final choice of your radio button field. This allows the user to specify a value that is not a predefined choice.
gettext_entries.translated: 请检查此选项以添加一个文本输入作为您的单选按钮字段的最后选择。这允许用户指定一个值，它不是一个预定义的选择。

gettext_entries.original: Enable this option to allow the user to select multiple choices. Disabling this option after entries with multiple choices have been submitted will hide the values for those entries.
gettext_entries.translated: 启用此选项可让用户选择多个选项。提交多选条目后，禁用此选项将隐藏这些条目的值。.

gettext_entries.original: Require user to be logged in
Check this option to require a user to be logged in to view this form.
gettext_entries.translated: 勾选这个选项以要求用户登录后查看这个表单。

gettext_entries.original: Enter a message to be displayed to users who are not logged in (shortcodes and HTML are supported).
gettext_entries.translated: 输入显示给未登录用户的信息（简码和HTML的支持）。

gettext_entries.original: Create rules to dynamically display or hide this page based on values from another field.
gettext_entries.translated: 创建基于另一个字段值动态显示或隐藏这个页面的规则。

gettext_entries.original: Select which type of visual progress indicator you would like to display.  Progress Bar, Steps or None.
gettext_entries.translated: 选择要显示的视觉进度指示器类型。进度条，步骤或无。

gettext_entries.original: Select which progress bar style you would like to use.  Select custom to choose your own text and background color.
gettext_entries.translated: 选择您想使用的进度条样式。选择“自定义”来选择您自己的“文本”和“背景颜色”。

gettext_entries.original: Name each of the pages on your form.  Page names are displayed with the selected progress indicator.
gettext_entries.translated: 在您的表单上的每个页面的名字。页面名称随着选定的进度指示器显示。

gettext_entries.original: Enter the text you would like to appear on the page next button.
gettext_entries.translated: 输入您想在下一步按钮上显示的文本。

gettext_entries.original: Enter the path to an image you would like to use as the page next button.
gettext_entries.translated: 输入您想用于页面的下一步按钮的一个图像的路径。

gettext_entries.original: Enter the text you would like to appear on the page previous button.
gettext_entries.translated: 输入您想在页面上一步按钮上显示的文本。

gettext_entries.original: Enter the path to an image you would like to use as the page previous button.
gettext_entries.translated: 输入您想用于页面的上一步按钮的一个图像的路径。
下一步 按钮条件逻辑

gettext_entries.original: Create rules to dynamically display or hide the page's Next Button based on values from another field.
gettext_entries.translated: 创建规则来动态显示或隐藏该页面上的基于另一个字段值的下一步按钮。

gettext_entries.original: Create rules to dynamically display or hide the submit button based on values from another field.
gettext_entries.translated: 创建规则来动态显示或隐藏基于另一个字段值的提交按钮。

gettext_entries.original: Select which categories are displayed. You can choose to display all of them or select individual ones.
gettext_entries.translated: 选择显示哪些分类。您可以选择显示所有的或个别选择。

gettext_entries.original: Select the post status that will be used for the post that is created by the form entry.
gettext_entries.translated: 选择将用于表单条目输入而创建的文章状态。

gettext_entries.original: Select the author that will be used for the post that is created by the form entry.
gettext_entries.translated: 选择将用于表单条目输入而创建的文章作者。

gettext_entries.original: Select the post format that will be used for the post that is created by the form entry.
gettext_entries.translated: 选择将用于表单条目输入而创建的文章格式。

gettext_entries.original: Check this option to format and insert merge tags into the Post Content.
gettext_entries.translated: 检查该选项去格式化和合并标签插入到文章内容。

gettext_entries.original: Check this option to format and insert merge tags into the Post Title.
gettext_entries.translated: 选中此选项去格式化和插入合并标签到文章标题。

gettext_entries.original: Select the category that will be used for the post that is created by the form entry.
gettext_entries.translated: 选择将用于通过表单条目输入创建的文章分类。

gettext_entries.original: Selecting this option will set the post author to the WordPress user that submitted the form.
gettext_entries.translated: 选择这个选项将设置文章作者为提交的表单的WordPress用户。

gettext_entries.original: Select one or more image metadata field to be displayed along with the image upload field. They enable users to enter additional information about the uploaded image.
gettext_entries.translated: 选择一个或多个图像元数据字段与图像上传字段一起显示。他们允许用户输入有关上传图像的附加信息。

gettext_entries.original: Check this option to set this image as the post's Featured Image.
gettext_entries.translated: 选中此选项来设置这张图片作为文章的特色图片。

gettext_entries.original: Check this option to enable data to be passed to the form and pre-populate this field dynamically. Data can be passed via Query Strings, Shortcode and/or Hooks.
gettext_entries.translated: 选中此选项，以便将数据传递给该字段的表单和预填充该字段动态。数据可以通过查询字符串、短码和/或勾子传递。

gettext_entries.original: Enter the content (Text or HTML) to be displayed on the form.
gettext_entries.translated: 输入在表单上显示的内容(文本或HTML)。

gettext_entries.original: Enter the base price for this product.
gettext_entries.translated: 输入这个产品的基础价格。

gettext_entries.original: Disables the quantity field.  A quantity of 1 will be assumed or you can add a Quantity field to your form from the Pricing Fields.
gettext_entries.translated: 禁用数量字段。数量1将假定您也可以从定价字段添加一个数量字段表单。

gettext_entries.original: Select which Product this field is tied to.
gettext_entries.translated: 选择哪个产品的字段是相关联的。

gettext_entries.original: Input masks provide a visual guide allowing users to more easily enter data in a specific format such as dates and phone numbers.
gettext_entries.translated: 输入遮罩提供一个视觉引导，允许用户更容易地在特定的格式，如日期和电话号码中输入数据。

gettext_entries.original: Standard Fields provide basic form functionality.
gettext_entries.translated: 标准字段提供基本表单的功能。

gettext_entries.original: Advanced Fields are for specific uses.  They enable advanced formatting of regularly used fields such as Name, Email, Address, etc.
gettext_entries.translated: 高级字段用于特定用途。他们启用了常常使用的高级格式化字段，如姓名，电子邮件，地址等。

gettext_entries.original: Post Fields allow you to add fields to your form that create Post Drafts in WordPress from the submitted data.
gettext_entries.translated: 文章字段允许您将字段添加到表单，从提交的数据创建WordPress中文章草稿。

gettext_entries.original: Pricing fields allow you to add fields to your form that calculate pricing for selling goods and services.
gettext_entries.translated: 定价字段允许您向您的表格中添加字段，计算销售商品和服务的定价。

gettext_entries.original: Select the form you would like to export entry data from. You may only export data from one form at a time.
gettext_entries.translated: 选择您要导出的表单数据。您可能仅导出在一个时间段中的表单数据。

gettext_entries.original: Select the forms you would like to export.
gettext_entries.translated: 选择您希望的导出的表单。

gettext_entries.original: Filter the entries by adding conditions.
gettext_entries.translated: 通过添加条件筛选条目。

gettext_entries.original: Select the fields you would like to include in the export.
gettext_entries.translated: 选择要包括在导出中的字段。

gettext_entries.original: Select a date range. Setting a range will limit the export to entries submitted during that date range. If no range is set, all entries will be exported.
gettext_entries.translated: 选择日期范围。将仅导出该日期范围内提交的条目。如果没有设置范围，所有条目将被导出。

gettext_entries.original: Click the file selection button to upload a Gravity Forms export file from your computer. Please make sure your file has the .json extension, and that it was generated by the Gravity Forms Export tool.
gettext_entries.translated: 单击文件选择按钮，从您的计算机上传 Gravity 表单导出文件。请确保您的文件具有 .json 扩展名，并且是由 Gravity Forms 导出工具生成的。.

gettext_entries.original: If a form uses the Image Choice field, or has Conversational Mode enabled, the importer will import the images and save them in your media library.
gettext_entries.translated: 如果表单使用了图片选择字段或启用了对话模式，导入程序就会导入图片并将其保存在媒体库中。.

gettext_entries.original: Your Gravity Forms support license key is used to verify your support package, enable automatic updates and receive support.
gettext_entries.translated: 您的Gravity Forms支持许可证密钥是用来验证您的插件支持包，启用自动更新并接收支持。

gettext_entries.original: Select yes or no to enable or disable CSS output.  Setting this to no will disable the standard Gravity Forms CSS from being included in your theme.
gettext_entries.translated: 选择“是”或“否”来启用或禁用CSS输出。没有设置将禁用标准Gravity表单，CSS被包含在您的主题

gettext_entries.original: Select yes or no to enable or disable HTML5 output. Setting this to no will disable the standard Gravity Forms HTML5 form field output.
gettext_entries.translated: 选择“是”或“否”来启用或禁用HTML5输出。没有设置将禁用标准 Gravity 表单的HTML5表单字段输出。

gettext_entries.original: Select On or Off to enable or disable no-conflict mode. Setting this to On will prevent extraneous scripts and styles from being printed on Gravity Forms admin pages, reducing conflicts with other plugins and themes.
gettext_entries.translated: 选择打开或关闭来启用或禁用无冲突模式。设置这这个开启，以防止多余的脚本和样式被打印在Gravity表单管理页面，减少与其他插件和主题的冲突。

gettext_entries.original: Enter your reCAPTCHA Site Key, if you do not have a key you can register for one at the provided link.  reCAPTCHA is a free service.
gettext_entries.translated: 输入您的reCAPTCHA站点密钥，如果您没有密钥，您可以点击链接注册一个。reCAPTCHA是一个免费服务。

gettext_entries.original: Enter your reCAPTCHA Secret Key, if you do not have a key you can register for one at the provided link.  reCAPTCHA is a free service.
gettext_entries.translated: 输入您的reCAPTCHA 私钥，如果您没有密钥，您可以注册一个供给链接。reCAPTCHA是一个免费的服务。

gettext_entries.original: Select the type of reCAPTCHA you would like to use.
gettext_entries.translated: 选择您要使用的 reCAPTCHA 类型。.

gettext_entries.original: Please select the currency for your location.  Currency is used for pricing fields and price calculations.
gettext_entries.translated: 请选择您所在地的货币。货币是用于定价字段和价格计算。

gettext_entries.original: Protect your form entries from spam using Akismet.
gettext_entries.translated: 使用Akismet垃圾邮件保护您的表单条目。

gettext_entries.original: Conversion is the percentage of form views that generated an entry. If a form was viewed twice, and one entry was generated, the conversion will be 50%.
gettext_entries.translated: 生成一个表单条目浏览转化率百分比。如果一个表单被浏览两次之后生成一个条目，转化率就是50%。

gettext_entries.original: If you have other forms on the page (i.e. Comments Form), specify a higher tabindex start value so that your Gravity Form does not end up with the same tabindices as your other forms. To disable the tabindex, enter 0 (zero).
gettext_entries.translated: 如果您有其他表单在页面上（即，评论表单），指定一个更高tabindex起始值，这样您的Gravity表单最终没有以同样的tabindices作为您的其他表单。禁用 tabindex，则输入0(零)。

gettext_entries.original: Enter a comma separated list of email addresses you would like to receive the selected notification emails.
gettext_entries.translated: 输入一个逗号分隔的电子邮件地址列表，您想接收选定的通知邮件。

gettext_entries.original: Check this box if you would like the progress bar to display with the confirmation text.
gettext_entries.translated: 勾选这个框，如果你想进度条显示确认文本。

gettext_entries.original: Enter text to display at the top of the progress bar.
gettext_entries.translated: 输入文本显示在进度条的顶部。

gettext_entries.original: Check this box if you would like to use the rich text editor for this field.
gettext_entries.translated: 如果你想要为此字段使用富文本编辑器，请选中此框。

gettext_entries.original: Check this box if you would like to include data from this form when exporting or erasing personal data on this site.
gettext_entries.translated: 如果您希望在本网站上导出或删除个人数据时包含本表中的数据，请选中此复选框。.

gettext_entries.original: Select the field which will be used to identify the owner of the personal data.
gettext_entries.translated: 选择用于识别个人资料所有者的字段。.

gettext_entries.original: Select the fields which will be included when exporting or erasing personal data.
gettext_entries.translated: 选择导出或删除个人数据时将包含的字段。.

gettext_entries.original: Check this box if you would like to prevent the IP address from being stored during form submission.
gettext_entries.translated: 如果您想防止在提交表单时存储 IP 地址，请选中此复选框。.

gettext_entries.original: Use these settings to keep entries only as long as they are needed. Trash or delete entries automatically older than the specified number of days. The minimum number of days allowed is one. This is to ensure that all entry processing is complete before deleting/trashing. The number of days setting is a minimum, not an exact period of time. The trashing/deleting occurs during the daily cron task so some entries may appear to remain up to a day longer than expected.
gettext_entries.translated: 使用这些设置，只保留需要的条目。自动销毁或删除超过指定天数的条目。允许的最短天数为 1 天。这样做是为了确保在删除/粉碎前，所有条目处理都已完成。天数设置是一个最小值，而不是一个精确的时间段。垃圾/删除发生在每天的 cron 任务中，因此有些条目可能会比预期多保留一天。.

gettext_entries.original: Check this box to add a toggle allowing the user to see the password they are entering in.
gettext_entries.translated: 选中该复选框可添加一个切换按钮，允许用户查看正在输入的密码。.

gettext_entries.original: Enable to show a summary that lists validation errors on top of the form.
gettext_entries.translated: 启用后，可在表单顶部显示列出验证错误的摘要。.

gettext_entries.original: Depending on the selected Bootstrap version the blocks will be rendered accordingly and version specific features will be available in the editor.
gettext_entries.translated: 根据所选的 Bootstrap 版本，编辑器中将相应地渲染块并提供特定版本的功能。.
启用 CSS 网格（试验性）

gettext_entries.original: If enabled Bootstrap's CSS grid will be used instead of the default flexbox grid system. The CSS grid is supported with Bootstrap >= 5.1.0. The `$enable-cssgrid` Bootstrap setting has to be set to `true` if this option is enabled.
gettext_entries.translated: 如果启用，将使用 Bootstrap 的 CSS 网格，而不是默认的 flexbox 网格系统。Bootstrap >= 5.1.0 支持 CSS 网格。如果启用此选项，Bootstrap 的 `$enable-cssgrid` 设置必须设为 `true`。.

gettext_entries.original: Huge SEO Issue: You're blocking access to robots.
gettext_entries.translated: 严重的SEO问题：站点正在屏蔽搜索引擎。

gettext_entries.original: If you want search engines to show this site in their results, you must %1$sgo to your Reading Settings%2$s and uncheck the box for Search Engine Visibility.
gettext_entries.translated: 如果您希望搜索引擎在其结果中显示此网站，则必须%1$s进入“阅读设置”%2$s，然后取消选中“搜索引擎可见性”框。

gettext_entries.original: I don't want this site to show in the search results.
gettext_entries.translated: 我不希望该网站显示在搜索结果中。

gettext_entries.original: Posted on %4$s
gettext_entries.translated: 发布于 %4$s。

gettext_entries.original: Save my name, email, and website in this browser for the next time I comment.
gettext_entries.translated: 将我的姓名、电子邮件和网站保存在此浏览器中，以便下次发表评论时使用。.

gettext_entries.original: You must be logged in to post a comment.
gettext_entries.translated: 您必须登录才能发表评论。.

gettext_entries.original: Logged in as %2$s. Log out?
gettext_entries.translated: 以 %2$s 登录。注销？

gettext_entries.original: Your Email address will not be published.
gettext_entries.translated: 您的电子邮件地址不会被公布。.

gettext_entries.original: Your recent posts are using default %1$s, which can make them easy to overlook in search results. Update them manually or %2$sfind out how %3$sYoast AI Generate%4$s can improve them for you.%5$s
gettext_entries.translated: 您最近发布的文章使用的是默认的 %1$s，这可能会使它们在搜索结果中容易被忽略。手动更新它们，或 %2$s了解 %3$sYoast AI Generate%4$s 如何为您改进它们。

gettext_entries.original: Looks like you’re new here. %1$s makes it easy to optimize your website for search engines. Want to keep your site healthy and easier to find? Sign up below to receive practical emails to get you started!
gettext_entries.translated: 看来您是新来的。%1$s 可让您轻松地为搜索引擎优化网站。想让您的网站保持健康并更容易被搜索到吗？在下方注册，即可收到实用的电子邮件，助您一臂之力！
前端搜索引擎优化检查员

gettext_entries.original: The form has been saved.  The content contains the link to return and complete the form.
gettext_entries.translated: 表格已保存。  内容包含返回并完成表格的链接。.

gettext_entries.original: This field is for validation purposes and should be left unchanged.
